articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of the Yangtze-Huai River Diversion Project on the Hydrodynamics and Water Quality of the Xi and Zhao Rivers
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The water quality of the Xi and Zhao Rivers, one of the critical lines of the Yangtze-Huai River Diversion Project, not only influences the water quality of Chaohu Lake but also the implementation of the overall diversion project. In order to build a hydrodynamic water quality model of the Xi and Zhao Rivers based on the MIKE11 model, a total of four water quality indicators-chemical oxygen demand (COD), permanganate index (COD<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</inf>), ammoniacal nitrogen (NH3-N), total nitrogen (TN), and total phosphorus (TP)-were used Eight working conditions were designed in accordance with the water quality and diversion flow of the Yangtze River, and the model was used to predict the effect of those working conditions on the hydrological situation of the Xi and Zhao Rivers in the planning year. This was based on the low-flow-year dual-lane design diversion scheme of the Yangtze-Huai River Diversion Project. According to the prediction results, the Xi and Zhao Rivers' flow velocity will change significantly after the river diversion project, and depending on the specific diversion flows, the river's water quality will improve to varying degrees. The Rivers' COD, COD<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</inf>, NH3-N, and TP levels will also be able to meet the diversion's requirements.

articleTitle: Collaborative Methods for the Ground Settlement Control in Shield Tunnels: Based on Numerical Simulation, GPR Detection and Ground Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Ground settlement during shield tunnel boring is a construction problem closely related to a variety of factors. To better control ground settlement, this paper proposes a ground settlement control method based on three collaborative methods: ground settlement prediction by FLAC3D numerical simulation, ground penetrating radar (GPR) backfilling grouting quality inspection and surface settlement monitoring. The results show that: the settlement pattern calculated by numerical simulation during excavation satisfies the peck settlement curve, and the maximum settlement does not exceed 6mm; the quality monitoring and dynamic feedback mechanism of backfill grouting can effectively guide the grouting construction and ensure compact grouting, and the results of monitoring the settlement of the tunnel surface show that the settlement of the surface and the settlement and tilt values of the building are within the permissible range.

articleTitle: Micro-Vibration Prediction and Evaluation Analysis of the Structural Foundation of a Precision Instrument Plant Across the Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The precision instrument plant is usually subjected to micro-vibration excitation by the passing of a high-speed railway, which affects the normal operation and working accuracy of precision instruments in the plant. This paper focuses on the natural vibration characteristics and micro-vibration of a large-scale precision scientific device plant across a reservoir. The whole finite element model of the final designed scheme of heavy bridge and culvert was established. The numerical analysis results show that the first 10 natural frequencies of the concrete structure of the main structure completely avoid the inherent frequency of the site of 5 ~ 10 Hz. The root means square of the comprehensive displacement of the foundation slab of the plant within the frequency of 1 ~ 100 Hz according to the time-history analysis does not exceed 150 nm, which meets the demands of micro-vibration control. Comparing the calculation results of two different damping ratio schemes, it is found that the damping ratio is an important factor in micro-vibration. The chosen designed scheme of heavy bridge and culvert across the reservoir is feasible to control the micro-vibration.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization Method of Internal Support System for Prefabricated Shaft of Underground Subway Station
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The research background of this paper is the research on the waist beam of the support system during the shaft construction stage of the subway tunnel construction. Because there is less comprehensive analysis and research at present, a standard design principle is needed to guide the actual construction. Therefore, according to the characteristics of the fabricated shaft and its waist beam, this paper constructs models with different spacing and size in combination with Xi'an Metro Line 8 Project. This paper analyzes the variation characteristics of displacement and stress under different factors, puts forward the design principle of the waist beam, reveals the variation characteristics of the displacement and internal force of the whole system with the depth of the shaft excavation process, and provides an important reference for the theoretical research and engineering design of the prefabricated shaft in the underground subway section. The conclusion shows that the displacement and stress increase gradually with the increase of the distance, reaching 50%, when the distance between the waist beams of the shaft changes between 2-6m, which indicates that the recommended value range of the subway shaft of this size is 4-6m.

articleTitle: Prediction of Settlement Induced by Tidal Fluctuation for Underwater Shield Tunnel During Service Based on Historical Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Underwater shield tunnels take significant parts in urbanization, such as metro tunnels and utility tunnels. It is important to determine the structural performance and safety during service under complex changes in structure and surrounding ground. One of the influencing factors for underwater shield tunnels is tidal fluctuation. To study the effect of tidal fluctuation on the settlement of underwater shield tunnels, field monitoring, theoretical calculation and statistical analysis are carried out for an underwater shield tunnel crossing the Huangpu River in Shanghai. Based on the historical monitoring data of tunnel settlement and tidal level, the analysis and prediction of tunnel settlement are carried out. The large positive linear association between variables during the service are revealed and verified. It's necessary to consider the effect of tidal fluctuation on tunnel settlement when analyzing the performance and safety of underwater shield tunnels given the unneglectable contribution. Further, the mechanical parameters of the tunnel structure and surrounding ground are determined. A data-driven prediction method of long-term settlement for underwater shield tunnels is proposed and compared. The comparison of different prediction window implies that the mechanical parameters of tunnel structure and surrounding ground only changes slightly in a short period. The results are meaningful for the evaluation and analysis of the performance and safety of underwater shield tunnels.

articleTitle: Artificial Neural Network-Based Method for Locating The Latest Assembled Shield Segment Ring
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The shield segments need to fit the design tunnel axis (DTA) during construction, and the axis fitting deviation needs to be maintained within a permissible range. The location of the latest assembled segment ring is an indispensable condition for calculating the axis fitting deviation of new ring. However, there is no description of the calculation method for the location of the latest assembled segment ring. Aiming at this problem, an artificial neural network-based method for calculating the location of the ring is proposed. First, the calculation of the segment ring location is transformed into the calculation of the relative location of the ring to the shield machine, and the thrust cylinder strokes and shield tail gaps are used to calculate the relative position. Then, a Monte Carlo-based method is proposed to generate dataset, which is used to train neural network to obtain the calculation model of relative location. Finally, the calculation method of segment ring location was tested on the test set, and the results showed that the calculation results meet the engineering requirements. The proposed method can accurately calculate the location of the latest assembled segment ring in real time, which can improve the quality of tunnels.

articleTitle: Comparison of Support Vector Machine, Gaussian Process Regression and Decision Tree Models for Energy Consumption Prediction of Campus Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Accurate prediction of campus building energy consumption is an important part of building energy consumption management, which is of great significance for reducing campus energy consumption. This paper compares the prediction accuracy of different machine learning algorithms for campus building energy consumption. Firstly, the meteorological and energy consumption data of a campus building in Beijing were collected. And the data were preprocessed and normalized by interpolation methods. Secondly, based on the collected data, three kinds of energy consumption prediction models of campus buildings, namely support vector machine (SVM), Gaussian process regression (GPR) and decision tree (DT), were trained respectively. The results show that the prediction accuracy of SVM model is 5.79% higher than that of GPR model and 13.93% higher than that of DT model. It is proved that SVM has the highest prediction accuracy and good practical value for energy consumption prediction of campus buildings.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent transportation verification platform based on hardware in the loop simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to verify the intelligent transportation system more directly, efficiently and comprehensively, this paper aims at the simulation and verification of the intelligent transportation system, and designs an intelligent transportation simulation and verification platform based on the hardware of intelligent minivan, simulation sand table, cloud monitoring platform, and millimeter class high-precision indoor positioning technology, multi-sensor fusion technology, and hardware in the loop simulation technology. At the same time, the multi vehicle formation control algorithm of the leader follower is applied to build the multi vehicle formation model, and the test verification is carried out on the simulation platform. The verification shows that the hardware in the loop simulation platform can effectively verify and quickly verify relevant algorithms. Compared with the traditional software simulation, the intelligent transportation verification platform based on hardware in the loop simulation technology has outstanding performance in model building, result analysis and effect display, and the simulation results are more accurate.

articleTitle: Soil and Water Conservation Online Monitoring System Based on Ultrasonic and Photosensitive Measurement Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The construction of ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission is the current trend in smart grids. However, the construction of UHV transmission will cause harm to the environment along the way. Environmental problems such as reduced green areas and soil erosion were triggered. Therefore, a soil and water online conservation monitoring system is studied. Hardware devices such as photosensitive drilling sensors and ultrasonic drilling sensors are used. It can provide accurate data support for soil and water conservation. The platform for data transfer and storage is designed in the system. Through a combination of hardware equipment and software, the system enables the collection of soil loss and meteorological data. The results show that the system has fast data collection speed, high monitoring accuracy and good data processing effect. The system has certain guiding significance for the prevention and control of soil erosion caused by the construction of ultra-high voltage power transmission.

Author Keywords: soil and water conservation online monitoring technology

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of tunnel wall reflection characteristics on tunnel lighting efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The wall in the tunnel is an important part of the driver's visual space, which constitutes the visual background of obstacles and vehicles. Affected by indirect light, the light reflected by the tunnel wall has a certain influence on the performance indicators such as the brightness and illuminance of the road surface, but there is still a lack of relevant research on the magnitude of the influence. In this paper, a three-dimensional space model of tunnel lighting is established, and the ray tracing algorithm is used to study the effect of the reflection characteristics of the tunnel wall on the efficiency gain of the road surface. The research results show that the road lighting efficiency gain is basically proportional to the wall reflectance, and the wall reflectance to the road lighting efficiency gain is affected by the light intensity distribution of the light source and the ceiling reflectance. In general, a higher wall reflectivity can increase the brightness of the wall itself, and the gain effect on the road lighting efficiency is not obvious. Generally, the maximum gain amplitude is less than 5%.

articleTitle: Test Analysis on Blasting Vibration of Xiaoyu Three-lane Neighborhood Highway Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Due to the extremely small thickness of interlaid rock in the small clear spacing tunnel, blasting construction is easy to have a certain impact on the tunnel structure, so it is particularly important to explore the dynamic law of tunnel structure under blasting load. Based on the Xiaoyu Tunnel in Qinhuangdao, the blasting vibration of the first tunnel was monitored during the blasting process of the rear tunnel of the tunnel, and the vibrational attenuation law and spectral characteristics of the first tunnel under blasting were analyzed. The results show that the vibrational velocity at the horizontal radial side wall is the largest in the three-dimensional vibrational velocity. The blasting vibration velocity decreases with the increase of the distance from the explosion source, and the attenuation rate also decreases, which can be attenuated by more than 50% at 15m. At the same section position, the blasting side wall is the position with the largest vibrational velocity, followed by the arch waist; the vibrational velocity of the front explosion side is much larger than that of the back explosion side, and the vibrational velocity of the front explosion side at the side wall position can reach 6∼7 times that of the back explosion side. The research results of this paper can provide a reference for the safe construction of similar tunnel small clear spacing tunnel projects.

articleTitle: Fully Coupled Thermal-mechanical Analysis of Concrete Gravity Arch Dam
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this study, a fully coupled analysis method of the thermal-mechanical field in the pouring process of mass concrete is proposed to analyze the temperature and stress distribution of a concrete gravity arch dam. A computational code of a concrete temperature damage constitutive model is programmed as a subroutine program in the finite element code ABAQUS via the secondary development platform. The construction process of a gravity arch dam is simulated, and the dam's thermal-mechanical field and damage or cracking area during the pouring construction are analyzed. The results show that the method proposed in this paper is appropriate for calculating and analyzing the fracture problem triggered by the internal temperature change in the pouring process of a concrete gravity arch dam. Predicting and evaluating the damage and cracking distribution during the concrete dam construction period can be processed via the method proposed in this paper. The research results will provide a reference for the construction and operation of the dam project.

articleTitle: Seismic Analysis of Reinforced Concrete Column Strengthened with carbon Fibre Reinforced Polymer and Steel Jacket
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Considering the respective advantages and limitations of steel jacket reinforcement technology and CFRP reinforcement technology, this paper proposes a method to strengthen concrete columns with a combination of CFRP and steel jacket. The low cyclic loading test was carried out by finite element simulation. The influence of axial compression ratio, carbon fibre cloth dosage and steel jacket strength on the seismic performance of composite reinforced concrete column with CFRP and steel jacket are analyzed. The research shows that The strength of steel jacket has a decisive influence on increasing the load-bearing capacity of specimens. with the increase of axial compression ratio, the ultimate bearing capacity of reinforced concrete columns decreases. The CFRP can protect the steel jacket from corrosion, and work together to be good for seismic reinforcement of reinforced concrete columns.

articleTitle: Research on Building Deformation Prediction Method Based on Prophet Model including Illumination Periodicity Factor
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The deep learning technology based on data sample set obtained by machine vision is one of the new means of building deformation prediction, and the prediction accuracy is difficult to improve due to the interference of ambient stray light. To resolve this problem, this paper proposes a Prophet model including illumination periodicity factor to predict the deformation of building structures. According to the periodic variation characteristics of ambient stray light, a linear combination function of trend term and seasonal term is constructed in Prophet model. In order to verify the prediction effect of the proposed model, the long short memory network model (LSTM) and the Prophet model without illumination periodicity factor were selected for comparative study. The experimental results show that the root-mean-square errors of the prediction results based on the Prophet model with illumination periodicity factor in the X and Y directions of the target monitoring point are 0.24 mm and 1.54 mm respectively, which are superior to the LSTM model and the Prophet model without illumination periodicity factor.

articleTitle: An Application of the Digital Image Crack Detection Technology Using UAV in Reservoir Safety Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The on-site inspection of reservoir dam safety evaluation requires the detection of crack characteristics of hydraulic concrete structures. Traditional methods mainly rely on manual detection, the recognition results of which are often imprecise and incomplete due to the subjectivity of the worker and the difficulty in reaching some parts of the detection objects. In this paper, a multi-point fixed-distance static photography of the cracks in the floor of the spillway of the Anhua Reservoir is carried out by using the UAV imaging technology. During the shooting process, the calibration object is used to calculate the imaging accuracy. Then, the improved digital image processing algorithm is proposed to carry out image processing, and the maximum crack width and crack centerline length under given accuracy are calculated.

articleTitle: Study on the Applicability of Spatial Interpolation Method for 3D Geological Modeling in Geotechnical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: For geotechnical engineering application, with the urgent needs of the subsurface development, 3D geological modeling is one of the main means of visualization and calculation of subsurface, and the spatial interpolation method for geological surface is the main methods for the related research of 3D geomodelling. In this paper, different methods of spatial interpolation are summarized and studied, including kriging interpolation, inverse distance weighted interpolation (IDW), spline function interpolation, and discrete smooth interpolation (DSI) method. In this paper, the principles and theories of these interpolation methods are discussed, the applicability and advantages of different methods are compared, and the improved method of 3D subsurface model building is summarized, the kriging method and the DSI method are more suitable for spatial interpolation in the geomodelling field with higher precision, but the calculations are more time-consuming than the IDW and spline function interpolation methods.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Development Trend of Domestic Pumped-Hydro Storage Based on SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As the most mature power system regulation device in the current energy storage technology, with the most significant benefit of carbon emission reduction in the whole life cycle, the best economy and large-scale development conditions, pumped-hydro storage plays an important role in ensuring the safety of large power grid, promoting the consumption of new energy and improving the performance of power system. The development of pumped-hydro storage investment is closely related to the geographical conditions, peak shaving demand, renewable energy consumption and so on of the region itself. The non-linear characteristics among the influencing factors are obvious. In this paper, the support vector machine (SVM) is used to establish the prediction analysis model of pumped-hydro storage installed capacity, which is commonly used in machine learning methods. Meanwhile, this model combines the characteristics of different stages of new power system construction, and introduce penalties for external factors such as construction difficulty, investment cost, investment, etc. To adapt to the non-linear characteristics of different influencing factors, the kernel function of this model is a linear combination of polynomial kernel function, RBF kernel function and Sigmoid kernel function. The calculation and analysis results show that the installation rate of pumped storage is expected to peak in 2030, after which some pumped storage devices and micro pumped storage that meet the concept of generalized pumped storage gradually participate in the market competition until 2060, when the era of carbon neutrality combined with electricity and hydrogen comes, pumped storage will not be competitive in the energy storage market.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of Digital Twin System for Bridge Vehicle Load Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligent level of bridge operation and maintenance, breaking through the bottleneck of real-time positioning of moving vehicle load on bridge deck, This research combines image recognition, target tracking, data fusion and other technologies, a digital twin system for real-time identification of vehicle load position on bridge deck is developed. Firstly, the virtual bridge vehicle operation platform is developed, the multi-angle, multi-environment and multi-type vehicle data sets are obtained; Secondly, A bridge global image information fusion technology based on vision stitching is proposed, combined with the improved deep learning algorithm, the real-time recognition and tracking of vehicles in the whole bridge are realized; Furthermore, integrated bridge camera real-time image data and bridge dynamic weighing system, a digital twin system for real-time identification of vehicle load position on bridge deck is constructed; Finally, the above system is applied to Baijusi Yangtze River Bridge, realized the real-time identification of vehicles and vehicle load positions of Baijusi Yangtze River Bridge.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Load Bearing Capacity of Offshore Jacket Platform with Suction Caisson
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In Zhuanghe wind farm project II, located in the northeast of China, the load-bearing capacity of 30 offshore jacket platforms with suction caisson has been numerically verified. As a representative, foundation 15# is selected to show the surrounding soils' deformation, rotation, and plastic areas. Various calculation cases have been considered, including the operation state (SLS and ULS), extreme wave load, ice load of a 50-year period, different load directions, and 2 m of scour depth. Calculation results show the influence of ice load in a 50-year period is dominant, in which case the plastic area of ice load cases is way larger than extreme wave load cases. The icing on the near coastline happens a lot in winter, so the effect of the ice load should be carefully treated. The rotation of the 15 # jacket-suction caisson foundation reaches 7.58%o in SLS, which largely exceeds the limit of 4.36%o, so the design 15 # jacket-suction caisson foundation hardly meets the requirement. In this case, the design should be modified and load bearing behavior of structures should be re-verified. Overall, the standard of verifying the loading bearing capacity regarding offshore jacket platforms with suction caisson is that pile top rotation 4.36%o and the plastic area connecting. The suggestion for the design regarding this type of offshore foundation, when the load-bearing capacity is not enough, is to make the suction caisson larger or longer. Also, the accuracy of CPTu representation is crucial for the calculation. Meanwhile, in this study, the pressure difference between the suction bucket inside and outside has not been taken into account, which may cause inaccuracy, and this could be future complimentary research.

articleTitle: Modeling of Urban Water Supply and Treatment System and Optimal Operation of Filters
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The urban water supply system is usually designed based on the technical conditions at that time to achieve the optimum in theory. However, due to the impact of various factors such as different ecological environments and seasonal changes, the water supply system cannot operate under the optimal working conditions in practical production applications. And because the water supply system is an indispensable infrastructure of the city, the relationship between water quality and price is of great significance to the development of the whole society. It is very necessary to take corresponding technical measures to ensure the quality of water supply. As an important part of the urban water supply system, water treatment process facilities are the key link to determine the water quality and water price. Reasonable adjustment of their working conditions can meet the water quality requirements of users. Therefore, this paper aims to study the modeling of the urban water supply water treatment system and the optimal operation of the filter. Therefore, first, the urban water supply situation, data collection and pretreatment are studied and analyzed. Second, the modeling and optimization of the water treatment system are studied. Finally, through the optimization study of the filter operation, it is concluded that the filter can obtain better filtration capacity after optimization and can reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Numerical Study of Coastal Erosion Based on Sea Level Rise
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In the propagation of wave near the shore, the water depth becomes shallower and the nonlinear effect becomes more intense. An extended version of XBeach model is presented to improve the accuracy of coastal profile evolution under nonlinear wave, and the improved model is verified by the classical wave flume experiment. The results show that the improved model can more accurately simulate the change of coastal erosion and deposition under wave action and can be used in the numerical simulation of coastal profile evolution. Based on wave flume experiment, several groups of simulated water depth were added to simulate sea level rise and explore the relationship between sea level change and coastal profile evolution. The results show that the higher the sea level is, the more serious the coastal erosion is and the larger the shoreline recession is. The trend of shoreline recession calculated by the numerical model is consistent with that predicted by Bruun Rule, which indicates that the numerical model can effectively predict the change of coastal erosion caused by sea level rise.

articleTitle: Study of Wireless Transmission Stress Measurement System Based on LoRa
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: A new wireless transmission stress measurement system was developed using the LoRa for the limitations of on-site stress testing cables of bolt support, including difficult layout, easy damage and high cost. On the basis of retaining off-line stress test analysis, the system can solve the problem of stress signal transmission of bolt support using wireless data transmission technology, so as to achieve real-time online measurement of bolt supporting stress in tunnels and roadways. Engineering practice showed that the wireless stress test system has strong anti-interference and high measurement accuracy and can satisfy test demands, providing strong data support for tunnel safety assessment.

articleTitle: Forward modeling of ground penetrating radar in look-ahead detection of slurry balance shield machine
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) is an efficient and no damage method which can be used in look-ahead detection of various obstacles like large boulders, concrete pile foundations and metal pipes or plates in the construction of slurry balance shield machine tunnels. Based on finite difference time domain method (FDTD), GPR responses were investigated using synthetic forward modellings. Numerical simulations show that obstacles can be identified in images of GPR.

articleTitle: Stability Evaluation of Slopes Containing a Weak Layer Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Man-made slopes including landfills and waste dumps may be situated above a weak layer, the stability of which needs to be evaluated carefully. In this paper, a novel method based on the artificial neural network is proposed to predict the factor of safety for slopes containing a weak layer. A dataset consisting of 50 samples obtained from numerical simulations is used for training and testing. Inputs are selected to be factors influencing the slope stability including not only slope geometry and soil properties but also the properties and thickness of the weak layer. High performance of the trained artificial neural network model is observed from the high correlation coefficient between the predicted and input factor of safety. The trained model is then applied to predict the factor of safety of 144 slopes and compared with some new numerical results, further demonstrating its applicability and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Relay Pump and Pipeline Layout Optimization Technology for Ultra-long-distance Slurry Transportation of the Xiaomiaohong Dredging Project
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In the construction of dredging, large cutter suction dredgers often use ship-borne mud pumps and relay pump boats for ultra-long-distance slurry transportation. There are problems that affect the quality and efficiency of construction, such as long conveying distance, high pipeline pressure, and complex pipeline composition. Based on the theoretical calculation of pipeline transportation resistance, this paper conducts the optimization of pipeline and relay pump layout scheme, and proposes an optimization scheme for the composition of sludge discharge pipelines, a flange structure strengthening scheme and a relay pump position layout optimization scheme. The results show that the complete set of optimization schemes can ensure the continuity and safety of the construction, and improve construction efficiency and environmental protection capabilities.

articleTitle: The Study on Problems and Solutions of Digital Twin Technology Application under River Chief System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As technology continues to develop, digital twin technology is gradually being used in water information technology. However, the current digital twin system still suffers from a number of difficulties, such as a lack of data, system coordination, and input and output. Based on this, this paper explores the problems and challenges of combining the digital twin technology with the river chief system and proposes policy recommendations to improve the data management system, address the relationship between people and technology, create an open digital twin public service platform, increase investment in research, and strengthen the training of complex talents.

articleTitle: Dynamic response analysis on caisson wharf structure under earthquake
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The caisson wharf's seismic response is an essential issue in the design and construction. The finite element method is used in numerical simulation. The complex internal components of the caisson structure are usually simplified when modeling, and connection between steel and concrete which affect the results are ignored. Based on the project of Putian port, constraint equation method is used in the numerical model, dynamic response of caisson wharf under earthquake is studied and results of static analysis and dynamic time history analysis are obtained. It shows that the proposed numerical modal is more realistic and can obtain more reasonable results. Under seismic action, displacement and stress increase obviously at the beginning of earthquake, and decrease with time until a trend of stability. As the shape mutation, the stress concentration phenomenon occurred at the caisson front toe and back toe, and toes need to be strengthened during design and construction. The results can provide a reference for the seismic design of caisson wharf.

articleTitle: Intellectualized Design and Construction of Fabricated Reinforcement Based on J2EE Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: FSTCC reinforcement is a semi-finished product of fabricated steel tube in the factory, which is installed into a finished product on site. Construction of FSTCC is a hotpot both in academic field and in modern engineering. This reinforcement method is environmentally friendly and efficient. This paper verifies that traditional reinforcement method was Optimally designed. The process of FSTCC reinforcement was re-engineering based on BIM. The process of system was designed and implemented based on J2EE technology. The stress and strain of reinforced column was analyzed, considering the secondary stress. The axial compression ratio beyond limit value is controlled within limit value, so that the ductility of the overall structure is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Research on the Influence Factors of Geotextile Control of Subgrade Collapse
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The influence factors of geotextile control of subgrade collapse were studied in this paper. To evaluate the influence of the subsidence width, tensile stiffness of geotextile and finite element software meshing three factors on subgrade subsidence treatment, finite element analysis was performed. The soil pressure, vertical deflection of the geotextile and soil settlement were analyzed. The results showed that the soil pressure, vertical deflection of the geotextile and soil settlement increased as the subsidence width increased. When an anchorage ratio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L$</tex> was equale or smaller than 0.5B, the geotextile was not suitable for treatment of a subgrade collapse. With the tensile stiffness of geotextile increased, the soil pressure increased, while vertical deflection of the geotextile and soil settlement decreased. It indicated that improving the tensile stiffness of geotextiles is improving safety of the structure. As the change of the finite element software meshing, the curves trend of the vertical deflection of the geotextile and soil settlement unchanged which indicated the effect of the finite element software meshing on model performance was neglectable.

articleTitle: Research on Air-conditioning Operation Energy Saving in Internet Data Center
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In recent years, China's internet data center (IDC) has grown rapidly. At the same time of rapid development, the problem of high energy consumption in IDC has been highlighted. Reducing the energy consumption of IDC cooling equipment has a profound impact on energy saving. This paper analyzes the energy saving of the IDC room by raising the air conditioning temperature and testing the change of temperature and humidity of the cold channel. The test found that for every 1°C increase in air conditioning temperature, IDC room air conditioning energy consumption is reduced by 12.9% ~ 14.0%. This paper is a guide to the construction of green data centers and the energy-efficient operation of IDC room air conditioners.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on The Effect of Bridge Piers Introduced by Landslide-Generated Waves
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Landslide surge is very harmful to wading structures. In this paper, it is found that the wave pressure on the pier can be classified into two types: impact pressure and pulsating pressure. The impact wave energy mainly gathers in the main wave direction. The distribution law of impact pressure along the water depth is divided into three types: single-peak, multi-peak, and no-peak. The impact pressure only exists in the main wave direction, and only exists in the opposite pier. The impact pressure increases first and then decreases along the water depth, the impact pressure in the middle of the pier is the largest. The pulsating pressure can be approximately regarded as a uniform load distribution along the water depth under certain water depth conditions. The maximum wave pressure is located in the middle from the bottom of the pier to the water surface. The calculation formula of the maximum hydrodynamic pressure is given for engineering reference.

articleTitle: Determining the Site Fundamental Period Based on Legendre Spectral Element Wave Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The site fundamental period, or the site fundamental frequency, is a main parameter for site classification in the Japanese seismic design code and the 2021 draft of Eurocode 8. In this study, the site fundamental period has been determined by a spectral element wave simulation based numerical method. First, we use the Legendre spectral elements method and the explicit integration scheme establishing the space and time discrete scheme for a one-dimensional problem. The accuracy and stability of our scheme are verified by comparing with the existing theoretical solutions and the existing literature. Then, we apply the scheme determining the site fundamental period.

articleTitle: Analysis of the characteristics of storm surge increase in Macau in recent years and empirical forecast of storm surge
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Macau is the core city of Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. In recent years, the number of strong typhoons in Macau has been increasing due to the influence of climate change, and the losses from storm surge disasters have been devastating in recent years. Accurate and sufficiently time-sensitive storm surge forecasting is one of the important elements to prevent and mitigate coastal flood disasters. Based on data of typhoon and the tidal level in Macau in the past 50 years, this study establishes a single-station forecasting formula for the Macau inner harbor station by separated storm surge and astronomical tide through harmonic analysis, and analyzing its surge characteristics and conducting empirical statistical forecast analysis to mitigate the storm surge disaster in the Macau region.

articleTitle: Analysis of Flow Field Characteristics of Square Piers Based on Different Slits
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The piers are scoured by water and sediment all year round, so it is necessary to study the protection of piers. In recent years, scholars have made breakthrough in the research of scour mechanism, scour depth calculation and pier protection measures. In this paper, three groups of slotted square pier models are established through ICEM, and Fluent is used for calculation and analysis. It is concluded that the pier opening is conducive to reducing the local scour caused by water flow, and the Y-shaped joint has a significant effect on reducing the scour caused by water flow, which provides a reference for the subsequent research on pier scour prevention and bridge construction.

articleTitle: Eddy current detection of hollowing defect in building exterior wall insulation layer based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to effectively detect cavitation defects in the insulation of building facades, which have a great impact on the structural safety of the project, proposes an eddy current signal impedance map analysis method based on RBF neural network. Firstly, a composite magnetic filler is added to make the insulation layer have electromagnetic properties, and then a self-comparing eddy current coil is used to build an experimental platform for eddy current detection of cavity defects in building external wall insulation; subsequently, uses the Hough transform to extract the signal geometric features; based on the geometric feature vector, a radial basis (RBF) neural network is established and trained to achieve the detection and classification of defects under noisy conditions; through the experimental detection of cavity defects in insulation layer of different specifications The experimental detection of hollow drum defects shows that the method has good robustness and universality.

articleTitle: Geomechanical Aspects of Fracture Placement in Horizontal Wells
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: For horizontal wells with cased-hole completion, multistage hydraulic fracturing is often performed to create multiple fractures through perforation clusters within each stage. The opening of propped fractures alters in-situ stress underground. The stress redistribution affects the propagation direction of the hydraulic fractures. The spacing between perforation clusters, the number of the clusters and the orientation of transverse fractures all have major impacts on well production. How to place these perforation clusters is a critical optimization issue. In this study, the spacing between perforation clusters is optimized based on stress analysis. A 3D numerical model is developed based on finite element method. The comparison between analytical and numerical solutions indicates that an excellent agreement has been achieved, which certificates the applicability of the numerical models to complex situations. Stress redistribution around hydraulic fractures can occur due to the opening of hydraulic fractures and poroelastic effects. Only the opening of hydraulic fractures is considered in the numerical model. Results indicate that the initial in-situ stress contrast in horizontal plane has a strong influence on the extent of stress-reversal region and reoriented-stress region. When the generated stress contrast is larger than the initial in-situ stress contrast, there will be stress-reversal region in the vicinity of fractures. As the distance from fractures increases, the generated stress contrasts become smaller. When the generated stress contrast is less than the initial in-situ stress contrast, the stress trajectories do not reverse. Usually the stress-reversal region is in the vicinity of fractures, the reoriented-stress region is beyond the stress-reversal region and around fracture tips.

articleTitle: Slope Stability Analysis of Expressway Subgrade with Photovoltaic Facilities
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Energy efficiency can be improved and the purpose of energy conservation and carbon reduction can be achieved by setting photovoltaic power generation facilities on the subgrade slope of expressways for solar power generation. However, the stability of the subgrade slope, which is the main structure of expressways, is related to the operation safety of expressways. Aiming at the stability problem of an expressway subgrade configured with photovoltaic power generation facilities, the analysis model was established through the numerical simulation analysis method, and the safety factors of the subgrade slope under different conditions were obtained. The results show that: (1) After the photovoltaic power generation facilities were installed on the subgrade of the expressway, the maximum shear strain of the slope under the action of photovoltaic panels and support loads was slightly greater than that without photovoltaic panels. Photovoltaic facilities had a slight impact on slope deformation. The safety factors of the slope with and without photovoltaic facilities were 4.36 and 4.33 respectively, which were relatively close. The structural load of photovoltaic panels was relatively small, which had little impact on the slope stability. (2) Under the influence of its stiffness, the column of photovoltaic facilities reinforced the soil of the subgrade slope. The deeper the buried depth of the column bottom was, the longer it was embedded in the stable soil layer, and the more obvious the reinforcement effect on the soil of the subgrade slope was. In the design stage, the buried depth of the column bottom should be set reasonably, and the reinforcement effect of the column on the subgrade slope should be made full use of. (3) The shear strength index of subgrade slope soil had a significant impact on slope stability. For the subgrade slope of expressways equipped with photovoltaic power generation facilities, the reduction of soil shear strength index would reduce the slope stability, among which the change in the internal friction angle had the most obvious impact on the slope stability. The setting position should be reasonably selected in the project site selection stage, and the construction method with less disturbance to the subgrade slope should be selected in the design and construction stage, ensuring the stability of the subgrade slope and the operation safety of expressways deployed with photovoltaic power generation facilities.

articleTitle: Study on Stability of shield tunnel excavation face with soft upper and hard lower strata
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Shield method as one of the most commonly used method of tunnel construction at present has been in its economic, efficient, and the advantages of the minimum impact on the environment in tunnel and underground engineering, especially in the soft hard formation, maintain the excavation face stability is the key to shield tunnel construction. Use more physical field coupling analysis software COMSOL Multiphysic in hangzhou some engineering of large diameter shield wear under both the subway before the affected zone, draw a large diameter shield tunnel when compound formation through the surface subsidence value; To judge in urban areas and under the geological conditions of composite shield close down through both the risk and feasibility of the subway, to judge in urban areas and under the geological conditions of composite shield close down through both the risk and feasibility of the subway.

articleTitle: Using Principal Component Analysis to Judge the Response of Measurement while DrillingParameters to Rock Mass Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Measurement while drilling (MWD) can accurately and quickly obtain high-resolution information from the borehole to characterize the highly variable rock encountered during underground engineering excavation. However, the characterization of rock mass characteristics by different MWD parameters does not tend to be consistent, which needs further study. Based on the Xishuangbanna Tunnel Project of Yumo Railway, this paper collected a large number of measurement while drilling data in the tunnel. The MWD parameters are integrated into the first principal component by using the principal component analysis method; the relationship between the first principal component and rock mass characteristics is established and the following conclusions are drawn: (1) For the same drill, the drilling parameters monitored are not independent, but highly correlated. The first principal component analysis method proposed can correctly explain the response of drilling parameters to rocks; (2) In granite formation, when drilling into broken rock mass, the drilling rate will be increased or sharply increased in varying degrees, and the drilling pressure and rotary pressure will be temporarily reduced. The proposed principal component analysis method based on measurement while drilling parameters can realize fast and accurate characterization of rock mass characteristics, providing a design basis for tunnel excavation and support.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization of Foam-Modified Silty Clay Layer Based on Response Surface Methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As the stratum environment of shield tunneling is becoming more complex and rich, more and more technical problems are encountered. In order to determine the optimal foam improvement parameters when excavating in silty clay for a power shield tunnel in Xi'an, a single factor test of foam injection ratio was carried out, and a regression model was established for response surface analysis to investigate the effect of the factor on the response, and the best parameters of sediment improvement were determined. The results show that the optimal silty clay improvement parameters were obtained through response surface methodology optimization: foam injection ratio of 60%, and the theoretical value of slump under the optimal improvement parameters was 118 mm, reaching the optimal fluid plasticity standard. The optimized improved parameters are applied to the shield tunneling construction, the total thrust is reduced by 1221kN, a 12% reduction, and the cutter head torque is reduced by 260kN m, a 20% reduction, and the total thrust of shield and the torque of cutter head are obviously reduced, so that the wear of cutter head is reduced and the construction speed is increased.

articleTitle: Research on the design of artificial lakes based on Mike21 flow field analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Based on the initially determined ecological design scheme of Nianhu lake, the flow field of Nianhu Lake under different schemes of wind-driven flow and huff and puff flow is simulated by using the MIKE 21 flow field analysis model, and the optimal form and water replenishment scheme of Nianhu lake are selected to provide scientific basis and technical support for the ecological design and management of Nianhu lake.

articleTitle: Discussion on Optimization Design of Tunnel Lining Based on Safety Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Considering construction and other factors, the secondary lining of a railway tunnel's arch wall is generally designed with uniform thickness and will not be adjusted to its actual mechanical behavior, resulting in unreasonable structure and other issues. This paper models tunnel lining of nonuniform thickness and discusses the pattern of influence on the lining's safety performance by its nonuniform thickness in a variety of design conditions using the safety coefficient and the numerical method, with an aim to discuss whether the lining's section dimensions are reasonable. The main conclusions are as follows: 1 The bending moment and safety coefficient of the crown are influenced to varying degrees by dimensional change at different parts (crown > haunch > side wall); ® The safety coefficient increases within a certain length range when the crown thickness reduces; 3 The smaller range of adjustment the crown dimension has, the more sensitive is the change in crown safety coefficient, and the more sensitive the safety coefficient is to length change; 4 The crown safety coefficient can be enhanced by about 20% when the crown thickness reduces by 25% within the range of 0.45B and the thickness of haunches and side walls on both sides increases by 12% within the same range of 0.45B, provided the quantity of secondary lining works remains basically unchanged.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of fire-induced smoke spread characteristics in a one-way downhill multiramp urban tunnel
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: A full-scale three-dimensional numerical study of fire-induced smoke spread characteristics in a one-way downhill multiramp urban tunnel in Chongqing is proposed. The effects of the tunnel slope and the fire location on the behavior of smoke spread are analyzed. For all six simulated cases, longitudinal ventilation can efficiently preclude smoke from propagating to the mainline tunnel and upstream of Ramp III. The chimney effect caused by the tunnel slope significantly affects the smoke flow in Ramp I and Ramp II. For Case A and Case D, the smoke spreads upstream of Ramp I, and the visibility in Ramp I decreases. The chimney effect reduces the velocity in the entrance of Ramp I by 74.39% and 144.27%, respectively. For Case B and Case E, the smoke spreads upstream of Ramp II, and the visibility in Ramp II decreases. For Case E, the chimney effect reduces the velocity in the entrance of Ramp II from 0.63 m/s to −0.13 m/s.

articleTitle: Surrounding Rock Stability and Support Structure Safety Analysis of Large Diversion Tunnel in Undesirable Geological Section Based on Hydro-Mechanical Coupling Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, the drainage hole sub-model is introduced to establish the hydro-mechanical coupling analysis method, which is successfully applied to the analysis of seepage field characteristics, surrounding rock stability and support structure safety during the plugging period of the diversion tunnel section with unfavorable geology in a water conservancy project. The results show that the influence of fault zone on the seepage field of rock mass is obvious, specifically, the velocity near the fault zone is large, and concentrated seepage will occur. The drainage hole of the diversion tunnel can effectively reduce the pore water pressure acting on the lining and the surrounding rock near the excavation face. The unloading damage degree of surrounding rock at the fault zone of the diversion tunnel is obvious, and the stress of the anchor bolt is large. The surrounding rock deformation and support stress in the above areas should be monitored.

articleTitle: Research on the Anti-collapse Performance of Steel Frame Structures with Masonry Filler Walls in the Form of Reduced Beam-flange Connections
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Masonry filler walls are widely used in practical buildings. Research shows that they have an important impact on resisting the vertical continuous collapse of the structure. However, in most current design codes, it is only considered as a secondary component or a non-structural component, and its contribution to anti-collapse is ignored. In addition, the application of reduced beam-flange connections is relatively mature at present, and research shows that the structure with reduced beam-flange connections gains an edge in anti-collapse performance, but the anti-collapse performance of steel frame structures with filler walls in the form of reduced beam-flange connections is still uncertain. In order to investigate the anti-continuous collapse performance of steel frame structures with filler walls in the form of reduced and bolted-weld beam-flange connections, this study uses numerical simulation methods to study the advantages of the structure when the middle column is removed, and to explore the impact of span on the anti-collapse performance of the structure. The results show that the bearing capacity and ductility of steel frame structures with filler walls in the form of reduced beam-flange connections are better than those in the form of non-reduced beam-flange connections. In addition, the research results reveal that the contribution of filler walls to the bearing capacity of the structure also decreases with the increase of the span.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Suspended Dam Based on Limit Equilibrium Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Blasting silt squeezing technology is a new soft foundation treatment technology. In recent years, this new technology has played an important role in the construction of water conservancy and tidal power stations in deep silt geological areas. However, the construction of dams for similar projects needs to deal with the thickness of silt soft foundation is gradually deepening. Engineering practice shows that the use of suspended dam structure can save project cost and speed up the progress of the project. Therefore, engineers often use suspended dam structure in deep silt geological areas. The stability analysis of this new type of dam structure has important engineering application value. Taking the bank protection project of an oil depot as an example, the safety factor of the embankment slope formed by blasting compaction is calculated by using the limit equilibrium analysis method, and its overall stability is further judged and analyzed. The conclusions are as follow: (1) It is difficult to accurately calculate the change and dissipation process of pore water pressure in most cases (such as construction period, sudden drop of water level, earthquake.), it is generally recommended to use the total stress method to calculate and analyze the stability of the dam in practical engineering applications. (2) At the same time, the shear strength index of soil mass should be reasonably selected in combination with the actual loading conditions, filler properties and drainage conditions of rock and soil slopes. (3) The safety factor calculated by the traditional Swedish slice method is low. The assumptions of Bishop method and Janbu method are closer to the actual project, and the reliability of the calculation results may be better.

articleTitle: Establishment and Analysis of Energy Consumption Prediction Model of Air Conditioning System in Subway Station
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The energy consumption of subways in the operation process is relatively large. With the continuous development and expansion of China's rail construction, the problem of energy saving has become more and more prominent. The air-conditioning system is a large energy-saving potential in the process of subway operation. It is necessary to optimize the design of the air-conditioning system to find energy-saving and emission reduction measures for subway operation. Therefore, it is a very important research topic to reduce the energy consumption of the system by optimizing the ventilation and air-conditioning design of the subway. In this paper, according to the proportion of energy consumption, the energy consumption prediction model of BP neural network with step of 10 minutes is firstly established, and then the seasonal air conditioning energy consumption prediction model is established. The research results of BP neural network model in this paper provide a reference for the energy saving control of subway stations and provide research mothod for other central air conditioning systems.

articleTitle: Measuring River Discharge Using Projection Reconstruction Vector Method Based on Acoustic Tomography
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Coastal acoustic tomography is a new flow measurement technique that has emerged in recent years, which has the advantages of long observation time and wide range compared with traditional flow measurement methods, as well as the ability to obtain spatially averaged and time-averaged observation data, and has unique advantages in observing river flow. The paper uses acoustic laminar observations of the Yangtze River channel to perform inversion measurements of flow data during the observation period. The observation sites were set up on the north and south banks of a section of the middle reaches of the Yangtze River in Chizhou, and a total of three acoustic tomography observation sites were set up to send and receive acoustic signals from each other. Correlation of the acoustic signals received at each station to obtain the underwater acoustic propagation time between the stations, and the difference between the acoustic signal reciprocal propagation time difference between any two stations by difference calculation. The average flow velocity in the direction of the measurement line between stations is obtained by inversion in combination with the known position relationship between the three stations. By reconstructing the vector method by projecting the flow velocity vector along the flow direction and cross-section of the section, the average flow velocity of the Yangtze River section can be obtained, and then the flow rate of the section can be found. And through the comparison with the single survey line method and the official data of Datong Hydrological Station, it can be concluded that the acoustic tomography based on the projection reconstruction vector method has an error of no more than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> in the cross-sectional flow velocity of the channel, which meets the requirements of hydrological observation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Design Parameters of Anti Slide Pile on Slope Stability
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to study the influence of design parameters of anti slide pile on slope stability, taking a slope as an example, the pile length (anchorage depth), section length, section width and pile spacing of anti slide pile are changed based on FLAC3D, and the influence of these design parameters on slope stability is analyzed. The results show that the safety factor increases with the increase of pile length (anchorage depth), section length and section width, and the increasing trend gradually slows down; The influence of section width on safety factor is more obvious than that of section length. Therefore, in order to increase the safety of the slope, the method of increasing the section width is more economical and effective than the method of increasing the section length. The safety factor increases with the decrease of pile spacing, and the variation range gradually decreases. However, the increase of pile length (anchoring depth), section length, section width, and the reduction of pile spacing mean more project investment and greater construction difficulty. Therefore, when using anti slide piles to reinforce the slope, comprehensive consideration should be given. It provides a certain technical support for the design of anti slide pile.

articleTitle: Surface Settlement and Discrete Element Analysis of Shields Through Water-Rich Sand and Cobble Strata
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: At present, the shield method is a commonly used construction method in underground engineering construction. During the shield construction of two-way parallel tunnels, there will be mutual influence between the tunnels. In this paper, taking Xi'an Metro Line 6 as an example, combined with relevant stratigraphic data, the discrete element software (MatDEM) is used to simulate the sand and gravel stratum under the shield tunnel, and the influence of uneven surface loads on the surface settlement of the sand and gravel stratum tunnel is studied. Studies have shown that single sand and pebble formations have higher stress values but less surface settlement, while mixed clay-sand and pebble formations have significantly higher surface settlement, with vertical settlement increasing and then decreasing with depth of burial.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Influence of Adding Rubber Powder on Strength Characteristics of Remoulded Loess
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The backfill loess of a construction site in Sanmenxia, Henan Province was remoulded by adding a certain proportion of rubber powder in the remoulding process. Through a series of static triaxial consolidated undrained (CU) shear tests on saturated remoulded loess samples containing rubber powder, the stress-strain relationship, shear strength line and strength parameters were obtained. Through the experimental results, it is found that the strength of remoulded loess can be improved by adding rubber powder under larger confining pressure, and the strength improvement is not obvious under smaller confining pressure. However, the strength parameters change obviously with the amount of rubber powder, the cohesion decreases with the amount of rubber powder, and the internal friction angle increases linearly with the amount of rubber powder. In addition, it is found that the shear rate of CU test has a certain influence on the strength parameters. With the increase of shear rate, the cohesion first increases and then decreases. The internal friction angle decreases gradually. Compared with the sample mixed with rubber powder, the strength parameters of the sample without rubber powder are more sensitive to the shear rate, that is, the addition of rubber powder also reduces the sensitivity of loess shear strength to the shear rate.

articleTitle: Study on The Influence of Air Distribution Form in Data Center Room on Thermal Environme
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The form of air conditioning affects the energy consumption and thermal environment of the data center. Taking a data center in Guangzhou as the research object, this paper uses CFD method to simulate three kinds of air conditioning forms: underfloor air conditioning, inter-row air conditioning and backplane air conditioning, analyzes the temperature field, flow field and the maximum inlet air temperature of the cabinet, and compares the characteristics and application effects of each air conditioning form. And the upper limit of the power of the single cabinet which can be borne by the backplane air conditioning scheme is studied. The following conclusions were drawn: 1) Under the underfloor air conditioning scheme, the thermal environment of the computer room is the worst, and the maximum inlet air temperature of the cabinet is 33.4°C. 2) Under the backplane air conditioning scheme, the overall cooling effect of the computer room is the best, and the maximum inlet air temperature of the cabinet is 23.4S°C. 3) Under the backplane air conditioning scheme, the average inlet air temperature of the cabinet increases by about 0.46°C with each increase of 1kW. 4) The upper limit of the power of the backplane air conditioner is 18kW.

articleTitle: Construction Progress Monitoring for High-Rise Building Groups using Digital Surface Model and Orthophoto
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Construction progress monitoring is important for the construction management of high-rise building groups. The traditional manually acquiring the construction progress of each individual building is inefficient and error-prone. Nowadays, automated image-based progress monitoring methods play a good role in obtaining progress on site. The construction progress of high-rise buildings is highly related to the height, which the image 3D reconstruction production, Digital Surface Model (DSM) is good at reflecting the elevation information of the landscape. Based on DSM and the corresponding orthophoto obtained from VAV aerial photos, this paper proposes a 2.5D as-planned model containing the plan layout and altitude list of the floor slabs, and uses the Peak position of the histogram of the Altitude in DSM (shorted as ‘PADSM’) of each individual building to identify the floor-level construction progress and use orthophoto to extract the appearance of the floor working plane to reflect the operative-level progress for each individual building. This paper also analyzes the patterns of DSM histogram peaks for individual buildings under different construction states. The results indicate that the method proposed in this paper is effective and significantly helpful for automated schedule monitoring and project management for high-rise building groups.

articleTitle: Study on Flow Control Countermeasures of Three-dimensional Cylinder around Offshore Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The Karman vortex street problem in fluid coupled with the natural frequency of the bridge structure will resonate and cause damage. Therefore, the phenomenon of Karman vortex street is an important factor that can't be ignored in the building structure, and it must be considered in the construction of offshore platforms with more columns. Mechanics is a very important problem in fluid mechanics. In some cases, when the fluid resistance bypasses an object, the two sides of the object will periodically shed double-row linear vortices with the same arrangement and movement mode, which will lead to the Karman vortex street problem <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Circular flow is a common way to produce Karman vortex street. Circular flow has important applications in many aspects of engineering, such as ocean engineering. Studying the flow around a cylinder is very important for improving the structural layout of offshore platforms <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. In this paper, the phenomenon of Karman vortex street, which is common in ocean engineering, is explored by CFD method, and the phenomenon of Karman vortex street caused by circular cylinder flow in ocean environment is studied by some projects in ANSYA software, so as to find a model with better vortex suppression effect.

articleTitle: Seismic Response of Large-diameter Tunnel Crossing the Interface of Ground Layers
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: For alluvial deposits, tunnels are often encountered with the interface of ground layers. The seismic performance of such tunnels may be challenged by the abrupt change of the stiffness of ground layers. This paper presents a series of numerical studies on the seismic performance of a large-diameter tunnel in soft alluvial deposits, encountered with the interface of ground layers. The nonlinear finite element analysis is carried out. The complex distribution patterns of the inner forces and deformation of the tunnel are found to be related to the interaction between the tunnel and the interface of soil layers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cross-section Area of Tunnel Clearance Above Rail Surface for Railways in Plateau Regions Based on One-dimensional Flow Model and Numerical Iterative Solution Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: This paper is intended to figure out the cross-section area of tunnel clearance above rail surface for single-track railways in plateau regions. All dimensional relationships are derived by applying the one-dimensional compressible unsteady non-homentropic flow model and generalized Riemann variable characteristic line method, and the equations are iteratively solved by using a numerical method to generate pressure fluctuation in the tunnels on the 160 km/h single-track railways in plateau regions. The economical and technically reasonable cross-section area of tunnel clearance is finally determined based on the comfort indexes. Based on the study results, in order to overcome the great impacts on the physical and mental health of passengers in the plateau environment and improve the operation and service level of railways in plateau regions, it is necessary to improve the vehicle tightness and apply the comprehensive transient pressure index stipulated in UIC 660 as the recommended index for railway construction in plateau regions. The requirements are concluded for the critical cross-section area of tunnel clearance above rail surface and the vehicle tightness index for 160 km/h single-track railways from calculation and analysis.

articleTitle: Research on BIM Design System of Railway Tunnel Based on Microstation
