publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Tunnel is one of the important components of railway engineering. In order to solve the problems of large manual design workload, low accuracy of model assembly along the line, cumbersome layout and cutting of auxiliary caverns, inconsistent model attributes and coding in the process of tunnel BIM design, the railway tunnel BIM design system was developed on the platform. By analyzing the geometric characteristics and topological relationship of the railway tunnel section profile, the mathematical model of the inner profile of the tunnel is extracted, and the constraint relationship and mathematical expression between the geometric parameters of the inner profile of the tunnel are established, and the parametric design of the tunnel section is realized. Model positioning code and section attribute set mounting, model assembly along the line based on 3D coordinates of the line, auxiliary cave layout and automatic cutting and other functions are also realized. The practical application shows that the technical scheme of the tunnel BIM design system is feasible and the functional design is reasonable, which can meet the needs of professional BIM design of tunnels, and can effectively improve the standardization and efficiency of tunnel BIM modeling.

articleTitle: Study on Construction Method and Supporting Structure Optimization of Separated Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Taking a separated tunnel as the study background, the combination of field monitoring and numerical simulation is used to optimize the construction method and supporting structure of separated tunnels, and the vault subsidence, surface subsidence and surrounding rock displacement of the tunnel are analyzed. The results show that the proposed optimization scheme is reasonable, the optimized construction method can greatly simplify the construction, and the construction control effect of the optimized support structure scheme is good. The research results can not only provide optimization construction organization design service for Tunnel X, ensure the safety and quality of tunnel construction, but also provide experience reference for similar projects in the future.

articleTitle: Study on Reasonable Support Form of Goaf Excavation Roadway in Deep Inclined Coal Seam
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of changing the supporting parameters for many times in the roadway driving process of deep inclined coal seam, this paper combined with the actual situation of Fucheng Coal mine and the roadway deformation of 1903N return wind roadway was relatively serious in the roadway driving process due to the influence of 1902 mining. The form of support is difficult and ordinary forms of support cannot play an effective role. The problems of roadway deformation and bolt support in the roadway driving along goaf under the strong influence of mining were comprehensively analyzed. Finally, extended bolt + anchor cable grout support can effectively reduce the amount of roadway deformation, which effectively strengthens the stability of inclined coal seam roadway driving and provides a guarantee for the safety of coal mine production.

articleTitle: Detection of Landslide Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Human activities are one of the main causes of geological disasters. From the perspective of visual observation, the degree of environmental damage can be reflected by detecting the exposed area of vegetation in the image along the road. In order to verify the applicability of the deep learning method in the detection of landslide, the EfficientDet model is applied to objects detection. This objects detection model is based on convolutional neural networks. A data set of landslide is established. The training samples are marked by labelme software. The object detection of landslide is carried out by EfficientDet model. The result of Precision, Recall, F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,</inf> AP, Average training time of each epoch (s) and FPS are 0.8158, 0.3240, 0.46, 0.5132, 27.17s, 12.2, respectively. The method can detect landslide objects well.

articleTitle: Construction structure and mechanical response of surrounding rock of composite stratum tunnel based on numerical simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: To ensure the safe construction of the tunnel through the fault composite stratum, relying on a domestic tunnel project, taking the surrounding rock of the tunnel in the fault zone as the research object, the three-dimensional tunnel model is established by the finite element software and combined with the on-site electronic equipment monitoring, and the mechanical response law of the tunnel structure and surrounding rock is studied. The numerical results show that the deformation laws of tunnel crown and arch waist in normal stratum and fault zone are the same. The overall deformation value of tunnel in fault section is greater than that in normal section, and the maximum deformation value appears at the rock stratum interface, which is 9.04mm and 3.49mm respectively; The tunnel uplift value is smaller at the interface than at both sides, and the maximum value appears in the fault section, which is 7.42mm; The surrounding rock within one time of tunnel excavation diameter is affected, and the deformation gradually increases from the depth of rock stratum to the vault. The existence of broken rock mass in fault zone will aggravate the deformation within this range. The maximum stress value of tunnel lining is 17.5MPa at the arch waist, 11.0MPa at the arch crown and 7.69Mpa at the arch bottom, all of which occur at the junction of fault zone and normal section rock stratum. The stress of arch crown and arch bottom lining decreases sharply from the interface along both sides, while the trend of arch waist decrease is relatively slow. The maximum lining pressure in the normal section appears at the arch waist, the maximum pressure in the fault zone appears between the arch waist and the arch shoulder, and the minimum lining pressure in both sections appears at the arch bottom. The field monitoring data show that the tunnel deformation gradually tends to be flat with time. The final change value is 0.6mm after 16 days, and no obvious deformation is detected after 24 days. The final monitoring results are consistent with the numerical simulation data. The research results provide a reference for the construction of similar composite stratum tunnels.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Influence of Ultra-deep Foundation on Groundwater Seepage Field Based on Unsaturated Flow
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The anti-floating water level of ultra-deep foundation is affected not only by the geological conditions of water level, but also by the foundation itself. In this paper, unsaturated seepage numerical simulation is used to evaluate the influence of typical ultra-deep foundation on groundwater seepage field in Guiyang. The results show that the construction of the foundation blocks the flow of groundwater, resulting in changes in the local seepage field. The water level in the upstream of the foundation rises, while it in the downstream of the foundation decreases. The maximum rise of the water level exceeds 1 m, while the maximum decrease exceeds 0.4 m. The time of foundation influence on seepage is up to 3 years, and the first 120 days are the great influence period. The pattern of water level change is controlled by the shape of the foundation plane. Sensitivity analysis shows that permeability and hydraulic gradient have important influence on the results. Therefore, when evaluating the anti-floating water level of foundation, not only the dynamic characteristics of groundwater itself, but also the impact of foundation construction should be considered.

articleTitle: A FLOW-3D-Based Numerical Simulation of the Energy Dissipation Characteristics of Pooled Stepped Spillways
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As a new type of spillway, pooled stepped spillways deliver better energy dissipation than traditional stepped spillways. However, there are few studies on how incoming flow affects energy dissipation with different pool heights. This paper used the FLOW-3D software, in a combination of the VOF method and the RNG k-ε turbulence model, to conduct a numerical simulation for stepped spillways with pools with a height of 2 cm, 4 cm, and 6 cm under five different operating conditions, including a flow rate of 100 L/s, 131 L/s, 165 L/s, 202 L/s, and 241 L/s. The results showed that at each flow rate, the turbulent energy at the midpoint of each step of the pooled stepped spillway decreases with the increase of the pool height. Additionally, with the same pool height, the turbulent dissipation rate increases with the flow rate, while the energy dissipation rate decreases with the flow rate increase.

articleTitle: Detection of the Embankment Slope Formed by the Mixed Fill of Coal and Soil by GPR
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: [Purpose] The slope formed by the mixed fill of coal and soil is prone to disease problems such as unconsolidated and hollowness because of particle loss. High-frequency GPR can easily detect the relevant diseases near the surface and make targeted treatments. [Methods] Based on the theoretical study of the propagation mechanism of GPR electromagnetic waves in multiple geological layers and the numerical method of the FDTD method, the layered geoelectrical model of the high embankment system is established. Reflection amplitude and electric field intensity of GPR wave in multilayer embankment are deduced. [Results] The change of electrical parameters in the stratum inevitably causes the change of echo characteristics. With the increase of relative permittivity in the stratum, the amplitude of GPR echoes increases significantly. While the amplitude of echoes does not increase significantly with the increase of conductivity in the stratum in a certain range. [Conclusion] The above conclusions make an important guiding significance for the detection of the slope formed by the mixed fill of coal and soil.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Waterproof Construction Risk of Subway Station Based on Analytic Network Process
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to explore the mechanism of water leakage in subway stations, improve water seepage in subway stations, and build a scientific and effective waterproof system, a risk evaluation model of subway station waterproof construction was established on the basis of risk identification and in combination with the Analytic Network Process (ANP) and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Besides, a subway station project in Zhengzhou was taken as an example to analyze the causes of water seepage in subway stations and summarize the characteristics of water seepage in urban subway stations. Risk evaluation was performed on the waterproof construction system of subway stations and some suggestions on waterproof construction control and plugging were put forward. The results showed that this model can be used to accurately evaluate waterproof construction projects of urban subways and provide a scientific and reasonable research method for the risk assessment of water leakage in urban underground space.

articleTitle: Application of SSP Seismic Scattering and Geological Radar in Foundation and Subsurface Obstacle Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the continuous development of urban construction, in order to ensure the smooth progress of the construction process, it is usually necessary to treat the foundation, so it is necessary to test the mechanical properties and lithology of the foundation strata and underground obstacles. In this paper, SSP seismic scattering technology and geological radar method are used to detect the foundation of the starting well of the Comprehensive pipe gallery project in Chengbei Road, Suzhou City. SSP seismic scattering technology comprehensively utilizes reflection and scattering seismic data to perform fine imaging of geology, which can be used as a basis for judging the mechanical properties of geotechnical media. It can identify difficult geological objects such as karst, boulder, grouting and goaf. The geological radar can comprehensively scan the underground obstacle target, obtain the vertical two-dimensional section image of the cross section, and judge the actual structure of the underground target. Both detection methods have advantages, and depending on the situation, the appropriate detection method can be chosen.

articleTitle: Vibration Characteristics of Crude Oil Pipeline Considering Fluid-solid Coupling Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: To find out the influence mechanism of fluid-solid coupling effect on the vibration characteristics of crude oil pipeline and improve the calculation speed of fluid-solid coupling method for solving the dynamic problems of oil pipeline, a finite element calculation theory and method based on the coupling of crude oil fluid sound field and pipeline solid field are proposed. Taking the crude oil pipeline as the research object, the dynamic finite element calculation model structure based on the acoustic-solid coupling method is established, and the pipeline as the physical field and the crude oil as the calculation parameters of the acoustic field are determined. The simulation analysis of 11 working conditions under different pipeline lengths is carried out, and the first six natural frequencies and vibration modes of the acoustic-solid coupling finite element model structure are obtained, and the results are compared with those of the traditional fluid-solid coupling calculation. The research shows that the sound-solid coupling method can ensure the correctness of the calculation results by solving the dynamic characteristics of the crude oil pipeline considering the fluid-solid coupling effect. Compared with the traditional calculation method of fluid-solid coupling, the calculation speed is greatly improved, and the occupation of computer memory is reduced.

articleTitle: Seismic Responses Analysis of PHC Pile Under Near-fault Pulse-like Ground Motions
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: To investigate the seismic performance of prestressed high-strength concrete pipe pile (PHC pile) under the effect of near-fault pulse-like ground motions, a three-dimensional dynamic nonlinear finite element model of PHC pile embedded in soft soil foundation is constructed for the dynamic time history analysis. Three different near-fault pulse-like ground motions selected from the NGA-West2 database were input into the PHC pile model. The time histories of acceleration, shear force and bending moment of the PHC pile under different ground motions are presented in present study to illustrate the effect of different ground motions on the seismic responses of PHC pile. The results indicate that the record-to-record variability of seismic ground motions has great effect on the seismic responses of pile and it is necessary to resort to the probabilistic methods to consider the effect of randomness of ground motion on the seismic performance of PHC piles.

articleTitle: Application of Building Information Model Technology in Hydraulic Engineering Design of Steel Gate
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Traditional steel gates are often designed separately in the gate design stage, hydraulic engineering design and reinforcement stage, analysis stage, detailed drawing stage and construction process, which not only results in loss of data information, but also requires repeated input of information or rebuilding of the model at various stages. Therefore, the use of BIM technology in the design of steel-gate water conservancy projects is of great significance. As a new model technology with high intuitiveness and operability, BIM technology is gradually applied in the whole process of hydraulic engineering design. In this regard, combined with the application example of the BIM software platform, this paper analyzes the key information points from the design stage to the construction drawing stage of steel-gate water conservancy projects and verifies the feasibility and validity of BIM technology. The conclusion shows that: BIM can not only avoid such drawbacks as loss of data information, repeated input of information at each stage and increased workload due to rebuilding the model in the process of gate design, design and reinforcement of hydraulic foundation buildings, detailed drawings and separate design of construction stages in the traditional steel-gate water conservancy projects, but also fully possess the technical characteristics of 3D visualization, parameter correlation and traceability, information sharing, predictability of conflicts, and drawing ability, optimizing the whole design process of the steel-gate water conservancy projects.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study on Sediment Effect of Bored Pile Tip
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Based on the PLAXIS3D finite element numerical method, a finite element numerical model of pile soil interaction of bored cast-in-situ single pile with pile tip sediment is established. Taking the thickness and modulus of sediment at the pile tip as variables, the variation law of bearing characteristics of common bored cast-in-situ friction pile foundation affected by pile tip sediment is quantitatively analyzed from the aspects of load settlement relationship, pile shaft compression, load sharing ratio, etc. The research results show that the thickness and modulus of the sediment have a significant impact on the bearing capacity of the pile foundation. The thicker the sediment at the pile end, or the lower the sediment modulus, the lower the stiffness of the pile end soil. The smaller the stiffness of pile end soil, the lower the bearing capacity, and the lower the ultimate bearing capacity of pile foundation. In practical projects, it is advisable to improve and ensure the bearing capacity of bored piles by improving the efficiency of slag removal, reducing the thickness of sediment, and improving the mechanical properties of sediment at the pile tip.

articleTitle: Hydrodynamic Characteristics of Shallow Groundwater in River Banks and Shoals Under Rainfall
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Taking a riverbank beach in Shanxi, the middle reaches of Cao'e jiang River, as the research object, according to the characteristics of water level fluctuation caused by rainfall confluence, simultaneously monitor the change process of water level and temperature in the riverbank beach, analyze the process of water level fluctuation, calculate the lateral subsurface flow exchange volume of the riverbank beach, and establish the response relationship between the lateral unit width subsurface flow exchange volume and the river water level. The results show that under the action of rainfall, the shallow groundwater level in the riverbank beach fluctuates frequently, and the lag effect of the water level fluctuation in the far water end is obvious, the amplitude of the water level fluctuation is weak, and the phase lags behind; From the river bank to the river direction, the total volume of water exchanged by # 1 and # 0, # 2 and # 1, # 3 and # 2 per unit width is 1.28 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, 0.37 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and 0.10 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> respectively. The far water end is recharged by rainfall infiltration, and the total volume of water exchanged by # 4 and # 3 per unit width is 1.87 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>; The beach is supplemented by transverse inflow, and the exchange volume of unit width subsurface flow between the shallow groundwater and the river channel and the river water level show a clear counterclockwise “rope sleeve relationship”.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Segmented Countermeasures for Metro Tunnels Intersecting Ground Fissure Zones at Small Angles
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Ground fissure is a unique geological disaster in Xi'an, China. It is stretched over 150km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Severe damages to infrastructures and facilities are encountered in reality due to the dislocation from ground fissure. When web-distributed metro lines are constructed, the tunnel lining will be inevitable undermined. In this paper, the engineering practice of Xi'an Metro Line 3 intersecting ground fissure zones at small angles has been evaluated. Numerical methods were used to study two setting schemes of deformation joints and the effect of ground fissures on the service performance of tunnel lining. The results show that the riding-type scheme reduces the range of axial tension on tunnel lining to a certain extent. The ground fissures in the jointing-type scheme significantly influence the tunnel lining located in the hanging wall, and the axial tension on tunnel lining appears only in the location closer to the hanging wall. When the tunnel intersects the ground fissure section at small angles, it is better to employ the jointing-type of joints-setting scheme.

articleTitle: Numerical Research on Temporal and Spatial Evolution Law of Debris Flow Impact Force Based on in-situ Model
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Debris flow is a huge hazard to downstream lives and property, which must be controlled by engineering. The construction of gravity sand retaining dams (hereinafter referred to as sand retaining dams) from the formation area to the circulation area is one of the quick and effective measures. Prevention and control projects often play a role in controlling the development trend of debris flow and reducing the size and frequency of debris flow. Debris flow will cause erosion and impact damage to the dam foundation of sand retaining dams. For the debris flow impact force, the most dangerous part is usually designed based on the largest impact force, while all parts of the dam body are designed according to the most dangerous part, which wastes materials. It's not economical. In this study, a debris flow gully is selected as the research model. Considering the interaction between debris flow and sand retaining dam, the impact simulation of debris flow on sand retaining dam was carried out. The research results show that the existence of the sand retaining dam hinders the movement process of debris flow, changes its speed and direction of movement, and in addition, the impact force varies at different places of upstream face of sand retaining dam. Research results provide a scientific and reasonable theoretical basis and design reference for the stability of sand retaining dam under debris flow impact impact. This will, to a certain extent, have important social needs and practical significance for disaster reduction to improve the technical level of debris flow prevention projects.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influence of pouring thickness on temperature stress during the construction of arch dam
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, the temperature field and stress field of a certain high RCC arch dam block at different pouring thickness during construction and operation were calculated and analyzed, and the influence of different pouring thickness on stress and safety coefficient was obtained. According to the results, in the case of the concrete poured in autumn and winter, the highest temperature at the middle of working surface is 25.53°C for the 1.5 m-thick warehouse layer, 27.13°C for the 3.0 m-thick warehouse layer, and 27.58°C for the 4.5 m-thick warehouse layer, respectively because of the relatively low outside temperature. In terms of the maximum stress and safety coefficient, they are 1.83 MPa and 1.99 in the 1.5 m-thick warehouse layer, 2.17 MPa and 1.68 in the 3.0 m-thick warehouse layer, and 2.19 MPa and 1.66 in the 4.5 m-thick warehouse layer. Therefore, it is recommended that the 3.0 m-thick warehouse layer shall be adopted in foundation constraint areas.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis of rainfall infiltration slopes considering spatial variability of material parameters
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The material parameters of soils have spatial variability. The covariance matrix decomposition method is used to discretize the random field to simulate the spatial variability of the soil, and the analysis of the influence of the spatial variability of the material parameters on the reliability of the slope helps to accurately judge the stability of the slope. Based on the strength reduction method and Monte Carlo method, the safety coefficient of each random field is determined and the reliability index of rainfall infiltration slope considering spatial variability is calculated. The results show that after considering the spatial variability of shear strength parameters, the slope reliability index becomes smaller and gradually decreases with the increase of soil correlation; compared with the horizontal correlation distance, the change of vertical correlation distance has a more obvious effect on the rainfall slope reliability index; the slope reliability index decreases with the increase of the coefficient of variation of shear strength parameters, and the effect of the coefficient of variation of internal friction angle is greater.

Author Keywords: Spatial variability; Rainfall infiltration; Covariance decomposition

articleTitle: Study on dynamic response of shield tunneling under existing railway subgrade
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Taking the shield tunnel of Qingdao Metro Line 2 underpassing Jiaoji Railway as the engineering background, a three-dimensional numerical calculation model of track system-sub grade-foundation is established by using finite element software to study the dynamic response law of shield underpassing existing railway subgrade under the action of train moving load. The influence of different shield tunneling speed on subgrade acceleration is analyzed. The results show that under the influence of shield tunneling disturbance, the decrease of shield tunneling speed has a significant effect on the decrease of subgrade acceleration peak. When the train enters, the sub grade acceleration is greatly affected by the train, but the influence of shield tunneling speed reduction on the subgrade acceleration is still significant. The change of shield tunneling speed mainly affects the 5–10 Hz frequency domain but has little effect on the middle and high frequency domain. The research results can provide reference for intelligent shield tunneling.

articleTitle: Analysis of Integrated Water Resources Scheduling System in the Yellow River Basin Based on Fuzzy Cluster Cyclic Iteration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Combining with the economic development, ecological environment condition and water resources development and utilization status of the Yellow River, the paper established comprehensive evaluation index system of the economic development-ecological environment-water resources scheduling of the Yellow River basin in 2019. Using fuzzy cluster cyclic iteration algorithm, the coordinated development of integrated water resources system in the Yellow River basin was evaluated. The method could be used to rank the evaluation results and get different coordination degree classification of the Yellow River basin, which could evaluate the degree of water resources optimal allocation.

articleTitle: Study on Steel-concrete Composite Structure Push-out Tests Considering the Interfacial Slip Behavior
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The shear capacities and shear stiffnesses of shear connections in steel-concrete composite structures were generally obtained through push-out test. However, push-out tests are time-consuming and the experimental results could be influenced by many factors. Numerical simulation method could be an efficient alternative to push-out experiment. In this study, the interface between the concrete slab and the flange of the steel beam, and the interface between the shear studs and the surrounding concretes were simulated and analyzed. The complex interfacial behavior between concrete slab and steel beam was simulated with a multiple broken line mode cohesive zone model. Then cohesive interface element was implemented through the user subroutine available in the ABAQUS software. A three-dimensional finite element model with the cohesive elements included was developed for push-out test. The load-displacement relationships, interfacial slips, and shear stress distributions were analyzed. Results indicated that tangential slips of the interface between concrete and steel parts have characteristics of uneven distribution. The proposed method could be used for the calculation of the shear capacity and shear stiffness of shear studs. The nonlinear mechanical interfacial behavior between steel and concrete materials could be successfully simulated and analyzed with the proposed cohesive zone model.

articleTitle: Acoustic Characteristics and Damage Fracture Mechanism of Fractured Tunnel Surrounding Rock Affected by Groundwater
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Under the influence of groundwater, the surrounding rock of the tunnel with cracks has a significant deterioration effect, which is easy to cause the instability and damage of underground projects. Uniaxial compression and acoustic emission tests were carried out on dry and saturated limestone specimens under different osmotic pressures. From the perspective of water rock coupling, the peak strength, characteristic stress, failure characteristics, acoustic emission characteristics and the deterioration mechanism of seepage water were analyzed. Taking mode I open crack as the research object, the influence of seepage pressure, fracture rock parameters (fracture dip, Poisson's ratio, fracture length) on the tip plastic zone growth is analyzed by using D-P yield criterion. The results show that water bearing state and osmotic pressure have little influence on fracture form, but have obvious influence on macro fracture development. With the increase of osmotic pressure and internal friction angle, the radius of plastic zone also increased significantly. The increase of Poisson's ratio will reduce the radius of plastic zone.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of the Impact of Shield Tunnel Operation on the Vibration of Hangzhou Ancient White Pagoda
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The impact of shield tunnels on neighboring buildings during construction has received more attention, while the impact of tunnels on neighboring buildings during operation has been little studied. However, in order to guarantee the safety of the architectures, the influence on adjacent ancient architectures which are sensitive to vibration and displacement should not be neglected during tunnel operation period. In this paper, numerical simulation is used to study whether the vibration and displacement of the adjacent ancient pagoda, Hangzhou White Pagoda, meet the safety control standards during the operation of the shield tunnel. According to the Finite Element Method analysis, judgment on safety of White Pagoda was made. The results of numerical simulation showed that the tunnel operation had a low impact on the adjacent White Pagoda.

articleTitle: Research on the Life Evaluation Method of the Miter Gate Based on Time-varying Reliability and Stochastic Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The miter gate of the ship lock will be corroded in the service process, which will cause the structural resistance degradation and affect the safe operation of the gate. It is of great significance for the long-term safe operation of the ship lock project to reasonably evaluate the impact of corrosion on the life of the gate. The main beam is the main bearing component of the miter gate, and its service life directly determines the life of the entire gate. In this paper, an evaluation method for the service life of miter gates is proposed, which combines the stochastic finite element method, the time-varying reliability analysis method and the standard evaluation criteria. Taking the miter gate of a ship lock as an example, the above method is used to evaluate the service life of the miter gate. The results show that the reliability index of the structure decreases linearly after a certain service life, and the remaining life is 32 years. The correctness and feasibility of this method are verified by the life evaluation formula. This method can more accurately evaluate the life of the gate as a whole, making up for the limitations of existing formulas in the life evaluation of complex integral structures.

articleTitle: Impact Assessment of Side Surface Surcharge on Subway Tunnel Structure in The Protection Area
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The surface surcharge in the rail transit protection area, especially in the special protection area, may lead to various degrees of diseases in the rail transit structure, which may even threaten the traffic safety. During the line inspection in an urban rail transit protection area, 291m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of soil was found on the ground 2.1m away from the outer boundary line of the tunnel uplink structure. In order to evaluate the impact of surface surcharge on the safety of the tunnel structure, a three-dimensional analysis model was established using finite element analysis software to reproduce the surface surcharge process. The results show that the strong influence range of lateral surface surcharge on the tunnel is the projection length range of surface surcharge in the longitudinal direction of the tunnel. The horizontal displacement, vertical displacement and convergence deformation of the tunnel caused by surface surcharge are all within the control range of the specification, and the stress of reinforcement is far less than the yield strength of reinforcement, and the stress of bolt is less than the yield strength of bolt, so the structure is safe. It can provide reference for other similar projects.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis Regarding Underground Cavern Group of Songyang Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: This paper has analyzed the stability of the underground caverns of the Songyang pumped storage power station with FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup>. Firstly, the initial stress of the model is calculated through a two-dimensional hydraulic fracturing stress test, which displayed the maximum principal stress as 17.7~19.4 MPa with the direction of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{N}70^{\circ}$</tex> E. Secondly, different spaces between caverns have been analyzed, and a spacing of 40 m has been selected with the nearly same stability effect as 45m. Then, the excavation response of not supported caverns has been simulated, which illustrates that the general deformation of caverns is 17~98.5mm. And the maximum deformation occurs in the upstream side wall. The maximum depth of the plastic zone is nearly 15m and the maximum principal stress is near 36 MPa, which may cause medium rock stress problems. Finally, two different support conditions have been compared and evaluated. The stress of the rock bolts in support scheme 2 is about 52.6% in the range of 50~300MPa, while the stress of the bolt in support scheme 1 is about 48% in this range, indicating that the bearing performance of the bolt in support scheme 2 is better. Overall, this paper suggests a cavern rock pillar of 40m, and support case 2 with longer rock bolts in the Songyang project.

articleTitle: Calculation of Reinforced Concrete Lining of Tunnel Based on Semi-Infinite Space Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In the original design, the crossing section of Damaowu branch tunnel and main tunnel of Xianlin Reservoir was designed with large section reinforced concrete lining structure. In order to save investment and speed up the project progress, it is proposed to adopt the construction of small section reinforced concrete lining with three sides constrained by surrounding rock and one side empty. Therefore, structural mechanics method and finite element method are used to analyze the optimized lining section, and the feasibility of the scheme is verified.

articleTitle: The Application of Computer Simulation in Municipal Feedwater and Sewerage
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The increasing level of urbanization, the expansion of city scale and the increasing complexity of city functions make the design and management of municipal water supply and drainage system face more and more pressure and challenges. At present, the water supply and drainage system of most cities can only meet the basic water supply and drainage needs of the city, and it is difficult to play more functions and values when facing the role of natural disasters and emergencies represented by heavy rainfall and floods. In addition, the traditional design of municipal water supply and drainage system is relatively old, which is not well adapted to the development of intelligent city development. Based on this, this paper designs the municipal drainage system relying on computer technology, and carries out the informationization and integration design for the subsystems and modules of rainwater pipe network, sewage pipe network and water supply pipe network in the municipal water supply and drainage system. Through detailed analysis of the design content of municipal water supply and drainage projects, this paper uses computer simulation to calculate the municipal pipe network and derive accurate pipe slope data, thus greatly enhancing the efficiency of the municipal pipe network and improving the rationality of the pipe network arrangement.

articleTitle: Investigation on Shield-Rock Interaction Under The High-Stress Condition
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Mechanized excavation via tunnel boring machines (TBMs) could contribute to significantly reducing construction time and costs. However, problems stemming from extreme geological conditions can cause a variety of issues, such as the potential of TBM jamming. Based on the time-dependent behavior of silty mudstone, the present work focuses on investigating the complex interaction between the surrounding rock and the tunnel machinery. A case study was also discussed that provides a theoretical basis for planning the actual project excavation along the tunnel. Comprehensive theoretical calculation methods are used to determine the radius of the plastic zone, the maximum total thrust of the non-jammed TBM, and the convergent deformation. To avoid jamming the TBM, the rated thrust of the TBM should be greater than the maximum total thrust force experienced by the auxiliary thrust cylinders, and the convergence deformation of surrounding rock should also be less than the expected deformation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Slope Excavation Deformation and Stability Under Different Excavation Stages
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The excavation stage of slope is a common consideration in the actual project, which has a certain impact on the stability and deformation of the slope. Based on this, taking the soil-rock dual slope of a highway in Guizhou as the research background, the finite difference method is applied to simulate the whole process of slope excavation and the validity of the numerical simulation is verified by comparing with the field monitoring data. The influence of excavation stages on slope displacement field and stability factor of safety is further discussed. The results show that increasing the number of stages can effectively improve the stability and reduce the displacement value during slope excavation. However, after the excavation is completed, there is no significant difference in the stability and displacement of the slope under different excavation stages. It is recommended to increase the number of excavation stages reasonably and appropriately when excavating slopes to ensure excavation stability and reduce the amount of displacement. The relevant research can provide a useful reference for the construction stability analysis, monitoring and design of similar slope projects.

articleTitle: Influencing Factors and Optimization Design of Cement Fly-Ash Gravel Pile
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: CFG pile composite foundation treatment technology is one of the most commonly used foundation reinforcement technology. Its parameter design usually adopts the trial algorithm. Under the premise of meeting the design requirements, there are many combinations of different parameters, and it is difficult to find the most economical design scheme. By analyzing the design parameters of CFG pile composite foundation, the main influencing factors of the reinforcement effect are pointed out. With the pile length, pile diameter and pile spacing as optimization variables, the main design parameters of CFG pile composite foundation are optimized by using Matlab optimization toolbox under the premise of meeting the design requirements of composite foundation and aiming at the minimum pile engineering cost. The method is applied to a practical project, and the results show that the optimization method is effective, which can reduce the cost and improve the economic benefit under the premise of meeting the requirements of the code.

articleTitle: Data Analysis of Water Supply Demand and Study on Scale of Water Transfer Project in Xiong'an New Area
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Water security is essential to social and economic development. As society has developed, the need for safe and stable water sources for life and production has increased. In this paper, we analyze the water demand of Xiong'an New Area and propose to construct a storage reservoir based on the Central Program of the South-North Water Transfer Project and local water resources. The purpose is to ensure a long-term and stable water supply to the new area. The storage reservoir is expected to offer emergency water supply, water transmission during the ice age, and basic water supply. Data processing models are used to simulate long-sequence water supply configurations and to determine the size of the construction project. The research results provide elements of reference for expanding water transfer projects and tapping local water resources along the water transfer route.

articleTitle: Primary Exploration on the Difference of the Automatic Picked P-Wave Onset between Three-Component Seismic Records
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The determination of P-wave onset is important in built of seismic ground motion database for the construction of ground motion prediction equation, seismic site effect model, response spectra for the earthquake-resistant design and et al. Various P-wave onset automatic picking algorithm have developed for vertical seismic records. For horizontal seismic records, of which the P-wave onset are simply set the same as the vertical records. In this paper, the performance of one recently proposed P-wave onset automatic picking algorithm for horizontal and vertical seismic records has been tested using 3000 ground motion records of 51 earthquake events recorded by KiK-net and K-net of Japan Station Motion Observatory Networks in the Kanto Basin from 2000 to 2020. The results shown that the picked P-wave onset for North-South (NS) and East-West (EW) component are quite similar with the mean absolute difference equals 0.0918s. The mean absolute difference of picked P-wave onset between NS (EW) and UD component equals 0.9989s (0.9070s). Moreover, according to the picked P-wave onset, the P-wave arrival of NS and EW components are lagged behind that of UD component. Thus, the tested P-wave onset automatic picking algorithm, developed on basis of vertical component records cannot be directly applied for horizontal component records. Finally, the discussion of the variation of picked P-wave onset on the late computation of signal-to-noise ratio are included.

articleTitle: Deformation Law of Deep Foundation Pit of Inclined Shaft Open Trench
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The surface of deep foundation pit of open channel section of auxiliary transportation inclined shaft in Zhangjiamao second panel is silty clay, which has large porosity, loose structure and is easy to lose stability after soaking. To ensure the safety and stability of surrounding soil and retaining structure during excavation, FLAC3D simulation and field measurement were used to compare and verify the excavation methods. The results show that as the construction progresses, the soil nail tension changes little, the horizontal displacement of the slope protection pile gradually increases, the top of the low slope shifts southward, and the top of the higher slope shifts northward. Through the comparison of numerical simulation and field monitoring data, the support form of Method 2 can make the slope excavation more stable.

Author Keywords: Open channel section of inclined shaft

articleTitle: Influence of the Cantilever Diameter of the Flexional DCEP Pile Plate on the Anti-overturning Bearing Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: This study mainly investigated the damage state of the soil around the flexional DCEP pile with different cantilever diameters under horizontal force. Using our innovative small-scale half-section model test method for undisturbed soil, the entire process of soil from loading to failure was observed, and the impact of the plate cantilever diameter on the horizontal bearing capacity of the flexional DCEP pile and the influence of the damage of the soil around the pile under the action of horizontal force were studied. The effects of the failure form of the flexional DCEP pile under the horizontal load and the size of the cantilever diameter of the plate on the horizontal bearing capacity were qualitatively determined. A reliable theoretical basis has been established for the design and popularization of the flexional DCEP pile in actual projects.

Author Keywords: the flexional DCEP piles (the flexional drill-expanded concrete extended-plate pile)

articleTitle: Study on the Influence and Control Methods of Shield Tunneling through the Sensitive Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Underground engineering increases steadily in large and medium-sized cities as urban construction develops rapidly. The surrounding effect caused by tunneling is of great concern. Especially effect on important building and vibration-sensitive buildings are strictly restricted. Based on the tunneling engineering construction of Hangzhou Zhijiang road to Hangzhou White Pagoda, a three-dimensional Foundation-tunnel-building FEM model has been established. Effects caused by shield tunnel construction on the sensitive building is calculated with ABAQUS software. Furthermore, the strengthening effects of tilting MJS piles are calculated. The results show that the stage of shield tunneling through the building has the greatest settlement, the building settlement near the tunnel is more obvious, and the total settlement and buildings differential settlement that the shield crossing the isolated foundation is greater than that of the raft foundation. Moreover, due to the protection of isolation piles, the settlement of the building in the reinforcement section greatly decreases, and the settlement satisfies the requirement.

articleTitle: Research on Landslide Motion Process Using a Dynamic Slice Model
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The landslide is a common geological disaster. In recent years, the outbreak of the landslide is more frequent and the scale is increasing. These landslides often constitute a threat both to human life and property. In order to reduce the landslide hazard impact effectively, further research should be undertaken to better understand the characteristics of the landslide. This paper presents a dynamic slice model. The dynamic slice model has been converted from the differential equations of continuous motion theory. The lateral pressure determined by different motion states has been taken into account in the dynamic slice model, which is accord with the actual situation of the geotechnical materials motion. Shibecha embankment landslide, which occurred in the Japan, was back-calculated using this model. The calculation results generally showed good agreement with field data, which verify the effectiveness of this model. According to the analysis, the landslide motion time was 20s in the calculation. The Shibecha embankment landslide basically completed the main deformation in the first 5s which showed high mobility. Finally, the numerical simulation of energy process has been carried out. The simulation results showed that the mechanical energy reduced in the motion process because it was converted into frictional dissipations and deformation energy generated respectively by basal friction and landslide deformation. And the frictional dissipation was the main form in the energy process.

articleTitle: A Calibration Method of Meso-Parameters of Cement Mortar Based on the Discrete Element Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Meso-parameters are key factors of numerical simulation based on the discrete element method (DEM). For cement mortar, the unconfined compressive strength test was simulated by the two-dimensional particle flow code (PFC2D). The influences of the main meso-parameters of the linear parallel bond model, including <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\overline{E}^{\ast}, \overline{\sigma}_{c}, \overline{c}, \overline{\kappa}^{\ast}}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu$</tex>, on unconfined compressive strength, elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio were studied. The results show that unconfined compressive strength, elastic modulus, and Poisson's ratio are mainly influenced by the cementing force (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline{\sigma}_{c}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\bar{c}$</tex>), <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline{E}^{\ast}$</tex>, and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\overline{\kappa}^{\ast}$</tex>, respectively. Then, a calibration method was proposed and validated, based on the meso-parameters determined by the method, unconfined compressive strength, elastic modulus, and Poisson's ratio can be accurately predicted.

articleTitle: Software Development for Statistics of Land Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: This paper discusses the specific method of secondary development of AutoCAD for the statistics of land acquisition during road construction, and introduces the function and operation method of “Statistics Software of Land Acquisition for Road Construction V1.0” which I have successfully developed. The software has obtained the “Computer Software Copyright Registration Certificate” (registration number: Ruan Zhu Deng Zi No. 3682920).

articleTitle: Application Study of Impact Imaging Method in Void Detection of Steel Shell Concrete Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Steel-shell concrete, as a new structural form, is used in the submarine immersed tube tunnel project in the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. Construction factors tend to form void between steel and concrete, which affects the overall force performance of the structure. In order to achieve the accurate detection of void defects at the steel-shell concrete interface, this paper takes the immersed tube tunnel in the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link as the engineering background, the specimens with different void shapes were made, conducted research on the application of impact imaging method in void detection of steel-shell concrete interface. The test results show that the method can better reflect the actual void space distribution at the steel-shell concrete interface, quantitatively evaluate the void condition, the results have important reference significance for the improvement of construction control measures.

articleTitle: Research on the Relationship between the Dynamic Stiffness and Pile Bearing Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The previous researches on the mechanical impedance method for pile testing mostly only stay on the basis of low strain. The method of calculating the pile bearing capacity has been controversial because the impact force is relatively small. However, a large amount of engineering practice data shows that the dynamic stiffness is closely related to the pile bearing capacity, and it is not advisable to negate it completely. A certain relative displacement is generated between the pile and the soil because the impact force is large enough during the high strain dynamic testing. At this time, the soil around the pile has entered the plastic deformation stage, and side resistance and end resistance have been fully stimulated. It is very valuable to explore the relationship between dynamic stiffness and the bearing capacity under this background. This paper discusses the relationship between the dynamic stiffness and the maximum impact force and the measured bearing capacity based on the measured data of high strain dynamic testing under the same geological conditions, pile length and pile diameters of the same project. The results show that the bearing capacity is positively correlated with the dynamic stiffness; the greater the dynamic stiffness, the greater the corresponding bearing capacity. The pile bearing capacity can be estimated by the measured dynamic stiffness value when the curve of dynamic testing is poor and the traditional mechanical impedance method can be used for the auxiliary analysis of high strain dynamic testing.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Stud Connector for Steel Self-Compacting Concrete with Machine-Made Sand
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The stud connection is the main connection methods of concrete and steel in the composite structure. There are fewer study on the stud connector for steel self-compacting concrete with machine-made sand. Considering different concrete strengths and stud diameters, 28 finite element models of stud connector for steel self-compacting concrete with machine-made sand are designed, and the shear performance of stud connector are analyzed under different influencing factors by using Abaqus finite element software and the stress-strain curve of machine-made sand self-compacting concrete. It is found that the diameter affects the ultimate bearing capacity of the connector more than the concrete strength, and the strength of the self-compacting concrete has a small effect on the stiffness of the connector. While the diameter of the stud is larger than 19 mm, the concrete strength influences the ultimate bearing capacity of the model obviously.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on the Influence of the Position of the Bearing Plate Under the Horizontal Load on the Failure State of the NT-CEP Pile
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Through the simulation analysis of ANSYS finite element analysis software, seven groups of model piles are designed using the bearing plate position as the main parameter to determine the influence of different NT-CEP pile plate positions (new-type concrete expanded plate pile) on the horizontal bearing capacity and the failure state of soil around the pile under horizontal load. Through the analysis of displacement nephogram and stress nephogram, the displacement values of pile top and pile bottom under different loads are extracted, and the load displacement curve and pile top bottom displacement curve are drawn. The corresponding conclusions are drawn from the analysis of the simulation results, thereby providing a theoretical basis for the further research on the design of NT-CEP pile under horizontal bearing capacity and promoting the development and application of NT-CEP pile in practical projects.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis of Existing Intelligent Analytical Techniques for Pile Integrity Test
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Pile health testing plays an important role in the safety and integrity of buildings, and there are low-strain integrity testing methods; thermal integrity analysis (TIP) methods; inter-well acoustic logging; Gamma-Gamma logging (GGL) and some less common methods. In this paper, based on the analysis of a large number of scientific papers, a critical analysis of pile capacity and integrity testing is conducted to determine their advantages and disadvantages through the principles of the test methods' formulas, analysis of field investigation data, cost effectiveness, requirements for engineers and method safe-ty, complexity of data processing, range of data deviations, completeness and applicability of data derived models. The proposed classification of pile integrity tests enables a very effective determination of which test type is the best for further geotechnical analysis of structures and which test type should be used in the geotechnical testing phase of design and scientific re-search. The future development of each technique and its sustainability re-search directions are also studied and evaluated. The purpose of this paper is to provide a reliable and effective reference platform for pile foundation integrity researchers.

articleTitle: A Real-time Detection Algorithm Based on Nanodet for Pavement Cracks by Incorporating Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to realize real-time detection of road crack defects on edge devices with low computational power, we propose a Real-time detection algorithm of Nanodet pavement cracks incorporating attention mechanism for a wide range of domestic road crack detection practical needs. Based on the Nanodet model, the algorithm in this paper introduces the attention mechanism into the feature extraction structure and assigns different weights to the features to improve the attention of the network crack target. It adopts the SimOTA dynamic label matching strategy to optimize the training process, so that the model can make full use of the data set. Besides, it uses the Hard-Swish activation function instead of the original ReLU function to speed up the network training convergence speed and improve the robustness of the algorithm, so as to achieve fast and accurate recognition of the key parts of pavement cracks. Through experimental validation on the pavement crack data set, compared with several classical target detection algorithms, there are different degrees of improvement in recognition accuracy and detection speed. In this model, the number of parameters is only 0.96M, the occupied memory is 7.6 MB, the floating point computation is 2.21G, and the average accuracy in the test set reaches 95.51%, the FPS is 123 fps. The model, which is 4.32% better than the original model, improves the detection accuracy of the model while maintaining the lightweight characteristics of the original model, and has good prospects for application deployment.

articleTitle: A Strategy for Optimal Sensor Placement in Modal Signal-to-noise Ratio-based Structural Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In structural vibration monitoring, the sensor layout scheme directly affects the identification accuracy of structural modal parameters. Aiming at the problem of operational modal identification, the concept of modal signal-to-noise ratio is proposed to characterize the difficulty of modal parameter identification of each order, and the influence of external random load amplitude, distribution and sensor noise level on the optimal layout of sensors can be considered. In order to balance the influence of each mode to be measured on the sensor layout scheme, the optimal layout of vibration monitoring sensors is realized by maximizing the minimum modal signal-to-noise ratio and minimizing the maximum off diagonal element of the modal assurance criterion (MAC) matrix. For the solution of the optimization problem, the subset simulation algorithm is selected to verify, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the modal test of the beam bridge model in the laboratory. The optimization results of measuring points show good linear independence and large enough modal signal-to-noise ratio.

articleTitle: Study on Key Technology for Comprehensive Dynamic Judgment System of Flood Control
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: This paper explored an overall model of the dynamic judgment of flood control through the design research of a comprehensive dynamic judgment system of flood control, abstracted key rules in the plan, realized the development of digital tools, and developed a basic database of the data in the plan based on a map. We studied and set up the mechanism of taking the calculation results of the hydrodynamic model as input and linking flood control-related factors based on a map; established digital tools for emergency refuge, which could generate suggestions on the emergency refuge and disposal with one click based on the danger prediction mode in the auxiliary decision-making function for emergency rescue; connected the processes from rehearsal to the application of an emergency plan through the digitalization of rules in the plan by reorganizing modules with different operation modes and taking the base data and map as a link, and realized a useful dynamic judgment system and the semi-automation of the whole business processes ranging from judgment to rescue, which can be used for reference in the construction of other digital twin riverbasins.

articleTitle: Analysis on Landslides of Mountainside Slopes for Water Conveyance Structures Induced by Rainfall after Earthquakes
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Loess areas are faced with water resource shortages. With the implementation of long-distance water transfer projects, a lot of water conveyance works will cross loess ridges and hills. The stability of mountainside slopes affects the safety of water conveyance structures. Therefore, loess landslides have become a major geological disaster faced in the ecological protection and rural revitalization strategy of the Yellow River Basin. The earthquake process accelerates the development of fissures and provides dominant passages for surface runoff penetration, becoming one of the key factors for the formation of a sliding zone. In this paper, we set up a numerical calculation model of fissured loess slopes by using finite element software based on the saturated-unsaturated seepage theory, and analyzed the penetration law and slope stability of fissured loess after 6 h, 24 h, 72 h and 240 h of rainstorms, heavy rain and moderate rain. The results showed that the greater the rainfall intensity, the greater the penetration depth in fissures; the longer the rainfall lasts, the greater the penetration depth in the fissured loess, while the penetration depth in the shallow surface layer changed little. Repeated rainfall causes a wider range of penetration in fissured loess, leading to the decrease of the matric suction of loess and the increase of the permeability coefficient in the penetration range, which has become an important factor affecting the stability of loess slopes. This paper provides technical references for long-distance water transfer projects to avoid slopes by analyzing the stability of fissured loess slopes under different rainfall intensities after earthquakes.

articleTitle: Effect of Bilinear Mohr-Coulomb Model and Tensile-Compression Ratio on Rock Fracture
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The compressive strength of rock mass is several times to tens of times its tensile strength, and the stress field of the crack tip of rock mass is mainly tensile shear. Therefore, the tensile-compression ratio of rock is very sensitive to crack propagation of rock mass. Firstly, the numerical difference software FLAC3D is used to establish the bilinear Mohr-Coulomb strength criterion, which considers the macroscopic local performance of far-field displacement and fixes the cracking direction of the unit. Then, the theoretical solution of the bilinear constitutive model and the Hoek-Brown model is compared, and the existing uniaxial compression test simulation of fracture-containing cement mortar verifies the effectiveness of the numerical means. Finally, the crack propagation of rock masses with different tensile-compression ratios is studied. The results show that the bilinear strength criterion requires fewer parameters to be measured than the H-B criterion, and more accurately reflects the rock strength failure, especially the tensile shear failure, compared with the linear Mohr-Coulomb strength criterion. In the uniaxial compression numerical test of fractured rock mass, the compressive strength of rock mass increases with the increase of tensile compression ratio, and the failure form of rock mass is quite different.

articleTitle: Application of QPSO-LSSVM in tunnel surrounding rocks deformation prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Predicting and analyzing tunnel surrounding rocks deformation is of great significance to the safe implementation of tunneling projects. In this paper, the QPSO-LSSVM algorithm is applied to the study of tunnel surrounding rocks deformation prediction, and case study and validation are conducted based on indicator-based data and time-series data. The results show that the QPSO-LSSVM algorithm outperforms the PSO-LSSVM as well as the LSSVM algorithm in the case analysis of indicator-based data, while the QPSO-LSSVM algorithm outperforms the seven methods of GM(l,l), ARIMA(l,l,l), BP neural network (BP), linear regression (LR), SVR, LSSVM, and PSO-LSSVM in the analysis of time-series data. Therefore, applying the QPSO-LSSVM algorithm to the tunnel surrounding rocks deformation prediction analysis is feasible and efficient. This provides new ideas for machine learning in the field of tunnel surrounding rocks deformation prediction.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Determining the Optimal Supporting Structure Scheme in Deep Excavation in River Channels by 3D FEM Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: A deep excavation with a maximum depth of 13.6 m in one river channel before the construction of a sluice is presented in this paper. The working environment of the deep excavation is rather complex, in which the surrounding 11-story building, underground pipeline, underground water and large areas of excavation are included. To ensure the security and stability of the foundation pit and the surrounding environment, and combined with the characteristics of the foundation pit, a gridding diaphragm wall or anchored diaphragm wall is designed in both sides of the river channel in advance, which constitutes multiple schemes for the supporting structures. A better understanding of their behavior through the three-dimensional finite element method could result in more reliable predictions and efficient designs, in which various phases, such as dewatering, soil excavation and anchor installation, are simulated. The simulation results of different schemes and the technical code for monitoring building foundation pit engineering are analysed and compared with a focus on the structural performance of supporting structures, the settlement of the 11-story building and the ground surface settlement behind the diaphragm walls. Then, the optimal supporting structure scheme is obtained to guarantee the economy and safety of foundation pit engineering. Finally, the real-time monitoring data during the foundation pit excavation are analysed, which demonstrates that a reliable supporting structure scheme can be achieved through simulation methods in advance. It is expected that this paper will provide a useful basis for similar excavations in river channels.

articleTitle: Multi-Field Coupling Research on Performance Degradation of Anti-Seepage Curtains in High-Pressure Waterways
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to study the deterioration law of anti-seepage curtain in high-pressure waterway of pumped storage power station, a mathematical model of multi-field coupling of anti-seepage curtain is established based on the principles of fluid dynamics, solute migration and chemical kinetics. The model is solved by finite element method and verified by engineering data. The research results show that the internal calcium of the anti-seepage curtain of high-pressure waterway is continuously dissolved and separated under the penetration and corrosion action of high water head for 30 years. In the deepest part of the anti-seepage curtain, 17.76% of solid calcium was dissolved and lost, its porosity increased by 29.38% compared with the initial porosity, the permeability coefficient increased by 2.49 times, and the impermeability and durability continued to decline. The seepage-corrosion damage of the high-pressure water channel anti-seepage curtain has the characteristics of temporal and spatial variation. The corrosion area of the contact part between the middle of the anti-seepage curtain and the high-pressure bifurcated pipe is the largest, while the top and bottom dissolution are mainly encircling dissolution, and its dissolution area is the second. The research results can provide a scientific basis for various preventive measures and control strategies to limit the deterioration of the anti-seepage performance of the high-pressure water channel anti-seepage curtain.

articleTitle: Study on the Design of Early Warning Release System Based on Digital Management of Early Warning Rules
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Through the research and design of early warning release, this paper aims to analyze the business scenario of automated early warning in the digital twin basin and the difficulties in its development. Through the analysis, the processing method based on the digitalization of early warning rules is proposed, and the key pages of the automatic early warning release system are designed. In the paper, a solution is provided to abstract the business and transform it into a logical operation, which can be used for reference in building other digital twin basins.

articleTitle: Research on the Effect of Vortex Tube Based on Cold and Heat Shock Cycle System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Aiming at the waste of test resources in the cold and heat shock test of small parts, a scheme of cold and heat shock test, with the help of small cooling equipment is proposed to solve this problem. Using carbon dioxide as working medium, the cold and heat shock cycle system with low operating cost and convenient maintenance is designed based on vortex tube. With the help of theoretical formula of gas dynamics and empirical formula, the structure of each part of vortex tube is designed, structural parameters of vortex tube are obtained, nozzle of vortex tube adopts two runners structure, inlet cross-sectional area of nozzle is 4.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, outlet cross-sectional area of nozzle is 0.92 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, total length of vortex tube is 103 mm, length of cold end tube is 35 mm, diameter of cold orifice plate is 2.39 mm, diameter of hot end tube is 4.32 mm. In order to obtain the temperature separation effect of vortex tube, vortex tube is simulated with the help of simple algorithm in CFD and standard k-e model, carbon dioxide is used as working fluid.
