The results show that inlet pressure of vortex tube is 6.5 MPa, temperature is 298.15 K, cold flow ratio is 0.4, outlet temperature of cold end tube reaches 284 K, cooling effect of vortex tube is 14.15 K, and the reliability of the design is verified.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on the Early Preset Intelligent Treatment System for Barrier Dams: A Case Study of Baige Barrier Lake
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In recent years, the number of geological disasters of barrier dams in China has surged under the influence of global warming, the frequent occurrence of extreme weather such as strong earthquakes and heavy rainfall, as well as the continuous expansion of human engineering activities. The current engineering measures to address the problem are all taken after the formation of the dam. During the management process, the risk of a sharp increase in water hoarding increases. Inundation and flooding caused by landslides blocking rivers can be effectively avoided by preventing the initial accumulation of debris flow during the incubation period. In this paper, we propose an early preset intelligent treatment system for barrier dams, which uses the remote automatic control system to intelligently control the opening and closing of the control gate, create drainage channels and seepage failure channels, inhibit the rise of the water level of the dam while automatically infiltrating erosion, and remove the dam. Taking the Baige Barrier Lake of Jinsha River as an example, the effectiveness of the scheme is demonstrated from two aspects of conveyance capacity and the removal of the barrier dam.

articleTitle: Research on Stress Monitoring and Early Warning of Super High-Rise Jacking Formwork Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The MCGS configuration software is used to design a monitoring and early warning system to investigate the stress status of a super high-rise jack up formwork platform in order to effectively prevent super high-rise construction safety mishaps. The hierarchical early warning approach is used to set the early warning threshold in conjunction with the stress state, taking into account the change in the early warning value produced by the change in the stress state of the components during the construction process. In order to lower the safety risk associated with the construction of ultra high-rise buildings, the monitoring data are compared with those from the finite element analysis. The findings indicate that the first span of the main truss has a certain amount of safety redundancy, the average stress value is around 80% of the calculated stress value, and the maximum and lowest values of each monitoring point are well below the first level warning range. The system's early warning threshold range is used correctly and effectively, and it can serve as a guide for other jacking formwork platforms' safety monitoring and early warning.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Enterprise Water-Saving Evaluation System Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Water-saving evaluation is the main fulcrum to implement the strictest water resources management system in China. Water-saving evaluation based on the existing guidelines has shortcomings: evaluation indicators are independent from each other, and have different degrees of influence. We studied on the evaluation index system for enterprise and the evaluation method on the basis of the existing evaluation indicators. A total of 24 indicators were selected, by filtering those can truly reflect the water intake, water utilization, water deprivation, and drainage of the enterprise, as well as building a 2-layer criterion of management and technology. Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) was used to calculate the weight of each index. Among them, the weight of decline rate of water withdrawal per unit, product with repeated utilization, and decline rate of water withdrawal per ten thousand yuan of output are larger, which is 0.27, 0.15, and 0.15, respectively. The evaluation index system was used on a certain iron and steel enterprise. The aim of this study is to construct a set of index system with different weights for the water-saving evaluation of enterprises. The rationality of the evaluation results can be verified between the index layers. This work may provide some new ideas for water saving evaluation in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Building A Data Visualization System Based on a Seabed Model —Take the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The data visualization system of the sea-crossing bridge is an intuitive observation and evolution analysis of the bridge and the seabed topography, landform, and strata at the top of the tunnel around the bridge, assisting maintenance personnel to carry out operations and providing support information for decision makers. Through the fusion of multi-source seabed topography data, providing two-dimensional, three-dimensional, and infographic visualization of these data is a key link in building a visualization system. This paper mainly introduces three types of submarine terrain detection technologies, namely multiple beams, side-scan sonar, and shallow stratigraphic profile, as well as the key algorithms in the process of data post-processing, and visualizes the surrounding terrain of the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge through data fusion.

articleTitle: Determination Methods of Ultimate Displacement Values of Tunnel Based on Bearing Capacity of Primary Supporting Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The limit states of a primary supporting structure were used to represent the limit states of the tunnel, and the analytical methods of Catastrophe Theory and bearing capacity were respectively used to determine the ultimate displacement values of the tunnel. The calculated results indicate that the ultimate displacement values obtained from the two methods are close to one another, and it is suggested to use the analytical method of bearing capacity, which is with explicit mechanical basis and small values. On surrounding rock, the effects of such parameters as resistance coefficient and side pressure coefficient were analyzed, and the results show that the effects of two parameters on the ultimate bearing capacity of the structure are great, but small on its ultimate displacement values. This paper proposed the determination method of the ultimate displacement values of a tunnel. The method directly correlates with the parameters of the primary supporting structure of the tunnel and is with explicit and reliable calculated results. Therefore, the application of the method can be spread to the determination of the ultimate displacement values of a tunnel in its displacement monitoring.

articleTitle: A Constrained Multi-objective Optimization for the Evaluation and Selection of Monitored Bridges in Road Network
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The selection of bridges to be monitored in an extensive road network requires comprehensive considerations such as total monitoring cost, bridge types and span, traffic flow, regional economic radiation and bridge service performance, and might control the total quantity of monitoring bridges within a certain proportion. Based on evolutionary algorithm NSGA2, this paper improved the mutation algorithm with respect to the binary integer (0,1) problem and adopted Tabu list to reduce the redundancy of iterative search. It proposed a constrained multi-objective optimization by introducing sparse random matrix and constraint violation indicator to restrain the proportion. Taking the selection of the monitored ones from total 207 bridges in a county road network as an example, the proposed method were used to analyze the distribution of Pareto solution set, the satisfaction of constraints and the calculation efficiency under different corresponding evolutionary simulation parameters. The result shows that the evaluation based on the crowding distance in the traditional NSGA2 cannot select the optimal bridges to be monitored effectively. By introducing a fuzzy membership degree to obtain the multi-objective decision weights, the extreme value of decision function can be used for selecting the final decision plan of monitored bridges in road network.

articleTitle: Study on Technology of Online Analysis and Visualization of Over and Under Excavation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Traditional analytical method of over and under excavation relies on such standalone software as AutoCAD and is based on data from excavation to carry out analysis manually, so the analysis process is tedious, and analysis results cannot be rapidly obtained to guide on-site construction. Aimed at the problems in the traditional method, and based on such technologies as computer network technology, computer graphics technology, and WebGL, a new method was put forward to achieve the purposes of rapidly calculating and analyzing such key data as the zones, areas, and deviations of over and under excavation, displaying analysis results with graphics, timely feeding the results back to construction sites, etc. With its feasibility and effectiveness verified by experiments, the technology can be applied to such underground engineering as underground powerhouses and tunnels to improve the quality and safety of engineering, so the technology has good popularization value.

Author Keywords: analysis of over and under excavation

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Technology in Integrated Urban-Rural Water Supply Project
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of a new generation of science and technology, such as 3DGIS+BIM, Industrial IoT, Engineering Big Data, and Intelligent Mobile Terminals, related technologies have been widely used in various industries, and the intelligent construction of the water conservancy industry has also become an inevitable development trend. under such a background, this paper Conduct a research on the problems of heavy and costly operation and management tasks, low IT construction standards of projects, and lack of intelligent supporting infrastructure in integrated urban-rural water supply projects based on the actual project construction and management, and established a system architecture and implementation plan of “intelligent management and control platform for integrated urban-rural water supply project” and realizes the intelligent construction goal of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\prime\prime$</tex> autonomous operation, intelligent inspection, remote control, and on-site emergency response” for the integrated urban-rural water supply project. The relevant results have technical application and case reference value in improving the intelligent management and control level of integrated urban-rural water supply projects, reducing management difficulty and operating costs, and realizing the optimal allocation and efficient utilization of water resources.

articleTitle: Load-Carrying Capacity Analysis of RC Slab Culvert Reinforced with Grouted CSP Based on Plastic Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: To develop a load-carrying capacity calculation method for reinforced concrete (RC) slab culverts reinforced with a grouted corrugated steel plate (CSP), a numerical equivalent model was established in this paper. Compared with the laboratory test results, the availability of the numerical model was verified. In addition, 21 numerical models of reinforced system were established, and their ultimate load-carrying capacities were obtained. Based on the plasticity theory, a mechanical model and load-carrying capacity estimation method of RC slab culverts rehabilitated with grouted CSP was proposed and verified. It was concluded that when the radii of the sidewall and crown of CSP remained constant, the load-carrying capacity of the reinforced system increased upon increasing the haunch radius. When the haunch radius of the CSP remained constant, the load-carrying capacity of the V system increased upon decreasing the radii of the sidewall and crown. At a constant rise-span ratio, a skene arch provided the maximum load-carrying capacity for the V system. The most important function of the grout was to provide strong lateral restraint for the CSP, which reduced the effective span and improved the load-carrying capacity of the CSP. This also indirectly improved the load-carrying capacity of the reinforced system. In addition, the grout contributed its shear strength to the reinforced system, which caused the grout to exert an arch effect or undergo shear failure. This also greatly improved the load-carrying capacity of the reinforced system. The error between the calculated results and numerical results was in the range of -27-12%. The findings of this paper provide a reference and guidance for engineers to design similar rehabilitated systems.

articleTitle: Application Analysis on Convergence Deformation of Soft Soil Shield Tunnel Controlled by Grouting
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: At present, the measure to control the large deformation of the tunnel's transverse diameter convergence is to adopt the grouting from the outside of the tunnel, but the direct control effect is still taken as the standard in the implementation process, so there are still many deficiencies in the understanding of grouting to control the tunnel's convergence deformation in engineering practice. Firstly, the influence range of grouting diffusion is analyzed based on the cavity expansion theory, and the diffusion pattern of grout and the change of excess pore pressure caused by grouting are verified by in-situ tests; Finally, the influence of grouting is simulated by volumetric strains method. The results show that the diffusion of grouting compacted soil is obvious in the clay layer in Shanghai, and the radius of plastic zone affected by grouting is about 8 ~ 9 times of the diffusion radius of grout; The grout diffusion radius of 1.5m grouting scheme is within 30.0cm; Cement soil is formed in the grouting area, and the strength is increased and the compressibility is decreased; More than half of the excess pore pressure dissipated 1h after grouting; The simulation results show that the convergence deformation of tunnel transverse diameter is about −1.0 ~ −2.0mm by single hole grouting.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of mud and water surges in tunnels based on game theory and regret theory
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to scientifically assess the risk level of mud and water surges in road tunnels and reduce the probability of mud and water surges in tunnel construction, this paper proposed a risk assessment model of mud and water surges in road tunnels based on game theory and regret theory. On the basis of research and analysis of tunnel mud and water surges and expert investigation, a risk assessment index system was established with climate environment, engineering geology, hydrogeology and construction design as the first level indicators, then according to the improved hierarchical analysis and CRITIC method, combined with game theory ideas to determine the comprehensive weights of indicators, and finally the use of regret theory for mud and water surges risk assessment. Applying the established assessment model to the engineering case, the risk level of IV (high risk) was obtained, and the assessment results obtained from the current national specification and fuzzy hierarchical analysis were compared, and the results showed the consistency of the three methods. In summary: the assessment model based on game theory and regret theory is a feasible method for assessing the risk of mud and water surges in tunnels.

articleTitle: An Interval Algorithm Based Method for Testing the Validity of In-situ Stress Measurement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As a second-order Cartesian tensor, in-situ stress naturally inherits the abstraction and mystery of the mathematical concept of stress tensor. It is difficult to present the in-situ stress measurement data intuitively and judge the validity of the measurement data concisely. It is pointed out that the orthogonality between principal stress vectors is the only criterion to judge the correctness of in-situ stress measurement data. The error algorithm based on interval calculation theory and simple error estimation algorithm are established to measure the degree of deviation from orthogonality between principal stress vectors caused by truncation of in-situ stress azimuth data, which can be used as an effective criterion for the validity of measurement data. In order to visually express the in-situ stress measurement data and to clarify its relationship with the stability of surrounding rock of underground engineering, the all element presentation method integrating data validation, three-dimensional stress state and stress ellipses on characteristic sections is proposed, which can clearly distinguish whether the principal stress vector meets the orthogonality at a glance. At the same time, the anisotropy degree of initial stress state of surrounding rock and the stress evolution path caused by excavation and unloading can be obtained intuitively. Using the all element graphical expression method proposed in this paper can visualize and concretize the abstract concept, and has stronger indication, which is convenient for the application of practical engineering.

articleTitle: Identification of Critical Areas and Difficult Areas in Pipeline Maintenance and Emergency Repair Based on Semi-Quantitative Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of long-distance oil and gas pipelines in China, pipeline accidents caused by geological disasters are also increasing, which are sudden and have serious consequences. The environment along the long-distance oil and gas pipeline is generally complex, and there are many geological disasters such as landslides, collapses, mudslides, which affect the safe transportation of the pipeline. The threat of geological disasters to the pipeline is more and more concerned. Shaanxi-Beijing pipeline has a lot of pipelines and a long distance. The identification of the difficult and important areas in the emergency repair will help the management department to obtain the risk level of geological disasters along the pipeline and provide scientific decision-making basis for pipeline maintenance and management. In this paper, multi-level extension theory and analytic hierarchy process are applied to comprehensively consider the susceptibility of disasters and the vulnerability of pipelines, and a semi-quantitative risk assessment method is proposed for three typical geological disasters such as landslide, collapse and debris flow. This method has been applied to a steep slope pipeline in Beijing for the purpose of demonstration. The result of the example shows that the risk grade of landslide disaster is “medium”. The example shows that the application of this method can effectively evaluate the risk level of geological disasters in various areas along the pipeline, so as to determine the critical areas and difficult areas for pipeline maintenance and emergency repair, thus ensuring the safety of the pipeline.

articleTitle: Study on Stress Characteristics and Time Effect of Pile Group in High Backfill Site
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to investigate the effect of creep of the fill around pile on the mechanical properties of the group pile foundation, using the finite difference software FLAC3D, the mechanical properties of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{2}\times\boldsymbol{2}$</tex> group pile foundation with a fill thickness of 10m and a rock embedded depth of 3m are studied The results show that during the creep of the perimeter fill, the group pile foundation will lead to differential fill and the group pile foundation will lead to differential fill. The results show that during the creep of the perimeter fill, the group pile foundation will lead to differential settlement of the perimeter fill and the inter-pile fill, which will weaken the downward pulling effect of the inter-pile fill on the pile foundation and produce bending moment on the pile cross-section; the variability of the pile internal force, neutral point The variability of the pile internal force, neutral point depth and pile end resistance with time is shown as the creep time increases, the neutral point depth and pile internal force change rapidly in the settling The creep deformation of backfill is a reorganization of its internal structure, which has little effect on the change of soil pressure at its bottom; the effect coefficient of negative frictional resistance effect coefficient of negative frictional resistance group pile calculated by the normative method is on the safe side, which should be optimized in the design with the group pile arrangement and The effect coefficient of negative frictional resistance group pile calculated by the normative method is on the safe side, which should be optimized in the design with the group pile arrangement and pile foundation.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Thermal Effects of Thermokarst Lake and High Sunny Slope on Permafrost Subgrade
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Sunny-shady slope and thermokarst lake are widely distributed along the Qinghai-Tibet highway, the lateral thermal erosion of which will induce serious subgrade diseases and affect long-term stability of the highway. In this paper, four numerical models were established to analyze the coupling thermal influence of thermokarst lake and high sunny slope on permafrost subgrade. Lateral single and composite thermal disturbances induced by 80m width lake and 5.3m height sunny slope had been investigated and the thermal influence weight of above two factors was also calculated by pixel method. The results show that: 1) High sunny slope leads to more serious lateral thermal erosion, and the melting depth is larger than that of the common subgrade, which also causes the lateral deviation of the temperature field of the subgrade. 2) Thermal erosion of roadside thermokarst lake mainly affects the permafrost below the lake bottom. Lateral thermal erosion of the lake has little effect on the morphology of thawing plate of subgrade permafrost, and it can melt the deep permafrost under the subgrade which results in a thickness decrease of the underlying permafrost layer. 3) With increase of servicing time, the weight of thermokarst lake lateral thermal erosion on the permafrost subgrade gradually decreases, and corresponding thermal impact of high sunny slope takes the dominant position.

articleTitle: Study on the Numerical Simulation of Groundwater “Drainage and Recharge” in Open pit Coal Mine Based on FEFLOW
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to maintain the balance of groundwater system in the open pit coal mine area, avoid water resource damage and adverse environmental impact caused by drainage, and ease the contradiction between drainage and drainage of the open pit coal mine, try to recharge the drained water of the open pit coal mine in the same layer within the scope of the falling funnel. On the premise of ensuring mining safety, zero drainage of drained water is realized through short path “drainage reinjection” groundwater circulation. Based on the theory of water balance, according to the theory of short path groundwater circulation and drainage, and taking the open pit coal mine as the research object, the FEFLOW groundwater numerical simulation software is used to build the geological model of drainage reinjection cooperative mining, and simulate the groundwater flow under the condition of simultaneous operation of drainage and reinjection in the open pit coal mine. Taking the open pit coal mine as the research object, the groundwater numerical simulation software FEFLOW is used to build the geological model of drainage reinjection cooperative mining, and simulate the groundwater flow under the condition of simultaneous operation of drainage and reinjection in the open pit coal mine. Analyze the relationship between the number of wells, well spacing, flow rate of drainage wells and recharge wells and the drainage effect. Compare and analyze the drainage effect of dewatering hole drainage method and short path groundwater circulation drainage method, and verify the short path groundwater circulation drainage method.

articleTitle: Development and Application of the Xin'anjiang Model based on Grid-Computation Unit Nesting
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Distributed models, which can take into account the spatial inhomogeneity of basin subsurface characteristics and rainfall, have become a hot topic of research. However, the emphasis on building large sets of hydrodynamic equations and the pursuit of fine and high-resolution calculation unit may heighten the problems of model scale and parameterization. Based on the latest theory of watershed spatial discretization and Xin'anjiang model, a framework that simulating flood using Xin'anjiang model based on grid-computation unit nesting is proposed, which makes full use of the distributed underlying surface and meteorological data with a relatively simple model structure. The established model is applied to the Qujiang River basin, a tributary of the Jialing River. The results show that the model has high simulation accuracy and efficiency. It has certain popularization and application value.

articleTitle: Field Study of Shaft Resistance of Continuous Flight Auger Pile in Residual Soil Using Fiber Optic Sensing Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Towards a better practice of the continuous flight auger (CFA) pile in Southeast China, a field study was carried in Huangpu District of Guangzhou to examine the shaft resistance response of the CFA pile in the residual soils. For this purpose, the ultra-weak fiber Bragg gratings (FBG) were mounted to the steel cage of the pile to directly measure the shaft resistance. Two frictional and two end-bearing CFA piles were examined using the static load test. For the frictional CFA pile, the shaft resistance in the residual soil was measured as 130 kPa, much greater than the empirical one as 80 kPa. For the end-bearing pile, the measured shaft resistance in the residual soil was lower than the empirical one instead, as the deformation along the soil-pile interface cannot be fully developed under loading.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Estimation of Pumped Storage Power Station Based on GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of insufficient data and information in the preliminary planning and site selection stage of pumped storage power stations, and the technical and economic difficulties of multiple schemes, through the analysis on a large number of historical data, various factors affecting the site selection of pumped storage power projects are comprehensively considered. With the total project investment and optimal unit power cost as the selection criterion, the BP neural network model and the modified genetic algorithm are established for the investment prediction of the site selection of pumped storage power stations in the early stage. It is helpful to provide a basis to improve the benefits of pumped storage power station construction.

articleTitle: Analysis on Lifting and Welding Opportunity of Steel Box Girder of Double Tower Single Span Suspension Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The primary purpose of construction control of suspension bridges is to control the alignment of main cables, e alignment and internal forces of stiffening beams in an ideal finished state. However, due to the differences in the erection sequence of stiffening beams, the connection mode of beam segments, the construction environment and other conditions, the adoption of different construction methods will have a significant impact on the main cable alignment, the stress state of stiffening beams, the construction progress, the project quality and the construction safety during the construction process. Therefore, determining a reasonable stiffening beam erection scheme and beam segment connection mode is the key to ensure that the stiffening beam reaches the designed bridge state, and also the key to ensure that its stress does not exceed the limit during construction [1]. In order to study the influence of the lifting and welding timing of stiffening beams on the final bridge alignment and beam stress of a suspension bridge, a bridge was taken as the research object, and the simulation analysis and calculation of different connection methods and welding timing of stiffening beams were carried out using Midas/Civil simulation software. The different connection methods of stiffening beams, the final bridge alignment of the welding timing, the change of the opening distance between beam segments during the lifting process, and the beam stress were compared [2]. The results show that the difference of the bottom opening distance between the two construction methods is very small, and tends to zero with the erection of the steel box girder; After the stiffening beam is hoisted, the bridge deck alignment of the two construction methods is basically the same [3]. No matter what scheme is adopted, as long as the stress free length of each component is the same, the final alignment has nothing to do with the construction sequence; as long as the weld seam meets the design requirements during welding, the internal force variation law of steel box girder is basically consistent, which shows that the rigid hinge joint hybrid construction method has little difference in force compared with the traditional erection method of lifting before welding, and can effectively improve the construction progress.

articleTitle: Study on Micro Disturbance Deformation Analysis and Control of Earth Pressure Balance Shield Sidearm Crossing Buildings in Water-rich Soft Soil Stratum
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Currently, due to the increasingly tense utilization of urban space, metro construction has become an urgent demand. In order to study the micro disturbance construction of earth pressure balance shield crossing buildings in water-rich soft soil stratum, this paper took the left line tunnel of a certain section of Zhengzhou Metro sidearm crossing a residential building as the engineering background and proposed the control standards for micro disturbance deformation in line with practical projects with a combination of the engineering practice. The disturbance deformation of the residential building and its surrounding surface and the analysis of causes were studied through the measured data obtained from the on-site whole-process monitoring, the three-dimensional numerical model of the whole process of the shield sidearm crossing the building established by the FLAC3D numerical simulation software, and the study method combining on-site monitoring and numerical simulation. Finally, whether the disturbance deformation of the building and its surrounding surface was in line with the micro disturbance deformation was determined based on the evaluation standards for micro disturbance deformation. And the control measures for micro disturbance deformation were proposed, which will provide a reference for the micro disturbance construction similar to the shield crossing buildings in this area.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study on Wave Runup of Curved Seawall
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Using FLUENT software, this paper creates a two-dimensional numerical wave flume and wave creep model based on the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$k-\varepsilon$</tex> turbulence model and the VOF method to track the free surface, uses the boundary condition method to create waves, and uses the sponge layer damping method to dissipate waves, and after verifying the validity of the numerical model, simulates the wave creep process on the slope embankment. The effects of dike top height, relative water depth and different curved surfaces on wave overtopping are analyzed. The results show that the wave runup height increases with the increase of relative water depth and decreases with the increase of the top height of the embankment; the wave runup height on the single-arc wave protection wall is smaller than that on the double-arc wave protection wall.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Dynamic Characteristics of Tailings from A Tailings Pond in The Strong Earthquake Area
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The dynamic triaxial test is conducted to study the influence of dry density, confining pressure, consolidation ratio and other factors on the dynamic characteristics of tailings silt and tailings sand in a tailings pond located in the strong earthquake area of Tajikistan. The results show that the dynamic stress of the two kinds of tailings decreases with the increase of the failure vibration times, and presents an obvious power function distribution law. The dynamic shear stress of tailings silt and tailings sand increases with the increase of consolidation ratio, and decreases with the increase of confining pressure. The curves of dynamic elasticity modulus, damping ratio and dynamic strain show typical three-stage distribution characteristics, which basically accords with the equivalent viscoelastic model. The maximum dynamic elasticity modulus and shear modulus increase with the increase of dry density, confining pressure or consolidation ratio, while the damping ratio shows the opposite law. The effect of dry density and confining pressure on dynamic elasticity modulus is more significant than that of consolidation ratio. The effect of confining pressure on maximum shear modulus and maximum shear stress is more significant than that of dry density and consolidation ratio. And the effect of dry density, confining pressure and consolidation ratio on damping ratio is basically the same. The mechanical crushed clay in tailings silt doesn't improve its dynamic characteristics. After compaction, the dynamic characteristics of tailings can be improved and the seismic capacity can be improved effectively.

articleTitle: Experiment of acoustic tomography under ice in Songhua River basin
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Coastal acoustic tomography is one of the important means currently used in river offshore observation. It can obtain important hydrological information such as temperature, salinity and flow velocity of the observed waters. In this paper, a coastal acoustic tomography experiment was carried out to measure current under ice in Songhua River waters. As the first subglacial acoustic tomography experiment, we set up three acoustic tomography stations near Tianhe Bridge in the Songhua River basin, and each station is equipped with a set of coastal acoustic tomography devices. The placement depth of the transducer under the ice is 5m, and the frequency of the transmitted signal is 25kHz. The cross section velocity is calculated by the time difference of the reciprocal acoustic signal propagation between several stations, so as to calculate the cross section flow for comparison with the data of the official hydrological station. This experiment is the first attempt at the application of coastal acoustic tomography under ice at home and abroad, and the result of the experiment is very ideal. The experiment of acoustic tomography under ice is feasible and we can get accurate flow data through the under ice acoustic tomography experiment. The results prove that the coastal acoustic tomography technology has a very broad application prospect in the flow monitoring of the subglacial basin.

articleTitle: Research on Longitudinal Constraint System of Cable-Stayed Bridge with two unequal-height pylons
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to improve the internal force and displacement response and determine a reasonable longitudinal static and dynamic constraint system of the cable-stayed bridge with two unequal height pylons under static and dynamic loads, taking the Shunxing Bridge as the research object, the finite element model of the Shunxing Bridge is established using the SAP2000 finite element software to carry out the static and dynamic analysis. It can be found that the limit damping restraint system is a reasonable longitudinal constraint system. Moreover, the limit stiffness, limit gap, and damping parameters of the limit-type damping constraint system are analyzed. The results show that the limit stiffness, limit gap, and damping index of the static limit-type damping device is 2E5 kN/m, 0.35 m, and 0.3, respectively. Furthermore, the static and dynamic responses of the floating system and the limit damping system are compared. The results show that the use of limit damping constraint system can greatly reduce the static and dynamic response of the structure and reduce the size of expansion joint, and is a reasonable longitudinal static and dynamic constraint system suitable for cable-stayed bridges with two unequal height pylons.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of ice pressure on concrete face dam
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: For a concrete face slab dam project in a 4000m high altitude cold area, the influence of static ice pressure on the stress and deformation of face slab and dam body is analyzed. According to different ice layer thickness by using the finite element analysis method, dam body displacement increment, face slab displacement increment, extreme value and range of face slab stress are discussed. The research shows that static ice pressure has little influence on dam body displacement, the scope of influence is limited to the dam crest 1/4~1/3. The influence on the stress and displacement of the face slab is shown in the increase of the deformation increment of the face slab, and the obvious increase of the extreme value and range of the tensile stress along the slope at the top of the face slab. Therefore, the antifreeze measures should be targeted at the top of the face slab in the area under ice load.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of the Back-propagation (BP) Neural Network to Predict the Performance of Recycled Brick Aggregates
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The rapid advance of urbanization leads to growing construction waste. To achieve the goals of “peak carbon emissions and carbon neutrality”, construction waste must be treated properly to reduce the consumption of non-renewable resources. In this paper, five general physical parameters that affect the compaction performance of the recycled material-the proportions of fine, medium, and coarse particles, moisture content, and the brick-concrete ratio-are selected to establish a prediction model based on the BP neural network through the BP neural network algorithm, based on the array test of a metro depot project. The results demonstrate that the relative errors between the fitted and predicted values of the BP neural network and the corresponding measured values fluctuated within small ranges, which indicates that it is feasible to apply the BP neural network to predict material performance.

articleTitle: Analytical Study on the Mechanical Behavior of Steel-concrete Composite Bridge Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The cable tower of Shunde Bridge adopted a hybrid structure tower with a steel upper tower and a steel-concrete composite lower tower. In order to verify the mechanical performance of the new multiple-cell composite bridge tower, a finite element model considering the connector forces was established, the stress distribution of the composite tower under the design load was studied, and the influence of concrete shrinkage was analyzed. The research results show that: The stress distribution law of steel structure and concrete in the cross-section of the composite tower was basically the same. And the effective combination of steel and concrete was ensured through the multiple-cell section and the steel-concrete connectors. Concrete shrinkage has a great influence on structure stress, which should be avoided in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Study on Development Characteristics and Control of Surrounding Rock Fracture in Deep High Stress Roadway
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to study the fracture development characteristics of surrounding rock in deep high stress roadway, taking the track crossheading of 5307 working face in Anju Coal Mine of Jining Mining Group as the engineering background, the PFC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2D</sup> numerical model is established, and the development characteristics of surrounding rock fracture of roadway under different lateral pressure coefficients are obtained. With the increase of lateral pressure coefficient, the fracture development degree of surrounding rock of roadway increases gradually. When the lateral pressure coefficient increases from 0.6 to 1.5, the number of cracks increases from 817 to 2148, and the length increases from 200 mm to 403 mm. The total number and length of cracks in roadway surrounding rock increase linearly with the lateral pressure coefficient, and the deformation of roadway increases gradually. According to the simulation results, the support scheme of the track roadway of 5307 working face is optimized, that is, the combined support of high pre-stressed yielding bolt + high pre-stressed anchor cable + metal mesh, and the engineering application is carried out. The engineering practice shows that the maximum deformation of the roof and floor of the roadway is 52 mm, the maximum deformation of the two sides is 78 mm, and the surrounding rock of the roadway is effectively controlled.

articleTitle: Detecting boulders using the horizontal cross-hole seismic method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Detecting boulders before tunnel excavation has become essential routine work to ensure safe, economic and efficient tunnelling. Here, a horizontal cross-hole seismic method to determine the distribution of boulders in tunnelling areas is developed by integrating the horizontal directional drilling technique and cross-hole seismic method. Compared to the cross-hole seismic method, the proposed method has obvious advantages of higher resolution and less limitation by ground conditions. The basic techniques and process of this method are introduced in detail. To verify the feasibility and efficacy of the proposed method, a 220 kV power cable tunnel crossing the Guangming River is taken as an example for detecting boulders beneath the river. A four-borehole detection plan is implemented, and four profiles are obtained. The results reveal several high-velocity anomalies, which are identified as dense sand according to additional logging surveying. This example indicates that the proposed method can provide sufficient information about boulders in underground engineering.

articleTitle: The Design and Construction of the Steel Hanging Box for East Cable Tower of the Lingdingyang Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The Lingdingyang Bridge is a three-span steel box girder suspension bridge with a main span of 1666 m on Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link. The main pier cap is 36m in diameter and 8m in height. The double-walled steel hanging box is used as the temporary cofferdam and permanent anti-collision box for the cap. The inner diameter of the steel hanging box is 36.2m, the height is 16m, and the weight is 1783t. During the construction process, the system changes frequently and the stress is complex. A finite element model of the whole construction process is built to analyze the forces during the lifting up, integral lowering, bottom cover pouring and cover pouring. The finite element calculation results are compared with the actual monitoring results on site, and the two are close. At the same time, the MSC. Dytran calculation software was used to simulate the anti-collision effect of the steel gondola when a 100,000 t ship was impacted from the front and side, and it was found that the maximum impact force was reduced by 5.6% and 7.4% respectively during the frontal and side impacts. The structural design of the steel hanging box is reasonable, and the overall calculation method and construction method are reasonable and feasible.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Research of SHPB Experiment of Oil Well Cement Stone Based on HJC Model
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, the HJC model parameters of oil well cement stone are determined by experiments, and the SHPB experiment process of materials is simulated by finite element software. The result shows that: 1) The HJC model can effectively describe the constitutive relation and failure mode of oil well cement stone under the impact loading; 2) As the strain rate increases, the compressive strength of oil well cement stone increases too, but Young's modulus change less obviously; 3) Under uniaxial impact, with the increase of loading rate, the fracture degree of oil well cement stone increases too, and the fracture surface is approximately parallel to the load direction, which is mainly tensile failure; 4) For oil well cement stone with different mix proportions, only a small amount of parameters in this paper need to be adjusted through uniaxial compression experiments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Finite Element Analysis of Stability of Rectangular Cavern
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Due to the limitation of topographic conditions and the need of function, the buried depth and span of underground engineering often vary greatly, so it is of great significance to study the influence of the ratio between depth and span on the stability of surrounding rock of tunnel. This paper deduced a formula of surrounding rock pressure by combining with Terzaghi theory and studied the law of surrounding rock pressure changing with ratio between depth and span systematically. The results show that: 1Under the condition of grade IV surrounding rock, the surrounding rock pressure of rectangular cavern increases with the increase of ratio between depth and span. When the ratio between depth and span reaches 2, the surrounding rock pressure gradually tends to be stable. 2 When the ratio between depth and span is less than 2, rectangular cavern is prone to failure through to the surface in the limit state. When the ratio between depth and span is greater than 2, the pressure arch effect appears above the cavern vault. Therefore, the ratio between depth and span equaling to 2 can be used as a reference standard to divide the depth of rectangular cavern.

articleTitle: Analysis on Stress Characteristics of Arch of Underground Excavation Station in New Botanical Garden Station
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The monitoring of the stress of the buckle arch steel bar, the pressure of the vault and the concrete strain of the vault were carried out in the new Botanical Garden Station of Xi'an Metro Line 8. The monitoring scheme design is introduced. The monitoring results from the construction stage of the primary support buckle arch to the construction stage of the secondary lining buckle arch are analyzed. The stress characteristics of the buckle arch structure are obtained. The overall steel bar stress of the buckle arch vault and the arch foot shows an increasing trend. The pressure at the vault is transmitted downward along the grille rigid frame to the arch foot, so the steel bar stress at the arch foot is greater than that at the vault. The concrete strain law is similar to the change law of the vault pressure.

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring of Flood Disasters Based on Medium-Sized Sponge Facilities
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, water conservancy informatization and disaster monitoring and early warning system has become a common development trend, looking at the water problems of urban development, combined with the current development of sponge cities, this paper proposes the intelligent monitoring concept of flood disasters based on medium-sized sponge facilities. The city itself is systematic, and the city's water problems, such as the decline in groundwater level, the shortage of freshwater resources, the prominent problem of internal waterlogging, the difficulty of water pollution to be eradicated, the ineffective protection of the water environment, the fragile fracture of the water ecology, the climate problem caused by the change of hydrological cycle, etc., have a correlation and complex cause relationship. From the perspective of solving problems, whether it is a “water-sensitive city”, low-impact development, or a sponge city, or a “near-natural system”, they are emphasizing the way to transform nature, and to a certain extent, they ignore the purpose and effect of transforming nature and solving urban water problems. Therefore, in the current urban planning and construction process, the emphasis is placed on “small sponge” facilities and medium-sized sponge facilities are ignored. The current water cycle is not only driven by natural elements, but also affected by human transformation activities, medium-sized sponge facilities can play a role in replenishing groundwater, intercepting peak flow, regulating water resources, optimizing wetland ecosystems, and at the same time, under the means of intelligent monitoring, flood disasters can be effectively prevented and avoided.

articleTitle: The Path of Introducing Digital Twin Technology into River Chief System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the continuous implementation of the river chief system in the whole country, the river chief system has played a positive role in many aspects. But up to now, we find that there are still some problems in the operation process of river chief system. This paper discusses the realization path of the transformation of river chief system from the perspective of digital twin technology. Firstly, this paper reviews the existing problems in the river chief system from the perspective of fragmented management, and describes them from the vertical and horizontal perspectives of river chiefs at all levels and the competent authorities. After that, the paper analyzes the possible synergies of river chief system and digital twin technology as follows: 1. Make up for the shortage of river chief professional and assist in solving problems; 2. Streamline the river and lake governance process, and quickly respond to problems; 3. Optimize departmental collaboration and implement decision-making power and responsibility.

articleTitle: Study on Allocation Method of Multi-Water Sources Complex Pipe Network in Beijing Raw Water System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the project completion of the middle route project of China's South-North Water Transfer Scheme (SNWT), Beijing's water supply system has become a form of multi-water supply. This study analyzes the topology of the complex water supply network in Beijing and constructs a water supply network simulation model of “water source - water supply pipeline - water user”. Under the premise of ensuring the balance of water sources and plants, a complex pipeline network scheduling model of multi-water sources is established according to the priority of the use of various water sources in the city. A simplified method for complex water supply networks is proposed to reduce the dimensionality of the problem, and the optimization rules required for the optimal equilibrium solution are investigated using a stepwise optimization algorithm. Compared with the previous multi-water sources annual allocation plan, the optimal allocation plan of this study is more reasonable for the deployment of multi-water sources and gives full play to the advantages of the multi-water sources system.

articleTitle: Application and analysis of force characteristics of high - fill pile bearing retaining wall
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In view of the problems of slope instability and insufficient bearing capacity of the traditional gravity retaining wall in the high fill slope and soft foundation, this paper puts forward the retaining scheme of pile bearing force retaining wall composite structure based on the background of a high fill project in Linxia city, Gansu Province. Through a series of theoretical calculation formula of gravity retaining wall alone setting piles combined retaining wall with three rows two, force calculation and three-dimensional finite element numerical analysis model is established, at the same time, the displacement mode of retaining wall and the distribution characteristics of earth pressure behind the wall under different calculation conditions are considered, and the numerical simulation results are compared with the analytical results. The results show that the combined retaining wall with three rows of bored piles has better mechanical characteristics such as stress distribution, displacement and deformation than the single gravity retaining wall. The earth pressure on the retaining wall is not linearly distributed along the wall height, and its distribution characteristics are related to the displacement mode of the retaining wall.

articleTitle: Research on the Working Resistance Relationship of Bracket Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Hydraulic support is an important support means for roof subsidence and collapse. Studying the working resistance of main support in the mining process of working face has an important theoretical and technical guiding role for roof stability. Taking 14301 working face in Shendong mining area as an example, the influence of working resistance on the support work is studied. Through analysis, it is preliminarily concluded that the linear relationship between initial support force and final resistance is strong and the formula is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{y}=\mathbf{Ax}^{2}+\mathbf{Bx}+\mathbf{C}$</tex>. The data distribution is relatively centralized and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{R}^{2}$</tex> is about 1. The supporting effect can be improved by adjusting the size of both.

articleTitle: Terrain Radiometric Correction of SAR Images Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images suffer from significant radiation distortion due to the effect of terrain relief, which makes the further analyze and apply quantitatively of SAR data difficult. The radiometric correction approach based on neural network is done by building training data sets of ascending and descending SAR images after co-registration. Different network input features have a huge impact on the correction performance. The comparison of the terrain correction performance of SAR images in the Wuyi Mountain area with three different input schemes show that the optimal correction result can reduce the image variance by more than 770%, and the other two input schemes reduce the variance by more than 70%. The correction results in four subareas with distinct topographic indicate that the average correlation coefficient between the backscatter coefficient and local incidence angle fall from 0.880 before correction to 0.224, 0.134, and 0.0382 after correction respectively and the mean values of the image variance correspondingly decrease from 22.534 to 5.497, 5.153 and 4.371.

articleTitle: Research on deformation and control measures of TBM undercrossing buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, the finite element software is used to establish the calculation model of double-line TBM tunnel crossing buildings, and the influence of TBM construction on ground surface and buildings is analyzed. At the same time, the reinforcement effect of full-section curtain grouting reinforcement and advanced small pipe grouting reinforcement is studied. It provides the basis for the future development of smart city and the intelligent control of TBM crossing project, and provides reference for similar projects. The results show that:-l) The peak point of the surface subsidence trough will shift towards the fracture zone. 2) Building settlement deformation presents a trend of large in the middle and small at both ends. 3) With the increase of the number of layers, the settlement value of the frame column decreases gradually. 4) Better effect of full section curtain grouting reinforcement.

articleTitle: Effect of Temperature Shock on Mechanical Properties and Energy Evolution of Sandstone
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: To explore the influence of temperature shock on the mechanical properties and energy evolution characteristics of sandstone during failure process, a series of triaxial compression tests on sandstone under different confining pressures and temperature shock were carried out. The results show that: when confining pressure is the same, with the increase of temperature shock cycles, the uncoordinated thermal expansion between mineral grains leads to a significant reduction in the stress characteristic strength and peak strength of sandstone occurring in different failure phases. During the loading process, the strain energy transformed by the external force is almost converted into elastic strain energy that can be released before the expansion stress is generated, as well as the change of dissipation energy is approximately 0. After the expansion stress is generated, the internal cracks inside the sandstone developed unstably. The strain energy transformed by the external force is slowly transformed into dissipated energy. The dissipated energy increases rapidly with the axial strain which remains at a high level in the post-peak stage. With the increase of the number of temperature shock cycles, the strain energy and elastic strain energy both decrease and the decrease amplitude becomes slower, while dissipation energy is just the opposite. The greater the dissipation energy, the more prone to cracks inside sample after expansion.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Analysis of Water Resources Scheduling in The Yellow River Basin Based on Improved Fuzzy C-Means
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: This paper established a comprehensive evaluation index system of economic development-ecological environment-water resource scheduling in 2019 by combining the status of water resources development and scheduling, economic development and ecological environment in the Yellow River Basin. The existing water resource scheduling and coordinated development in the Yellow River Basin was evaluated through Fuzzy C-means (FCM) based on genetic simulated algorithm. The application example indicated that the improved FCM could avoid falling into the local optimal, and be used for grading the clustering results, as well as getting the classification of different coordination degrees in the Yellow River Basin, then evaluate the current water resources scheduling situation of each district.

articleTitle: Research on Bearing Characteristics of Modified Variable Diameter Micropile Based on Pile Group with Uniform-section
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to improve the load bearing characteristics of micropile and to study the deformation mechanism of variable diameter micropile. On the basis of the real type test of group pile foundation with uniform-section in plateau mountainous area, combined with the load transfer mechanism of variable diameter micropile, FLAC3D was used to numerically simulate the horizontal and vertical loads of three kinds of single micropiles, and to compare with the real type test of group pile foundation of uniform-section, the results show that: Due to the influence of bearing platform and pile group effect, the compressive and pull-out bearing capacity of pile group foundation is greater than and less than the sum of the corresponding single micropile bearing capacity, respectively; The ultimate pullout and compressive capacity of double diameter-extended micropile are about 4.4 times and 3.8 times of the uniform-section micropile. The soil deformation is concentrated on the expanding part and the value is larger, which shows the characteristics of frication & end-bearing pile characteristic of multi fulcrums; the vertical bearing capacity of double diameter-extended micropile is close to group pile foundation with uniform-section (2x2 micropile), but its horizontal bearing capacity is less than pile group foundation, which can be improved by adding a bearing platform to the pile top. It is feasible to improve the performance of single micropile to the level of pile group with uniform-section expanding the diameter, which has engineering significance for power transmission and transformation engineering.

articleTitle: Research on 110 Method Technology of Ultra Kilometer Deep Well Based on Microseismic Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Anju Coal Mine 5307 working face main mining 3 coal seam, buried depth of more than kilometers. In order to realize roof cutting, pressure relief and automatic roadway mining without coal pillar in a kilometers deep well, namely the ‘110 method ’, taking the 5307 working face of Anju Coal Mine as the engineering background, the ‘ 110 method ’ and the ‘ 121 method ’ are adopted for the track and belt roadways of the 5307 working face respectively, and the distribution of microseismic events in the field is analyzed. It is found that the number of microseismic events in the 5307 track roadway is significantly less than that in the belt roadway, and the energy released by the vibration is also reduced. The mining speed of working face also has influence on microseismic events. The faster the mining speed, the higher the frequency and energy of microseismic events.

articleTitle: Design and monitoring analysis of foundation pit support for sewage treatment plant
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Taking the foundation pit supporting project of a sewage treatment plant in Changchun as an example, using BIM technology, the geological conditions of the construction site, the hydrological environment, and the distribution of surrounding buildings and other information are gathered, and the design scheme of foundation pit support is formulated. At the same time, the displacement of pile top and pile body in the construction is monitored in real time, and Midas GTS NX software is used for numerical simulation analysis and verification. The comparative analysis shows that the use of pile row prestressed anchor cable can effectively limit the lateral movement of foundation pit and reduce the influence of the foundation pit excavation on the surrounding buildings, which can provide effective reference for similar projects in the future.

Author Keywords: BIM technology full cycle monitoring analysis

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Repairing Old Concrete with Slag-Fly Ash Geopolymer Concrete
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, old concrete was repaired by slag-fly ash geopolymer concrete (SFGPC) and the effect of interfacial roughness and interfacial agent on the bond strength of old and new concrete was investigated using splitting tensile strength tests. The test results show that too large or too small roughness at the bonding interface is not conducive to the bonding behavior of SFGPC with old concrete, and a reasonable roughness (2.4-4.8mm) can increase the bond strength of SFGPC with existing concrete by more than 50%-70%. The effect of interface agent on the bond strength is geopolymer slurry > no interface agent > geopolymer mortar > fly ash, where the most effective geopolymer slurry interface agent can increase the bond strength by more than 24%.

articleTitle: Laboratory simulation test research on soil characteristics of foundation pit excavation considering the deflection of principal stress axis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Three-dimensional stress path of foundation pit excavation considering deflection of principal stress axis is deduced by numerical simulation. It is found that the direction of principal stress axis of soil mass in the pit varies greatly and that the soil mass on the side of the pit is approximate to the axial shear. On this basis, a series of undrained stress path tests were carried out with hollow cylinder torsion shear apparatus (HCA) to study the soil deformation characteristics during excavation of foundation pit. The test results show that with the increase of deflection angle of principal stress axis, the stress-strain curve develops faster and faster, the positive strain components and shear strain develop faster and the strain increases gradually during the excavation of foundation pit. As the distance from the center of the pit bottom increases in the horizontal direction, the development of strain becomes gentle and the final strain decreases gradually. The trend of stress-strain relation curve of soil mass on the side of pit is basically the same. The positive strain components and shear strain develop faster from the surface to the bottom of pit, and the strain at yield increases gradually.

articleTitle: Improved denoising of structural vibration signals based on smoothing filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: For the purpose of effectively remove noise interference from vibration response signals, this paper introduces a filtering method which is often used in the field of seismic data processing to improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of data – smoothing filtering. The method is principally realized by triangular filtering, which is composed of two rectangular filters and has high computational efficiency. At the same time, triangular filtering can also be seen as an excellent approximation method of Gaussian filtering. When a trigonometric function is convolved multiple times with itself, it can approximate a Gaussian function mathematically. An approximate Gaussian filter can also be implemented after many iterations. By processing the synthetic vibration signal and the measured vibration signal, the denoising performances of the smoothing filtering method and median filtering method are compared. The superiority of the smoothing filter method is further proved by time-frequency analysis. The results reveal that the smoothing filter method can preferably retain the details of the effective signal while eliminating the noisy signal, and effectively improve the SNR of the data. The feasibility and effectiveness of the smoothing filtering method applied to the structural vibration signals noise suppression are tested and verified.

articleTitle: Research of Simulation Analysis on Multi-energy Complementary Wind-PV-pumped Storage System Based on Different Types of Pumped Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the base of the wind-PV-pumped storage system as the subject, this paper conducted a simulation analysis on multi-energy complementation of different types of pumped storage units by considering configuring wind turbines, PV generators, or other generators driven by new energy near the pumped storage power station in an effort to promote the efficiency of new energy. This study, on the premise that the requirement of output was met, compared the simulation operation of different types of pumped storage units, optimized the selection of unit types in line with the minimum damage rate of the system, and comprehensively evaluated those types in the light of return on investment (rate of return) after fully considering economic indicators of different units to provide a reference for selection of pumped storage units and combined operation of generators driven by new energy.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on The Shear Behavior of Stud Connector for Steel Self-Compacting Concrete with Machine-Made Sand
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As natural river sand is becoming scarce, replacing natural river sand with other fine aggregates has become an urgent problem. The self-compacting concrete with machine-made is a new type of self-compacting concrete material using machine-made sand as fine aggregate for mixing. At present, the research and engineering application of self-compacting concrete with machine-made sand is relatively small. In this paper, the shear performance of stud connector for steel self-compacting concrete with machine-made sand was studied and three combined members were designed for push-out test. The test results show that the shear capacity and shear stiffness increase with the increase of concrete strength, but the increase rate decrease. And the influence on shear stiffness is greater than that on shear capacity.

articleTitle: Hydraulic Characteristics of S-shaped Overflow Weirs with Different Curvature
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, FLOW-3D is used to numerically simulate the three-dimensional flow field of an S-shaped overflow weir with different curvature radius and arrangement forms, systematically analyzing the hydraulic characteristics of the overflow water, mainly including the flow pattern, discharge capacity, and energy dissipation rate. The numerical simulation shows that when the arc is convex to the outside (ie., <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{R}_{0}=1.2$</tex> m), compared to an S-shaped overflow weir whose radius <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{R}=1$</tex> m, the former has a larger cavity range. The basic hydraulic characteristics of the S-shaped overflow weir with different curvatures are generally consistent with the trend of the change of hydraulic head, and the energy dissipation rate of the S-shaped overflow weir with the horizontal arrangement is the best among the overflow weirs of three different curvatures.

articleTitle: Baseline Correction Analysis of Luding Seismic Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In many researches of seismic engineering, low-frequency seismic waves have important effects on bridges, dams, high-rise buildings, etc. However, the existence of various noises leads to baseline drift, which limits the availability of low-frequency signals. In order to obtain high-quality strong motion acceleration records, it is necessary to analyze the impact of various noises on the digital strong motion instrument, and conduct baseline correction analysis on the records to make them conform to the correction criteria. Based on the analysis of the Luding earthquake of magnitude 6.8 on September 5, 2022, and the baseline correction of its strong motion acceleration records, high-quality data including low-frequency seismic waves are finally obtained, and the relationship between its PGD and permanent displacement is explored.

articleTitle: Measurement Data Analysis of Deformation Coupling Relationship between Foundation Pit and Nearby Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The influences of foundation pit (FP) excavation on the deformation of nearby shield tunnels are significant. However, the quantitative analysis of deformation of FP excavation and nearby shield tunnel is still lacking. This study measures the displacement during FP excavation, and analyzes the quantitative correlation between the displacement and convergence of shield tunnel and the displacement of deep soil. The results show that horizontal deformation of nearby tunnels on the side can be estimated by horizontal displacement of deep soil outside the FP. The increment of both horizontal displacement and horizontal convergence of the shield tunnel caused by FP excavation have linear correlation with the increment of deep soil horizontal displacement. This result can be used to guide the similar cases.

articleTitle: Design of Treatment Facilities for Bridge Deck Stormwater Runoff on Highway
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In recent years, hazardous chemical transportation accidents occur frequently, causing extreme environmental risks to receiving water bodies. In concern of public health and environment safety, treatment facilities for bridge deck stormwater runoff should be constructed to avoid hazardous chemicals spilling into nearby water bodies.
