In this paper, characteristics and control techniques of bridge deck stormwater runoff were investigated, treatment facilities and an intelligent emergency response system were designed for bridge deck stormwater runoff on highway. The intelligent emergency response system can monitor, alarm, and prevent hazardous chemical leakage in bridge deck stormwater runoff of highway with high precision and integration.

articleTitle: Basic Experimental Research on the Application of Reinforced Mortar Layer Strip Method in BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: When BIM technology is applied to analyze the seismic performance of buildings, the integrity of design components and the accuracy of relevant data need to be ensured. The reinforced mortar layer strip method has advantages such as reinforcement simpleness and low reinforcement costs, which can help with the application of BIM technology to the field of seismic retrofitting. Based on this, a three-dimensional shaking table test was carried out in this paper, and the law of infill wall frame structures' seismic capacity improvement by the reinforced mortar layer strip method was obtained. Moreover, the dynamic characteristics, acceleration responses, and displacement responses of the model structures were analyzed. According to the research, it is concluded that reinforced mortar layer strips help enhance the ductility of structures while increasing the bearing capacity of walls, thereby improving the seismic performance of the structures. The research results provide data support for designers to apply this method in BIM technology.

articleTitle: Cause Analysis and Treatment Measures for Upstream Cracks of a Overflow Dam
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: There are several longitudinal and transverse cracks under the water level fluctuation area of upstream dam surface of a hydropower station. According to monitoring, detection and numerical simulation calculation, it is comprehensively judged that the cracks are caused by improper treatment of horizontal construction joints and are carried out under the action of hydraulic splitting, and there is the possibility of further expansion of cracks. After expansion, the anti-sliding stability requirements of the floor are not satisfied and reinforcement is required. Further, three-dimensional stress calculation is carried out for the three proposed treatment schemes, and the best one is selected by comprehensively considering the difficulty and reliability of implementation. Adding pre-stressed anchor cable and crack-limiting wall on the basis of sealing joint can significantly improve the stress of dam body and joint end and ensure the safety and stability of dam body. This paper provides a good reference value for the cause analysis and treatment measures of similar engineering cracks.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Sand Bag Materials Selection Based on Finite Element Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to explore the impact of materials on the working performance of large geotextile sandbags in the waterway regulation project, a numerical analysis model was established based on the engineering background by using finite element method, revealing the stress and deformation mechanism of geotextile sandbags under different sandbags materials, providing support and basis for the selection of large geotextile sandbags materials in actual projects, and a proposal was made to use 510g/m2 polypropylene filament woven fabric and 150g/m2 non-woven fabric to prepare composite sandbags. Finally, the application of the first phase of the Yangtze Estuary South Passage Channel Regulation Project is taken as an example to demonstrate the safety, applicability and efficiency of the technology, and the relevant achievements can provide technical guidance and application reference for relevant projects.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of Multi-Source Fracture Observation and Identification Scheme for Underground Engineering Rock Mass
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Rock fracture often becomes the key control factor for surrounding rock instability or water and mud outburst disaster in underground engineering. It is of great research value to effectively identify the key disaster control fissure for subsequent precise prevention and disaster reduction. On the basis of the scale division of rock mass fractures, a multi-source observation and identification scheme based on UAV aerial survey, ground close range photogrammetry and drilling, supplemented by traditional manual observation and supplementary survey, is preliminarily constructed. Finally, the application effect of the multi-source observation and identification scheme of fractures is demonstrated with an application case. This scheme can identify the relationship between the fracture and the location of the roadway, and the fracture distribution characteristics of the rock mass around the roadway. This paper is expected to provide some useful references for the information development of survey technology, the deepening of disaster prevention design and the construction optimization of underground engineering.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Analysis on Construction Process of Pile Method Pilot Tunnel of a Subway Station in Xi ' an
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The emergence of subway greatly reduces the pressure of urban traffic, PBA construction method can effectively reduce the subway station construction induced surface subsidence, is one of the preferred construction method of urban subway station construction under complex ground conditions. In order to explore the law of surface subsidence induced by different excavation steps of PBA method in loess area, a three-dimensional model of subway station was established by using finite difference software FLAC based on a subway station in Xi 'an. The simulation analysis of ground settlement caused by different excavation sequences were completed, and the field deformation monitoring scheme was executed. The FLAC simulation shows that the maximum settlement of ground settlement caused by the two construction sequences of “from bottom to top” and “from top to bottom” is located at the center line of the station, and the settlement curve is in a “V” shape. The displacement of deep soil mass in the pilot tunnel “from bottom to top” construction is small, and the variation of soil structure and interaction force is small, which is convenient to control the ground settlement. The results of engineering measurement are basically consistent with those predicted by FLAC, and the FLAC simulation calculation of ground subsidence law is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Monitoring Technology of Slope Internal Deformation Based on Distributed Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Distributed optical fiber sensing technology has been gradually applied in the field of safety monitoring in recent years due to its low cost, high sensitivity, strong immunity to interference and other advantages. In view of the shortcomings of traditional inclinometer in the practical application of slope internal deformation monitoring, a symmetrical distributed optical fiber inclinometer with four cores was designed and manufactured based on distributed optical fiber technology. The results of the landslide model test showed that the relative errors of the monitoring values of the distributed optical fiber inclinometer (DOFI) were within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 5\%$</tex> compared with the measured displacement values of the draw-wire displacement sensor (DWDS), which fully verifies the feasibility of the distributed optical fiber technology applied to the high-precision monitoring of the internal deformation of the slope.

articleTitle: Design of Modubus Intelligent Energy Meter Data Reading System in Civil Engineering Based on S7-1200
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: At present, smart meters are used in many industries to record the consumption of electric energy within a specified time. The electric energy consumption within a specified time can be recorded. This paper uses the Modubus network protocol and implements PLC reading of the smart meter date, and be convenient for electricity testing, realizing, counting and analyzing the separate electric energy calculation of different areas and different loads. The data reading method adopted in this paper enables accurate and real-time acquisition of electricity meter data during class hours to meet the application of industrial environment.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Construction Management and Control Platform in Airport Construction Taking Kunming Changshui International Airport as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of various advanced technologies such as the Internet of Things, geographic information system, real-time positioning, etc., the airport has gradually formed all-weather, all-factor and all-round construction data acquisition conditions. It is inevitable that rapid industrialization of digital construction will become necessary due to the massive quantities of multi-source construction data and the industrial application requirements. Digital construction technology focuses on visualization of construction data, facilitating all participants in viewing the construction situation, optimizing the use of information resources, and improving project quality and efficiency. At present, the application degree of digital monitoring of vibration grinding equipment needs to be improved in airport engineering. In accordance with the technical requirements for vibration and rolling equipment, the digital construction platform is built with hardware and software systems that allow real-time monitoring of construction vehicles, rolling tracks, rolling passes, rolling thickness and rolling velocity. Moreover, it has been applied in the underpass and the foundation pit backfilling project of the integrated pipeline corridor construction in the east flight area of Kunming Chang shui International Airport. By comparing the data presented in this paper to that of the third party detection, it establishes that the digital construction monitoring platform designed in this paper can be highly reliable and improve the project's quality and management.

articleTitle: Research on Information Monitoring System for the Whole Process of Pipe Joint Installation in Immersed Tunnel
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The floating transportation and installation of pipe joint is an extremely important part of the whole construction process of immersed tube tunnels. In order to solve the problem that the existing immersed tube monitoring system cannot achieve intelligent control of the whole process of floating transportation and installation of pipe joint, an information monitoring system for the whole process of floating transportation and installation of immersed pipe section was developed. The information monitoring system relys on Yuliangzhou Section of Xiangyang East West Axis Road Project and uses the cloud based B/S web page architecture. The system is composed of construction environment monitoring module, pipe joint floating monitoring module, pipe joint installation module, real-time cloud database, comprehensive early warning decision-making module and user interface sub module. The monitoring data types, monitoring methods, monitoring point layout and floating installation control points of the pipe section installation are analyzed. The external environment monitoring, floating transportation control of the immersed pipe and the installation control of the immersed pipe are effectively combined, and the functions of centralized processing, display and decision-making of the whole process construction data of the immersed pipe are given. The engineering practice has proved that the monitoring system has a good effect, and the whole process of floating transportation and installation of pipe joints is measurable, visible and controllable. It overcomes the operation difficulties of water-saving installation of immersed pipe, reduces the construction risk of pipe joint installation, and can provide reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Stress-strain Hysteresis Loops in Saturated Soft Clay Soils under Variable Frequency Traffic Loading
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In the past, scholars often used single-frequency traffic load form to study the dynamic characteristics of soil, but in the actual engineering context, because public transportation in the process of driving will produce variable speed driving and thus lead to the characteristics of the frequency is not unique, for the Zhoushan area marine soft clay soil, using Wille dynamic triaxial instrument to carry out a series of undrained triaxial test, study the combination of frequency on the dynamic stress of soft clay soil. The effect of combined frequency on the dynamic stress-strain hysteresis loops of soft clay soils was investigated. The results show that the combined frequency has a significant effect on the strain characteristics of the soil. There is a significant difference compared with the single-frequency mode. The stress-strain hysteresis loops in the combined frequency mode show the characteristics of sparse first and then dense, and the loading form of combined frequency can be closer to the actual engineering.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Digital Core Structure Characterization Method and Application of Thick Limestone in Baotu Spring Basin of Jinan
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The identification of rock structure has a significant impact on the mechanical properties and seepage characteristics of reservoir. In order to truly, accurately and intuitively characterize the pore structure characteristics of rocks, the thick limestone core samples in Baotu Spring basin were scanned by CT and a three-dimensional digital core was constructed, and finally the three-dimensional display and quantitative characterization of the pore structure characteristics of the core were realized. The research shows that the pore types of this rock mass are mainly intergranular pores, dissolution pores and a few intergranular pores, with an average pore radius of 15.71 μm and a permeability of 0.51. The small pores are the main reasons for the low permeability of this rock mass. This technology can also quantitatively identify pores, and has the characteristics of visual and nondestructive samples. It has greater advantages for the characterization of rock pore structure.

articleTitle: Study on Running Water Dispatching of Jiefang River System in Shishan Town
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: On the basis of the current operation scheme of Jiefang River System and according to the overall idea of live water operation in the area, a series of schemes such as optimizing live water operation of Jiefang River System are put forward. Through one-dimensional hydrodynamic and water quality mathematical models, the schemes are compared, analyzed and evaluated, and the recommended scheme of live water operation is put forward in order to improve the overall water environment of rivers in Jiefang River System, it provides a scientific basis for the practice of live water regulation in Jiefang River System.

articleTitle: Project Design of Nanchang Shared Parking System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the rapid economic development in China, there are more and more cars in cities, and the demand for parking is also growing. The backward offline parking equipment makes the parking process that is already difficult, which leads to the random parking of vehicles. So this paper analyzes many problems existing in the development of shared parking from the residential area of Nanchang City, points out the impact of different factors on parking demand, investigates the needs and suggestions of different subjects on the shared parking business model, analyzes the operation model of the shared parking platform, and confirms the feasibility of the platform development. Finally, an all-round system design scheme is constructed for the development strategy of shared parking. It is expected to promote the development of the shared parking mode in Nanchang City and promote the continued development of the shared economy.

Author Keywords: parking demand and willingness to share

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Mechanical Characteristics and Acoustic Emission Characteristics of Coal with Different Saturation and Impact Tendency
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Using RMT-201 rock and concrete mechanical test system, uniaxial compression tests of coal with different water saturation and impact tendency were carried out. The results show that the saturation of coal is closely related to its mechanical properties, and the strength of coal sample decreases with the increase of water saturation; The change trend of acoustic emission of coal with different water saturation is basically consistent, but the emission activity of coal with low water saturation is larger, and the active stage is ahead of that of coal with high water saturation; The relationship between coal burst tendency index and water saturation is nonlinear, which can be fitted by Boltzmann model. It is obtained that the burst tendency index decreases in a “ladder” manner with the gradual increase of water saturation. Therefore, the model can correctly reflect the relationship between different saturation of coal sample and its impact tendency index, which has important guiding significance for the prevention and control of rock burst havoc.

articleTitle: Study on Post-Peak Stress Surge in Closed Jointed Coal by Direct Shear Test Based on Particle Flow Code Method
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The Particle Flow Code (PFC) program is used to generate the closed joint numerical model of coal. First, the direct shear test of LPBM as the rock contact model SJCM as the closed joint contact model is carried out. Then the direct shear test of FJM as the rock contact model SJCM as the closed joint contact model is carried out. The post-peak stress surge phenomenon of SJCM as the contact model of closed joint is studied under the condition of rock with different contact models. The results show that when the shear displacement exceeds the minimum particle diameter, the shear stress of the closed jointed rock based on LPBM and SJCM will suddenly increase, while this phenomenon does not appear in the closed jointed rock based on FJM and SJCM, which is found to be caused by the defects of LPBM itself.

articleTitle: Flood Inundation Analysis of Existing Small Culverts and Study of Flooding Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to clarify the mechanism of inundation water damage of existing railway small culverts, and reduce the secondary water damage brought by inundation water damage to the railway. The article takes the K477+698 culvert of Lanzhou-Xinjiang Railway as an example, establishes the hydrological model through SWMM, simulates the inundation process of the railway small culvert, and analyzes the rainfall runoff under different return periods, studies the flooding capacity of the culvert, and obtains the following conclusions: the hydrological model simulates the inundation water damage process of the K477+698 culvert of Lanzhou-Xinjiang Railway and the actual measured data are close to each other, and the analysis is applicable for the flooding inundation of small culvert. In addition, When the culvert is not inundated, the water level of the culvert is positively correlated with the rainfall duration and the return period, and when the culvert is inundated, the inundation duration is positively correlated with the rainfall duration and the return period. Finally, after the inversion trial calculation, the critical inundation drop for the inundation of K477+698 culvert is 3h and 6h. The critical inundation rainfall for water damage is 20.14mm and 21.41mm respectively, which provides reference for the determination of flooding capacity of existing small culverts.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Tunnel Reflective Coatings Based on Safety and Energy Saving Requirements
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The advantages and disadvantages of the tunnel light environment will lead to increased lighting energy consumption or increased traffic risks. Reflective coatings have good optical properties, which can effectively balance and improve the above status quo. In this study, DIALux lighting software was used to explore the light environment creation and energy saving performance of reflective coatings in the arrangement of reflectivity of 50% to 90% and height of 1 to 6 m. The 30 design working conditions will be compared with the standard working conditions to analyze the light environment improvement effect in five aspects, including road brightness, brightness uniformity, unified glare value (UGR), vertical illuminance, and physiological equivalent illuminance. An additional 30 optimization schemes for changing the spacing of the lights further demonstrate the energy saving potential of the reflective coatings. The research results show that the improvement rate of the road surface brightness of the reflective coating used in the actual project is slightly greater than the energy saving rate, and the design should reach 2/3 of the area of the sidewall of the tunnel and the reflectivity should be higher than 70%.

articleTitle: Research on the Lateral Buckling of Submarine Pipeline Considering the Pipe-soil Interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: A nonlinear finite element model of pipeline buckling is proposed with ABAQUS. The pipeline is set up with initial imperfection, and the pipe-soil interaction is modeled with PSI24 element. The frictional pipe-soil interaction model is used in the model. The influences of lateral friction factor, axial friction factor and yield displacement on the initiation and post-buckling behavior are studied. It is found that the lateral friction factor has great effect on the pipeline bucking. The axial friction factor has small influence on the pipeline buckling. And the yield displacement has little influence on pipeline buckling.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of the Earth-Rock Dam after Foundation Treatment in Landfill
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Earth-rock dam is generally preferred in the landfill for its economy and strong adaptability to the surrounding environment. Taking an earth-rock dam of a landfill in Hangzhou as an example, the stabilities of four typical different cross-sections before and after backfilling behind the dam are analyzed. It shows that except one cross-section the safety factors are larger than the critical value proposed by the relevant specifications. Then foundation treatments are adopted under the dam bottom, and it is found that the safety factor could greatly increase after different replacement treatments beneath the dam. The results also show that with the scope and depth of replacement increasing, the dam is getting more stable. It is suggested to replace all the miscellaneous fill soil under the dam bottom.

articleTitle: Prediction and Statistical Analysis of Damaged Land in Coal Mine Goaf
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The probability integral method was used to quantify area and intensity of damaged land in order to study damaged land in the coal mine goaf. The degree of land damage in the coal mine goaf was predicted by statistical analysis. The land damage area in the coal mine goaf area was calculated by combined coal occurrence status with mining intensity, mining area layout and mining time series data of the mine. The land damage intensity of the coal mine goaf was analyzed by land use status and ground deformation contour of goaf were collected according to the grading standard of land damage. The law of deformation and failure in coal mine goaf were summarized. The degree of land damage in coal mine goaf was predicted. The results show that ground displacement change law of goaf was consistent with inclination rate change and obvious certain continuity distribution law in space. The degree of land damage in each mining area was positively correlated with amount of deformation damage.

articleTitle: Driving Factors of Water Resources Consumption in The Yangtze River Delta Based on LMDI
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With continuous economic development, the Yangtze River Delta region is facing the problem of conflict between economic and social and water resource systems, and problems such as water shortage and water environment degradation have become important factors limiting the economic and social development of the Yangtze River Delta city cluster. Therefore, the article adopts the LMDI method to decompose the water resources, and drivers of the Yangtze River Delta urban agglomeration, into technology effect, structural effect, output effect, and scale effect, and analyses the spatial and temporal differences of water consumption drivers in terms of spatial and temporal differences. At the end of the paper, the policy recommendations are put forward. Local governments should improve the water-saving awareness, optimize the structural effect and control the scale of population migration to promote sustainable development of water resources.

articleTitle: Computer Aided Analysis of the Influence of the Interfacial Bonding and Friction on the Shear Connection of Steel-Concrete Composite Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The bond and friction of the interface between concrete slab and steel beam can affect the shear force values of the shear studs widely-used in steel-concrete composite bridge structures. The complex bond-slip relationships of the interface make the nonlinear finite element analysis become difficult. In this paper, computer aided method was proposed for the analysis of steel-concrete composite bridge with interfacial bonding and friction considered. A new type of cohesive zone model with the cementing bond and friction included is applied to simulate the complex interfacial behavior between concrete slab and steel beam. Cohesive interface element was then developed through the user subroutine in ABAQUS software. Then a continuous steel-concrete composite beam bridge model was analyzed with the proposed method. Load-deflection relationships of the steel-concrete composite structure, interfacial slips, interfacial shear stresses, and shear force of shear connectors were investigated. Results showed that the bond and friction of the interface between concrete slab and steel beam can affect the shear force distributions of the shear connectors. Numerical analysis method proposed in this study can be used for the analysis and evaluation of the shear connectors used for steel-concrete composite bridge structures. Results of this study can be further applied to intelligent testing and monitoring. It can provide theoretical support for the data analysis of intelligent infrastructure operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: Deformation Analysis and Risk Control of Pile Foundation of Subway Shield Tunnel Crossing Roads and Bridges
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In view of the need for shield tunnels crossing urban roads and bridges during the construction of the Zhengzhou subway, this paper studies the overall process of shield tunnel crossing roads and bridges, the negative displacement deformation of the surrounding pile foundation due to the displacement of soil around the tunnel, and the impact on the safe use of the bridge. This paper builds a monitoring system for the whole process of subway shield tunnel crossing roads and bridges, collects and studies the data of each monitoring section during shield tunneling, and establishes a three-dimensional numerical model for the entire process of subway tunneling across roads and bridges. The actual monitoring data is combined with the finite element numerical simulation results to study the deformation law of the pile foundation of roads and bridges in the process of shield tunneling. By adjusting the construction parameters of the shield model, the bridge deformation control method is studied to provide a reference for similar projects in the future.

articleTitle: Simulation study on penetration effect of projectile impacting concrete target
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Using the numerical simulation method, the process of 76mm caliber rigid projectile penetrating concrete target at different incident angles is studied. In the calculation process, the concrete material adopts the HJC model, considering the influence of material damage, strain rate effect and hydrostatic pressure on the yield stress, and studies the relationship between different incident angles, projectile impact velocity, penetration depth and penetration time. The research results can provide a theoretical basis for the prediction of penetration capability, structural response analysis, structural optimization and material selection of high speed non-positive projectiles.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Static Compression Deformation Characteristics of Coarse-grained Soil Fillers
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to reveal the deformation characteristics of the coarse-grained soil filler of railway subgrade under load, this article carried out a systematic static pressure deformation test with a self-made model test device, and discussed the influence of various factors, like vertical load, rainfall infiltration, compaction degree, lateral stiffness. It's shown that the strain of coarse-grained soil filler is 0.6%-1.97% under the load of 50-300kPa. The deformation of coarse-grained soil increases linearly with the increase of static pressure load, increases slowly with the increase of rainfall infiltration, or decreases gradually with the increase of compaction degree and lateral stiffness. It is recommended to prevent rainwater from infiltrating into the subgrade in engineering practice, while strictly controlling the compaction degree during filling, and applying appropriate constraints to the slope of high embankment. The results can provide reference for post-construction settlement control of high-speed railway coarse-grained soil subgrade.

articleTitle: Analysis of Water Inrush for Tunnel Boring Machine Passing through Fault
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: It may be encountered with the water and mud inrush when a TBM (tunnel boring machine) passes through the fault fracture zone. In this study, the Xianglushan tunnel of Central Yunnan Water Diversion Project was taken as an example, the variation characteristics of surrounding rock seepage field during TBM tunneling through the Qingcaitang fracture zone without advanced grouting support and different advanced support (grouting) schemes are compared. Meanwhile, prevention and control measures are given accordingly. The results show that: 1) When the TBM cutterhead begins to enter the fault fracture zone, the seepage channel firstly occurs between the fault fracture zone and the tunnel, and the maximum local water inflow of the tunnel occurs near the interface between the fault fracture zone and the intact rock zone. 2) When TBM completely enters the fault fracture zone, the low pore pressure area around the tunnel further expands, forming a pumping well effect, and the seepage flow of surrounding rock increases significantly when compared with the intact rock zone. 3) Without considering the advanced support, the total water inflow of TBM cutterhead area in the fault fracture zone reaches 562.85 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h, which is about 11 times of that in the intact rock zone. After considering different advanced support (grouting) schemes, the maximum water inflow of TBM cutterhead area is 324.27 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h and 262.11 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/h, respectively reducing by 42.4% and 53.4% when compared with that in the intact rock zone.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Operation and Maintenance of Building Air Conditioning System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The development of 5G technology is driving the development of digital industry in China. In order to change the traditional on-site management mode of air-conditioning systems in existing buildings and reduce the maintenance costs of existing buildings. This paper proposes an economical and practical three dimensional visualisation air conditioning management system. The system applies open source free software such as Three. js. The system is convenient for managers to carry out energy consumption analysis and “health diagnosis”, and has certain engineering application value for the construction of intelligent operation and maintenance systems for existing buildings. This paper develops the system for an existing building at a university and develops the system functions according to the needs of different personnel. It enables remote monitoring of the air conditioning system, regulation and control, as well as fault warning.

articleTitle: Analysis of Flow Characteristics Around a Cylinder With Front Beak Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Karman Vortex Street phenomenon plays an important role in building safety. In this paper, ANSYS software will be used to conduct three-dimensional fluid structure coupling numerical simulation and calculation to study the fatigue damage of Karman Vortex Street phenomenon caused by the flow around the ocean cylinder. The total strain and equivalent stress diagram of the flow around the cylinder are obtained. It can be seen that adding a beak structure in front of the cylinder can reduce eddy current, and the inhibition effect is proportional to the protrusion length.

articleTitle: An Analysis Framework of Stability for the Concrete Gravity Dam in Landfill
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The dam stability is vital to the landfill safety, and its design and analysis generally refer to several relevant specifications. Therefore, taking the concrete gravity dam of a typical landfill project in Hangzhou as the background, both limit equilibrium method (LEM) consisting of two simplified calculation modes and strength reduction method (SRM) are adopted to analyze the dam stability. The calculation models are simplified and the resulting ultimate sliding surfaces are similar to each other. The safety factors are 1.474 and 1.469 in the LEM, respectively. However, it is 1.23 in the SRM. The difference can be due to the different calculation mechanism. Considering some actual construction factors, the dam could be identified in a stable state. Finally, the analysis framework of the concrete gravity dam in a landfill is expected to be a reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Research on the Real-time Calculation Method of safety factor of Tailings Dam Based on Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Stability analysis is an important method to estimate the safety of tailings dam, In order to monitor the real-time safety of the tailings dam, this study establishes the dynamic modeling technology of the tailings dam outer profile model based on the monitoring data such as the beach crest elevation, the outer dam slope ratio, and others data of the tailings dam online monitoring system, uses the preliminary optimization algorithm of profile to generate the generalized zones of the cross section of tailings dam, and then employs the discrete point results of phreatic line monitoring data to fit the phreatic line curve of tailings dam based on the theoretical calculation formula of spatial distribution curve of phreatic line, finally uses Python language to develop the real-time calculation module of tailings dam safety factor, thus realizing the real-time calculation of tailings dam safety factor based on the outer profile monitoring data and phreatic line real-time monitoring data.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Parts in The Primary Return Air System
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: It is difficult to detect the faults of air valve and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sensor in the primary return air system. If not handled in time, the system will be affected. First, we built an experimental platform with 10 fault conditions and 1 fault-free condition. Then we selected 5 parameters to describe the system state when the air valve and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sensor fail. It is found that faults can change system's ability to control CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, energy consumption and operating time. For example, return valve's smaller fault results in 2.86% reduction of fan energy, 19.20% increase of system energy, 24.23% increase of fresh air energy and 44.04% decrease of operating time. CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sensor's larger fault results in 15.32% increase of fan energy, 25.21% increase of system energy and 27.46% increase of fresh air energy. It also makes fan keep working for a long time. In the end, we developed a fault diagnosis table for parts' fault in the primary return air system.

articleTitle: Application of Micro-seepage Field Detection in Reservoir Leakage Treatment
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Leakage is a key factor affecting the safety of reservoir dams. In view of the problems which is difficult to accurately locate the leakage point of reservoir dams and the inaccurate measurement of leakage volume, this paper describes the principle of sonar velocity measurement, introduces the micro-seepage field detection technology, and successfully applied in Banqiao Reservoir. Through the ‘DB-VI three-dimensional velocity vector sonar measuring instrument’, the crack leakage passage of Banqiao Reservoir concrete spillway dam is detected, and the size and distribution of the acoustic energy transfer in the fluid are measured. At the same time, combined with underwater camera verification, the leakage site was determined, the leakage entrance was located, and the leakage amount of each part was calculated, which provided a basis for taking targeted treatment measures.

Author Keywords: DB-VI three-dimensional velocity vector sonar measuring instrument

articleTitle: Application of BIM Technology in International Engineering — Take Mauritius Cruise Passenger Terminal Building Project as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The Belt and Road (B&R) Initiative brings huge development opportunities for my country's engineering construction field and puts forward higher requirements for engineering construction management technology. BIM technology has good visualization, coordination, optimization, simulation and drawing ability, and is considered to be an important means to improve the degree of informatization on engineering construction management. This paper takes the Mauritius cruise passenger terminal building project as the research background, uses Revit, Tekla and other BIM software to carry out architectural conceptual design, steel structure deepening, comprehensive coordination and engineering calculation, which significantly improves the efficiency of the project and reduces to rework. It is hoped that the research results can provide reference to the research and application of BIM technology in international engineering.

articleTitle: A Study on the Basic Hydraulic Characteristics of S-shaped Overflow Weirs
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In this paper, FLOW-3D is used to simulate the 3D flow field of an S-shaped overflow weir for systematic analysis of the hydraulic characteristics of the water flowing through the weir, including the flow pattern, discharge capacity, and dissipation rate. In terms of the flow pattern, it changed significantly after water with different heights of hydraulic heads flowed through the S-shaped overflow weir. In terms of the discharge capacity, it significantly improved as calculated by comparing the flow coefficient m and the excess discharge ratio r. In terms of other basic hydraulic characteristics, the critical control section of the S-shaped overflow weir moved downstream with the increase of the relative hydraulic head, and the flow velocity distribution of the central section was quite different from that of both ends is quite. As the relative hydraulic head increased, an obvious low-pressure area appeared above the overflow weir, which significantly expanded as the hydraulic head went higher.

articleTitle: Application of Hexahedral Mesh Generation AlgorithmBased on Frame Field and Feature in Hydraulic Strcutures
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In recent years, hexahedral mesh automatic generation methods have been developed rapidly, especially the hexahedral meshing method based on frame fields. In this paper, a decomposition algorithm based on frame fields and feature edges is used to decompose some complex hydraulic structures. Benefiting from the state-of-the-art frame field theory, the output blocks of this algorithm can be meshed by mapping or sweeping methods, which is easy to implement in current commercial software. The decomposition algorithm in this paper has the ability to automatically and efficiently obtain high-quality hexahedral meshes without relying on experience. In the end, the scaled Jacobian is used to evaluate the final hexahedral meshes.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Large Section Rectangular Pipe Jacking Construction on Soil Deformation
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: During the construction of the underground space of the rectangular pipe jacking with a large section, a large amount of soil below is lost, which cannot be ignored to the surrounding soil Sedimentation occurs depending on the disturbance. Now, depending on a large cross-section rectangular pipe jacking project in Suzhou, the lateral settlement of the monitoring section is predicted through the peck formula and the random medium theory respectively, and the comparative analysis shows that the modified peck formula is more consistent with the measured value; The daily settlement data of the monitoring section are analyzed and compared to verify that the mud slurry injection during construction has a significant control effect on the formation settlement.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Control of Mass Concrete - - Application of Embedded Cold Water Pipe Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of heat release during the construction of concrete dams, the embedded cold water pipes are used to control the temperature. The finite element method is used to discuss the relationship between the cooling effect, cost and project safety when the pipes have different arrangement forms, diameter, material, spacing and water flow temperature. The results show that when the pipes are arranged in rectangular shape, the pipe diameter is 0.016m and the spacing is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{1}.\mathbf{5}\mathbf{m}\times \mathbf{1}.\mathbf{5}\mathbf{m}$</tex>, the comprehensive effect is the best. Piping material has little effect on reducing concrete temperature; When the water flow temperature is too low, it is easy to cause the internal cracking of concrete, which should be paid attention to in the construction.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization Analysis of Shallow Buried Pile-plank Structure on Deep Silty-fine Sand Foundation of High-speed Railway
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to control the settlement of high-speed railway subgrade under the condition of deep silty fine sand foundation, this paper studies the influence of different design parameters of shallow buried reinforced concrete pile-board structure on the settlement and deformation of ballastless track with the help of FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> software, analyzes the sensitivity of factors, designs multiple sets of models combining different pile length, pile diameter, plank thickness and longitudinal span, compares and analyzes the post-construction settlement, pile and soil settlement and stress analysis, plank stress deformation, so as to obtain the most suitable pile-board structure parameters for deep silty fine sand soft soil foundation. The results show that the sensitivity of pile length and pile diameter to post-construction settlement is greater than that of plank thickness and longitudinal span, showing a linear increasing trend, and the influence of plank thickness and longitudinal span is not obvious. As the pile length increases, the maximum vertical stress of the pile body also increases and the depth continues to move down. The plank is too thick to make the pile bear greater load.

articleTitle: Influence Research on Relative Stiffness to Synergistic Effect of Newly-built Pile-slab Wall and Existing Gravity Retaining Wall
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: For the reconstruction of the existing railway lines as well as the new second-line projects, the issues of roadbed widening and slope reinforcement can be effectively addressed through newly-built retaining structures on the basis of existing retaining wall. Currently, there is little research on composite retaining structure, especially on the synergistic mechanism between the newly-built pile-slab wall and the existing gravity retaining wall. In this paper, a three-dimensional model is established by Abaqus software. By the stiffness variation of the retaining slab and the elastic modulus of the soil, taking the slab-soil relative stiffness as the control variable, the influence law of soil arching effect behind the pile-slab wall and the synergistic effect of the composite retaining structure are studied. The results demonstrate that the stiffness of the retaining slab decreases, while the soil arching effect increases. Considering the stiffness of the retaining slab and the elastic modulus of the soil, when the slab-soil relative stiffness is between 63 and 100, the synergistic effect and soil arching effect are the optimal.

articleTitle: Analysis and Study on Seepage Safety Monitoring of Zhaoshandu Diversion Project
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The Zhaoshandu Water Diversion Project is a large (2) type water conservancy project, and the flood gate is its main component. Considering that the foundation of the flood gate is mainly gravel and gravel, the concrete anti-seepage wall is used for anti-seepage treatment, and the gate foundation seepage and around dam seepage safety monitoring facilities are arranged to evaluate the seepage safety of the flood gate. This paper analyzes the dam seepage safety measured data of the flood gate of Zhaoshandu Water Diversion Project after 10 years, The more accurate and objective evaluation conclusion can provide a useful reference for the safety evaluation of sluice seepage in large pivotal projects.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation System of Sewage Treatment Plant Based on ESG+E
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Sewage treatment plants play an indispensable role in improving the quality of the water environment and promoting the circulation of the water system. Its operation services are responsible for the control of water environment pollution. This paper optimizes the existing ESG evaluation, proposes the ESG+E sewage treatment plant performance evaluation system, and designs 17 evaluation indicators from four aspects: environmental impact, social responsibility, corporate governance and economic benefits. The AHP-fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method was used to construct the evaluation model, and the performance evaluation of a sewage treatment plant in Ji'an City was carried out and related suggestions were put forward to provide a more scientific and effective method for improving the operation and management of the sewage treatment plant and increasing economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design of On-line Monitoring System for Foundation Pit Water Level Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Deep foundation pits in coastal areas have the characteristics of high groundwater level, strong formation permeability, and large changes in foundation pit water level. The real-time monitoring of the water level of the foundation pit is an important basis for ensuring the safe operation of the foundation pit project. Traditional monitoring methods have disadvantages such as unstable equipment, high cost, and poor scalability. Therefore, in this study, a set of online monitoring system for deep foundation pit water level was developed by combining Raspberry Pi and IoT technology. The system mainly consists of data acquisition layer, data management layer, equipment control layer and data display layer, and has good expansibility. By embedding self-compiled Python Program in Raspberry Pi, the system can be controlled remotely, and the water level of foundation pit can be collected, stored and transmitted in real time and effectively. At the same time, the foundation pit pumping is controlled according to the water level of the foundation pit, so as to realize the fine control of the foundation pit pumping and achieve the effect of energy saving and emission reduction. Based on relational database MySql and B/S architecture, it realizes centralized data management, calculation and analysis, charting and other functions. The practical application test shows that the system has good stability, reliability and expansibility, improves the water level monitoring efficiency of the deep foundation pit in the coastal area, and provides a guarantee for the safe construction of the project.

articleTitle: Twin Non-local Attention Network with Frame-Similarity Loss for Video Instance Lane Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Lane detection plays an important role in autonomous driving. For video instance lane detection, both global spatial and temporal information is significantly important. However, the global spatial features and the temporal features are not been well exploited in recent studies. In this work, we address the video instance lane detection task by capturing global context based on non-local attention network. Specifically, we designed a twin non-local attention network to extract long-range dependencies along the spatial and temporal dimensions, respectively. Meanwhile, the global spatial and temporal features can be adaptively fused by gating mechanisms for better results. In addition, the frame-similarity loss is proposed to further exploit the information of adjacent frames. The experimental results on the video instance lane detection (VIL-100) dataset verify that our method achieves better results compared with other comparison methods. Ablation experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of each sub-module.

articleTitle: Effect And Prediction of Concrete Strength of Precast Pipe Sheets Under Different Maintenance Based on BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high water consumption and high cost caused by the late immersion curing of precast concrete pipe sheets, a new curing method of spraying instead of immersion is proposed. The relationship between the strength of the concrete under two types of curing was analysed. The relationship between the strength of the concrete under the two types of curing was analysed and the strength development was predicted using BP neural network based on MATLAB software. The results show that the growth rate of compressive strength of concrete at short ages of 3–14 d is higher in water immersion curing than in spray curing, and the difference in compressive strength between the two curing methods at 28 d is not significant. The flexural strength of the specimens under submerged condition is about 8% higher than that of the spray condition at 28d. The results of the BP neural network model for predicting the strength development of the concrete were in good agreement with the experimental results, which verified the validity of the BP neural network model analysis.

articleTitle: Automatic First Break Picking of Blasting Vibration Signals Based on Modified Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In blasting engineering, in order to calculate the longitudinal wave velocity of the site rock mass with the help of the seismic wave excited by the existing explosive source, and at the same time consider the interference of the background noise, a method for automatically picking the first break of the blasting vibration signal is proposed, based on modified ensemble empirical mode decomposition, combined with the normalized energy concentration ratio of the autocorrelation function and the energy ratio of the vibration signal. An example is analyzed, and the results show that the method can accurately locate the first break of noisy blasting vibration signals and determine the longitudinal wave velocity of rock mass in the site accurately, which can be applied to the engineering practice of calculating the longitudinal wave velocity of rock mass by seismic wave method.

articleTitle: Study on slope instability caused by excavation of shallow buried small spacing loess tunnel
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The construction time of shallow buried small spacing tunnel is long, the surface deformation is large, and the surrounding rock disturbance range is wide. The staggered excavation of double caverns will cause secondary disturbance to the surrounding rock, which is easy to cause the instability of the soil near the tunnel slope. Based on a tunnel project introduced from China-Lanzhou Passenger Dedicated Line to Lanzhou Hub, the influence of construction sequence and excavation support method on slope stability of small spacing tunnel is studied by using numerical analysis software ABAQUS, and the displacement and stability safety factor of tunnel adjacent slope under different excavation methods are analyzed by local strength reduction method. The results show that: (1) Tunnel excavation reduces the safety factor of mountain slope and causes slope instability; (2) The horizontal displacement of the slope is small and the stability safety factor is large when the construction sequence of the left tunnel is first used for tunnel construction, which is conducive to slope stability. (3) In order to reduce the disturbance of tunnel excavation on the slope, CD method should be used.

articleTitle: Fast Calculation of Acceleration Responses of the Intake Tower under Near-fault Ground Motion
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As an important part of hydraulic structures, the intake tower is closely related to the normal operation of the dam diversion and drainage system, while the velocity pulse of near-fault ground motion has a significant impact on the acceleration response of the intake tower structure system. In this paper, the effects of the forward-directivity pulses and the fling-step pulses on the response of hoist chamber and tower body are studied when the near fault ground motions are modulated with different intensity paramaters. Fast seismic dynamic response analysis program is constructed for the intake tower and hoist room simplified mechanical model. The acceleration response of intake tower and hoist chamber simplified mechanical model under PGA (peak ground acceleration) scaling of near-fault ground motions was investigated. PGA modulation will affect responses of near-fault ground motion. Acceleration responses of the hoist chamber are increased with the near-fault ground motions with forward directivity. It is found that the acceleration responses of structure increase as the PGA scaling index increases, while forward-directivity pulse-like ground motions have more profound effects on the acceleration responses of the hoist chamber with abrupt stiffness changes.

articleTitle: A Real-time Predictive Study on the Deformation of Incremental Launching Construction of Steel Box Girder Based on Numerical Inverse
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In order to obtain a finite element model of steel box girder incremental launching construction that matches the actual structure and to solve the problem of difficult prediction of structural deformation in incremental launching construction, this paper combines the incremental launching construction with the response surface finite element correction technique and proposes a real-time prediction method of steel box girder incremental launching construction deformation based on numerical inversion. The method is applied to the calculation of a steel box girder step incremental launching construction. Firstly, the initial incremental launching construction full working condition finite element model is established, the modulus of elasticity and density of the main girder, guide girder and link truss of the jacked bridge are selected as the parameters to be corrected, the test design is carried out using the central composite design method, and the test sample calculation is quickly carried out in combination with the Python interface in the secondary development interface of ABAQUS software to obtain the response The objective function is constructed by using the Fmincon solver in Matlab to solve for the objective function, and the corrected parameters are substituted into the original model to calculate the structural deformation for the subsequent working conditions. The model is then modified if it exceeds the warning value, and recorded if it does not. The results of the study show that after the four finite element corrections, the calculated values of the subsequent predicted working conditions are very close to the measured results, indicating a good correction effect. Compared with the initial finite element model, the error is significantly reduced, and the error between the corrected response values and the measured values is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Study on Confined Water Control in Foundation Pit Design under Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Confined water inrush is one of the important problems in foundation pit engineering. How to control confined water is always the focus of research. Taking a foundation pit project in Hangzhou as an example, this paper briefly expounds the confined water control measures. It is found that, according to relevant norms and local experience, the measures of hanging waterproof curtain with pit-in-pit reinforced have been adopted successfully, which could provide a wealth of experience and guidance for the design and construction of future similar deep excavation projects.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Analysis of Long Distance Pipe Jacking Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Taking the second phase drainage pipe jacking project of Meilan Airport in Haikou city as the engineering background, since the axis of pipe jacking process inevitably deviates, the friction resistance and jacking force of pipe section under the condition of deviated jacking are studied on the original basis, and the force law of multi-row pipe jacking is studied through the force monitoring data of three rows of pipe jacking on site. By analyzing the field monitoring results of jacking force, internal force and contact pressure of pipe and soil, it can be concluded that the longitudinal stress value of pipe joint in jacking soil is basically the same, but the longitudinal stress of pipe joint in jacking soil increases with the increase of jacking distance, and the variation curve of earth pressure around pipe is relatively gentle, which decreases first and then tends to be constant. As Drive 2 is in the superposition area of soil disturbance between Drive 1 and Drive 3, with the jacking of Drive 1 and Drive 3, there is a certain soil extrusion effect on the pipe section of Drive 2, resulting in a significant increase of soil pressure on the pipe side of Drive 2.

articleTitle: Study on Flood Forecasting and Regulation Model for Datengxia Hydroproject
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Affected by the construction of Datengxia hydroproject, the river channel and flow pattern have been changed. An integrated flood forecasting and regulation model for Datengxia hydroproject was proposed in this study. The Xinanjiang hydrological model was used for flood forecasting model, and three reservoir regulation models were mainly considered. The model was used to simulate four floods in June 2022 successfully. The results showed that the model has great applicability in the flood simulation.

Author Keywords: a flood forecasting and regulation model

articleTitle: Bayesian Hyperparametric Optimization Based Random Forest Algorithm for Bathymetric Inversion of Inland Water Bodies
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of remote sensing technology and computer technology, machine learning algorithms are widely used in optical remote sensing bathymetry inversion. However, due to the many parameters of machine learning algorithm, the parameter selection has a large impact on the accuracy of model inversion. To address this problem, this paper adopts Bayesian optimization algorithm to select the parameters of the clerk forest model. The experimental results show that the Bayesian hyperparameter-based optimization random forest algorithm has the highest accuracy, and the average relative error is only 10.60% which is better than the research results of many scholars at present.

articleTitle: Influence Analysis of Large Diameter Shield Tunneling under Building Pile Foundation in Sand-cobble Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In view of the disturbance to the buildings caused by the underpass of a subway shield in Chengdu sandy cobble layer, a numerical analysis model of the irregular buildings under the double track shield was established with MIDASGTSNX software, and the laws of the building surface subsidence and the pile foundation stress redistribution caused by the large-diameter shield tunnel during the underpass of the buildings were analyzed. The results show that the surface settlement curve changes into a concave settlement trough. The deformation of the four corners of the building after construction is affected by the height of the building, resulting in uneven settlement. The bottom of the independent foundation of the building is under pressure, and stress concentration occurs at the pile foundation position at the junction of the first and third floor buildings.

articleTitle: Study on Optimization of Ventilation and Virus Transmission in Large Classroom Buildings
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In large classroom buildings, people are crowded and the flow field of air is complex. It is important to study the diffusion pattern of aerosol-borne viruses in large classrooms to prevent the spread of infectious diseases and viruses. The distribution and dispersion of aerosol particles with viruses in a classroom were analyzed by numerical simulation using a large classroom in a school. For the structural diversity of classrooms, the effects on particle distribution under two working conditions, natural ventilation and central air conditioning ventilation, were studied separately. The numerical simulation results show that the aerosol particles are effectively suppressed in the central air conditioning air distribution case, and the ventilation pressure of 50 Pa has the best virus aerosol discharge effect.

articleTitle: Study on Geological Prediction Method for Tunnel Boring Machine Tunneling Based on Geophysical Exploration
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Tunnel Boring Machine(TBM) tunneling technology, which has gradually emerged recently, has improved the efficiency of tunnel excavation to a certain extent, and improved construction safety. To avoid the risk of cutter head jamming, it is urgent to solve the problem of geological advanced prediction. In this paper, considering the particularity of TBM construction conditions, based on the principle of TGS360pro (tunnel geology survey) advanced prediction method, the geological model with a water-filled cave in front of the face was simulated by the spectral element method. The applicability of TGS360Pro prediction technology to TBM tunnel construction is illustrated by analyzing wave field propagation characteristics. When the seismic wave method is used for advanced geological prediction, the main energy is transmitted in the form of Rayleigh surface wave. In TBM tunnel construction, the TGS360Pro prediction method can flexibly handle the problem of the TBM cutter occupying the tunnel face through a special observation system.

articleTitle: Rebar Detection in Concrete Based on GPR B-scan
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: In the quality inspection of the highway bridge structure and tunnel lining, ground penetrating radar (GPR) is often used to perform the nondestructive testing of rebar distribution structure within the concrete. To address the problems of low precision and slow extraction speed of rebar features from GPR images, this paper proposes an improved target detection method for YOLOv5. The module of structural re-parameterization is designed to accelerate the rebar feature extraction, improve the path aggregation network to fuse multi-scale features and improve detection precision, and reduce the model complexity through the lightweight process of feature extraction and FPN-PAN network. The ablation experiments and contrast experiments with other methods show that through the detection method, 0.5mAP reached 98.6% on the REBARDETECT dataset, 0.7% higher than the 0.5mAP of YOLOv5 model; the model file size was 2.9M with a decrease of 78.9%; and detection speed reached 76FPS on A40 GPU with an increase of 49%, all of which could meet the requirements of high precision, fast collection and detection of rebar.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Microseismic Waveform Classification: A Case Study of The Yebatan Hydropower Station Project
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Deep learning plays an important role in automatic classification of microseismic (MS) waveforms, but there is still a problem of low recognition accuracy based on small training samples in engineering applications. We propose an enhanced convolutional natural network (ECNN) based on ACGAN structure for MS waveforms classification, where the generator is used to synthesize samples of specified type and the discriminator is used to identify class and authenticity. The generator and the discriminator are confronted with each other through alternate training, so as to ensure the accurate classification of MS waveforms with small training samples. Then, relying on the Yebatan hydropower project, 15503 microseismic waveforms are processed to study the impact of training sample changes on ECNN and traditional CNN model. The results show that the classification accuracy of the two models tends to be stable with more than 1024 samples, and decreases rapidly with less than 512 samples; ECNN method has higher classification accuracy than traditional CNN method under the same training samples, and the accuracy increases more significantly with the reduction in sample size. The research results can reduce the difficulty of modeling waveform classification and help the application of deep learning in MS monitoring.

articleTitle: Research of Effects and Control Methods of Ancient Stone Pagoda Vibration Caused by Shield Tunnel Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The amount of underground engineering increases steadily in large and medium-sized cities as unban construction develops rapidly. Then surrounding effect caused by tunneling is of great concern, especially the effect to important building and vibration-sensitive buildings. For tunneling engineering construction effect of Hangzhou Zijiang road to Hangzhou white pagoda, comprehensive numerical simulated analyses were conducted. Three dimensional Foundation-tunnel-pagoda FEM model has established. Effect caused by tunneling engineering construction to Hangzhou white pagoda was calculated with ABAQUS software. The simulation results showed that the calculated vibration value has gone beyond the limitation of standard regulation value without protective measures. It does not satisfy isolative vibration requirement under isolation trench of superficial layer (8.2 m). And it can satisfy the requirement under isolation trench of medium layer (17.45 m) and better satisfies the requirement under isolation trench of deep layer (32.7 m).

articleTitle: Characterization of the High Geostress Field in Deep-Buried Diversion Tunnels and its Inversion Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: The distribution characteristics and evolution law of initial in-situ stress field in deep tunnel are the important basis for the stability analysis of surrounding rock and the design of support and reinforcement scheme. Taking a deep-buried high geostress diversion tunnel as the study object, this study used the hydraulic fracturing method to measure the geostress and explore the distribution law of the geostress field in the deep-buried diversion tunnel area. Based on the measured data, we constructed a geological model of the tunnel area, and employed the finite element regression calculation analysis theory to run the initial inversion calculation of the geostress field in the deep-buried diversion tunnel area. The results showed that the average stress at the tunnel axis was around 23 MPa, and the maximum horizontal principal stress was 46.32 MPa, which belongs to a high geostress tunnel. The triaxial principal stresses can be ordered as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sigma \mathrm{H} > \sigma \mathrm{z} > \sigma \mathrm{h}$</tex>, indicating that the initial geostress field was a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sigma \text{Hz}$</tex> type and dominated by the horizontal tectonic stress. The difference between the maximum and minimum principal stresses at the tunnel axis was significant. According to the Mohr-Coulomb criterion, there is large shear stress at the critical surface of the tunnel excavation, which is likely to cause rock explosions in the tunnel. The inversion results of the initial geostress field were basically consistent with the measured results. Therefore, this study can provide a theoretical basis for the characterization of the geostress field in similar deep-buried high geostress tunnel projects, as well as the design and construction of the cavern.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Assessment of Shield Tunnel Construction in Karst Area
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Under the complex geological conditions such as karst, there are many factors influencing the construction of subway shield tunnel, the process is complex, the engineering risk is high, the difficulty is big, and the engineering accident consequence is serious, so it is of great significance to identify and evaluate the construction risk. Taking Guiyang Rail Transit Line 3 as an example, the main risks in its construction can be divided into four categories. Based on these four risks, a risk assessment index system for shield tunnels in karst areas is established. On this basis, the expert survey method based on WBS-RBS technology is used to conduct qualitative analysis of risks, and the weight of each risk factor is determined by AHP. The concept of risk index is introduced on the basis of risk estimation. The risk level of the main risk factors and the total risk level of the project are obtained. It has a certain reference significance for the construction safety control of similar projects.

articleTitle: Comparable Analysis on Machine Learning Prediction Models of Mean Annual Ground Temperature in Qinghai Tibet Engineering Corridor
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms have been widely used in the field of permafrost. In order to compare the advantages and disadvantages of different algorithms in the application of mean annual ground temperature, combined with 277 groups of mean annual ground temperature monitoring data along the Qinghai Tibet Highway and Qinghai Tibet Railway, three machine learning models of mean annual ground temperature are established based on mean vegetation index, latitude, elevation, equivalent latitude, surface temperature and ice content: support vector machine, random forest, radial basis function neural network model. Comparing the prediction results of the three models, RBF neural network has the best prediction effect, and the goodness of fit R2 reaches 0.87. The ice content of the prediction factor is an important factor affecting the prediction effect of the model. And compared with previous studies, it shows that the machine learning model is more accurate and stable in predicting mean annual ground temperature.

articleTitle: Research on Segmentation and Extraction of Mountain City Trail Landscape Elements Based on Improved PSPnet
publicationTitle: 2022 8th International Conference on Hydraulic and Civil Engineering: Deep Space Intelligent Development and Utilization Forum (ICHCE)
abstract: As an important part of livable life, the efficiency and accuracy of landscape data management and scene design of urban footpath have become the new requirements of urban renewal. In this paper, a landscape element segmentation method which can be used in street view images is proposed. This method is based on the PSPnet semantic segmentation model. Firstly, through the cascades of different dimension features, it preserves more details of Street view image on the basis of enhanced scene parsing. And then, a lightweight semantic segmentation model is constructed using the depth separable convolution module to make it more efficient. Finally, through experimental comparison, the average pixel accuracy and average intersection ratio of the proposed method for the sample segmentation of mountain city walk street scene are 82.49% and 77.87%, respectively, which are 10.14% and 13.42% higher than before the improvement. Furthermore, the segmentation results are better than other models commonly used. This method can effectively divide the landscape elements of urban footpaths, which is of great significance for the improvement of urban streetscape data and the promotion of municipal management.
